posts.title: Day 20: Customize Your Profile
posts.titleTr: 第 20 天：定制您的个人资料

op.content:
Over these past days, many Keepers have told us they want their Traphase Emotes to actually be put to use, and others have asked for more ways to personalize their Keeper's Archives. While discussing it, it suddenly hit us: why not bring the two together?

1. You can now customize the background of your Keeper's Archives from what you've unlocked or own: up to 10 Traphase Emotes, 2 Awaker or Garment artworks, 1 Background CG, and 1 music track!

2. The original function panel of the Keeper's Archives has been redesigned and narrowed to the left side, so the background you put together has plenty of room to shine.

3. On top of Likes, there's now a Comment feature! Only Keepers who follow each other can leave comments on each other's pages. Either side can delete a comment, and each Keeper can post 1 comment per day.

We can't wait to see what you all do with your pages!

We've always hoped that, whether in the official community or in the game itself, everyone can get along with kindness, respect, and good cheer. Beyond the fight against the Dissolution, may you also join hands and create some wonderful memories together. What other fun social features would you like to see in the game? Let us know!

The functionality improvements are drawing to a close. A quick preview: tomorrow will be a small improvement related to Affinity! We also know some combat-focused Keepers may care more about other things, so today we've prepared 1,000 Silver<:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662>  for everyone as well!
op.tr:
在过去的几天里，许多 Keeper 告诉我们他们希望他们的 Traphase Emotes 能够真正投入使用，而其他人则要求更多的方法来个性化他们的 Keeper 档案。在讨论的过程中，我们突然想到：为什么不把两者结合起来呢？

1. 现在，您可以根据您已解锁或拥有的内容自定义守护者档案的背景：最多 10 个 Traphase 表情、2 个唤醒者或服装艺术品、1 个背景 CG 和 1 个音乐曲目！

2.守护者档案馆原有的功能面板经过重新设计，向左侧缩小，让你拼凑的背景有足够的发挥空间。

3. 除了点赞之外，现在还有评论功能！只有相互关注的 Keepers 才能在彼此的页面上发表评论。任何一方都可以删除评论，每个 Keeper 每天可以发表 1 条评论。

我们迫不及待地想看看你们对页面做了什么！
我们一直希望，无论是在官方社区还是在游戏本身，每个人都能和善、尊重、欢乐地相处。除了与解散作斗争之外，愿你们也携起手来，共同创造一些美好的回忆。您还希望在游戏中看到哪些其他有趣的社交功能？让我们知道！

功能改进即将结束。快速预览：明天将会有一个与 Affinity 相关的小改进！我们也知道一些注重战斗的守护者可能更关心其他事情，所以今天我们也为大家准备了1000银<:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662>！

messages.content:
# 第二十天：定制个人主页

这些天以来，有许多守密人告诉我们想要让相位对弈表情派上用场，也有人想让守密人档案能够有更多个性装饰。我们在讨论时突然想到：为什么不把它们融合在一起呢？

1. 你可以从已解锁或已拥有的内容里，选最多 10 个相位对弈表情、2 个唤醒体或幻衣立绘、1 个场景CG、1 首音乐，来定制你的守密人档案背景！

2. 守密人档案原本的功能界面也进行了重新设计，收窄在左侧，确保你搭配的背景有充足的展示空间。

3. 除了点赞之外，还新增了留言功能！只有互相关注的守密人才可以互相留言，双方都可以删除，每天限发 1 条。

我们已经迫不及待地想看到大家把自己的主页玩成什么花样了！

我们始终希望，不管是在官方社区还是游戏内，大家都能友好、尊重、愉快地相处。在对抗融蚀之余，也能与彼此携手，创造一些美好的回忆。大家还希望游戏内出现哪些有趣的社交功能？请告诉我们！

功能性改善即将迎来尾声。预告一下，明天会是同调率相关的小改进！也考虑到或许有些专注战斗的守密人更想关注其他内容，所以今天也为大家准备了 1000 银芯<:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662> ！

大家平时说的「宿舍」，一般就是指主界面。而这次的个人主页定制是守密人档案，也就是点自己的头像、或查看其他守密人信息时出现的那个界面！

无光之境确实是早期的教程产物，我们目前没有继续更新它的打算！

When people say "Dorm," they usually mean the main screen. This profile customization, though, is for the Keeper's Archives: the screen you see when you tap your own avatar or view another Keeper's info!

The Lightless Realm really was an early tutorial-era product, and we have no plans to keep updating it for now!

恭喜20天，剩3分之1了，再加把劲<:Aurita_please:1356053110375714817>

重新评估一下相位对弈里的角色命轮强度吧。我不明白鸟弟(波吕克斯)和他的命轮为什么可以经过这么久不削，你们那种可以限制敌人生命上限并且能触发该层数伤害，同时拥有驱散缠绕、中毒麻痹、易伤虚弱，还有预备，又能回血的角色在这个环境很夸张吗？

罪印，这个层数不会因为他的死亡而消失，这也导致鸟弟常常和朵尔组在一起，鸟弟复活后可以直接开大，希望能如同痴醉一样，只要把造成罪印的角色杀死就清除罪印。

骑士诗命轮绝对是令鸟弟更加超模的东西，算力花费少，触发频率高，这性价比对于鸟弟来说是物所超值，并且也只有他能用，希望重做或削弱数值。

我的想法是其他角色的OTK都已经死得差不多了，鸟弟怎么还活着？
对我来说，唯独鸟弟的OTK最让人难接受，没有什么手法与技巧，全是疯狂叠罪印，除非伤害又高又快能一下拍死鸟弟和朵尔，不然很少有什么角色能应对。

说到朵尔，这里有一个大家可能各有不同的意见。我的意见的话，就是其实她可能也该削，不过削的不是她的数值，而是复活机制。很多时候，复活的确能逆转局势，一复活就开狂，你说是吧？血希。

所以我希望复活可以花一些代价，比方说被复活的角色仅恢复阵亡前50%或75%的狂气，并根据因复活损失的狂气量额外得到一些血量，这样让复活不会是一件更无脑的行为，而是需要深思熟虑的做法。

当然还有其他像以上有些强，代价少的角色，但我只想让你们先重视这两件东西。

(以上是我的看法，其他玩家也请理性看待)

messages.content:
`%player%` 给一些不了解情况的守密人带来了困扰，所以我们不打算把这个支持加回来。

至于状态图标，要正式支持所有这些内容，界面会变得非常复杂，所以很抱歉，这不在我们的优先考虑之中。

但是颜色、字号这些 bug，我们会为大家保留的！

`%player%` caused some confusion for Keepers who didn't know what was going on, so we won't be adding that support back.

As for the status icons, properly supporting all of that would make the interface very complicated, so I'm sorry, it's not among our priorities.

But the color and font-size bugs? Those we'll keep for you all!

messages.content:
我们会在未来考虑宿舍自定义的！
We'll consider home screen customization in the future!

融灾禁区支持使用应急灵知体之后，确实需要合理控制「靠囤积来过高难挑战」这条路，把弹性控制在合理范围内。这是顺带的考虑。主要的考虑则是……需要的时候却没法立刻买、必须提前囤货，这一点很不方便。但这么改之后确实也改变了一些原有的习惯，未来我们在设计这些细节时会更小心，抱歉！
Once the D-Effect Zone allowed the use of Emergency Gnosis, we did need to reasonably rein in the "stockpile your way through high-difficulty challenges" approach and keep that flexibility within a sensible range. That was a secondary consideration. The main one was... not being able to buy it right when you need it, and having to stock up in advance, was inconvenient. But the change did end up disrupting some existing habits. We'll be more careful when designing details like this in the future. Sorry about that!

posts.title: Day 18: Covenant Management Improvements
posts.titleTr: 第 18 天：契约管理改进

op.content:
A while back, many Keepers told me about all the inconveniences in Covenant management, and we heard every one of them. Some wanted new players to get the level-gated Covenants sooner. Some found the inventory cap too small. Some felt Auto Transcription wasn't flexible, since it only stops at the maximum attribute value. And then there's that awful Remnant conversion, honestly one of the worst things we've ever designed. Today, let's fix them!

## Lower Unlock Levels

- In the Rose Scrip Exchange, "Organic Form" now unlocks at Keeper level 25 instead of 56.
- In the Sediment Exchange, "Paradox" now unlocks at Keeper level 25 instead of 57.
- In the Investigation Exchange, "Dream of Medicine" now unlocks at Keeper level 25 instead of 58.
- In the Lightless Exchange, "Ring of Chamber 36" now unlocks at Keeper level 25 instead of 59.

## Higher Inventory Cap

From 1,000 up to **2,000**!

## Auto Transcription Improvements

You can now set your own target transcription value and attribute type.

## Remnant Conversion Improvements

- You no longer need each Covenant's own Remnants: during Transcription, 20 Thousand Faces Seals lock the first attribute directly!
- Remembrance Quills no longer need to be converted into other Remnants first; they can be disassembled straight into 20 Thousand Faces Seals!
- Once this goes live, all existing Remnants will be converted 1:1 into Thousand Faces Seals.

## Origin of Time Upgrade

Using "Origin of Time" on an Awakener now removes its bonded Covenant for free.

We hope these changes make the Covenant system feel the way you want it to, with more flexibility. Which other system features still feel awkward to use? Keep telling us, and we'll find a way!
op.tr:
不久前，许多守护者向我讲述了圣约人管理中的所有不便，我们都听到了。有些人希望新玩家能够更快地获得等级限制的契约。一些人发现库存上限太小。有些人认为自动转录不灵活，因为它仅在最大属性值处停止。然后就是可怕的遗迹转换，说实话，这是我们设计过的最糟糕的东西之一。今天，我们就来解决它们！

## 较低的解锁级别

- 在玫瑰纸币交换中，“有机形态”现在在守护者等级 25 级而不是 56 级时解锁。
- 在沉积物交换中，“悖论”现在在守护者等级 25（而不是 57）时解锁。
- 在调查交流中，“医学之梦”现在在守护者等级 25 级而非 58 级解锁。
- 在无光交换中，“36号密室之环”现在在守护者等级为25级而不是59级时解锁。

## 更高的库存上限

从 1,000 到 **2,000**！

## 自动转录改进

您现在可以设置自己的目标转录值和属性类型。

## 剩余转换改进

- 不再需要每个盟约自己的遗迹：转录时，2万面封印直接锁定第一属性！
- 纪念羽毛笔不再需要先转换成其他遗迹；直接可以分解成两万面封印！
- 上线后，所有现有遗迹将按 1:1 转化为千面封印。

## 时间起源升级

现在对觉醒者使用“时间起源”可以免费解除其契约契约。

我们希望这些变化能够让《盟约》系统达到您想要的效果，并具有更大的灵活性。还有哪些系统功能用起来还是感觉别扭？继续告诉我们，我们会找到办法的！

messages.content:
# 第十八天：密契管理优化

前段时间有许多守密人跟我吐槽密契管理的种种不便，我们都听到了。有人希望新人能更快拿到那些需要守密人等级才能兑换的密契；有人觉得持有上限不够用；有人觉得自动转录只会在最大属性值停下来，不够灵活。更别说那个糟糕的残本转化，那简直是我们设计过最糟糕的东西之一。今天就来解决它们！

## 密契解锁等级下调

- 「金券兑换」中，「有机形态」的解锁条件从守密人等级 56 下调为 25。
- 「沉淀兑换」中，「二律背反」的解锁条件从守密人等级 57 下调为 25。
- 「调查兑换」中，「入药之梦」的解锁条件从守密人等级 58 下调为 25。
- 「无光兑换」中，「36室之环」的解锁条件从守密人等级 59 下调为 25。

## 密契持有上限提高

从 1000 提高为 **2000**！

## 自动转录优化

可以自定义设置目标转录值与属性类型。

## 残本转化优化

- 不再需要各密契各自的残本，转录时直接用 20 个「千面印章」即可锁定第 1 条属性词条！
- 追念羽笔不再需要先转换成其他残本，可以直接分解为 20 个千面印章！
- 功能实装后，所有残本都会统一变为千面印章。

## 时间原点增强

对唤醒体使用「时间原点」时，可以免费拆下已结合的密契。

希望这些修改能让密契系统更顺大家的心意，也提供更多灵活性。还有哪些系统功能用起来不太舒服？请继续告诉我们，我们来想办法！

密契的平衡调整也在进行中，确实有一些密契已经不再适应当前环境了。具体方案现在还无法确定，预计还要再晚几天，到时候一起说！
Covenant balance adjustments are in progress as well. Some Covenants really don't fit the current environment anymore. The specifics aren't settled yet, so expect that a few days later, and we'll go over it all at once!

messages.content:
这两个问题正好体现了一种我们很难两全的矛盾。

密契解锁提早，是为了让新人早点接触到它们；在没有结合这些进阶功能之前，密契在早期的资源负担并不大，所以印章供给暂时不会因此调整。

反过来，密契结合如果开放得太早，很可能让人在早期就把资源砸进去。我们非常不推荐新人这么做：耗费大量资源，提升却有限。所以我们选择用等级来做保护。

These two questions actually show a tension that's hard for us to resolve both ways.

Unlocking Covenants earlier is so new players can get to them sooner; before the advanced features like Bonding come into play, Covenants aren't much of a resource burden early on, so we won't be adjusting Seal supply because of this for now.

On the other hand, if Covenant Bond unlocked too early, people would likely pour resources into it right away. We really don't recommend new players do that: it costs a lot for limited gains. That's why we use level as a safeguard.

这一点我们之前说过：反击的设计本身就已经把「敌人有时攻击、有时不攻击」这个特性考虑进去了，所以不会为凝视单独做调整。反击目前的环境确实不太好，前几天的改动已经解决了一部分，我们会继续朝这个方向走。
We've addressed this before: Counter's design already accounts for the fact that enemies sometimes attack and sometimes don't, so we won't be making a special adjustment for Gaze. The environment for Counter really isn't great right now; the changes over the past few days have fixed part of that, and we'll keep moving in that direction.

这个问题今天也有其他守密人问过，一起答：胚胎保留是新增的一种选择，可以搭配抽牌能力使用；如果你的队伍不适合，战斗结束前把它们用掉就好，和现在没有区别。血肉本身的强度和适配性，不靠这一项改动解决。
Other Keepers have asked this today as well, so one answer for all: Embryo retention is a new option, meant to pair with draw abilities. If it doesn't suit your team, just spend them before the battle ends, same as now. Caro's overall strength and fit aren't something this one change is meant to solve.

凝视尽管不完美，但它是一个提供时间紧张感的关键机制，需要保留。至于第几回合，6 回合是我们权衡「给成长型队伍的起手时间」和「不让无风险拖延成立」之后定的数，目前不打算往后挪。
Gaze isn't perfect, but it's a key mechanic that creates a sense of time pressure, and it stays. As for the turn count, 6 is where we landed after weighing "enough setup time for ramping teams" against "not letting risk-free stalling work", and we don't plan to push it later for now.

messages.content:
我们也想过节！这种氛围我们自己也喜欢。

现在少做，主要是产能：我们想先把游戏内容的基本更新稳住。2.0 早期几乎断更的那段时间，我们做过几个这样的小活动撑场面，但赶工出来的东西我们自己都不满意，所以后来宁可不做，也不想再端出半成品。愚人节那次完全是有人突然想使坏，一天灵感爆发就做完了，根本不在计划里。

但等产能腾出来，节日会有机会回来的。

We want to celebrate too! That kind of atmosphere is something we love ourselves.

We've been doing fewer of these mainly because of capacity: we want to get the core content updates on solid ground first. In the early days of 2.0, when updates nearly dried up, we made a few small events like that to hold the fort, but we weren't happy with what came out of the rush, so we'd rather not do them than serve up something half-finished again. The April Fools' one was purely someone suddenly wanting to be mischievous, done in a single day of inspiration and never in the plan.

But once we have the capacity to spare, the holidays will have a chance to come back.

messages.content:
密契的设计还在进行中，打击系有没有新密契，等密契平衡那天一起说。

最适配的密契确实会随着队伍、环境和新命轮而变化，而密契结合又是游戏里最深的那层追求，所以这种「练好的一套跟不上环境」的沉没成本，我们知道它有多重。至于直接改指定主效果或属性、又不掉数值的道具，目前没有计划：它会让转录这个系统本身失去意义。能做的是让转录的路更短一些，今天的残本改动是第一步。

Covenant design is still in progress; whether there'll be new Strike-oriented Covenants is something we'll cover on the Covenant balance day.

The best-fitting Covenants really do shift with your team, the environment, and new Wheels, and Covenant Bond is the deepest layer of investment in the game, so we know how heavy the sunk cost of "a fully built set that no longer fits the environment" is. As for an item that changes a specific main effect or attribute without losing value, there's no plan for that: it would make the Transcription system itself meaningless. What we can do is make the Transcription road shorter, and today's Remnant change is the first step.

messages.content:
话说得重，但我不回避这里的问题。

1.「攻防兼备」的判断，来自内部战斗设计团队多轮集体测试：围绕珊的特定配队，表现确实位于前列。但我们也注意到了大家的游玩感受与内部测试之间的差异，会继续研究。

2. 前几次加强落在触腕，是因为她首先也是深海界域的唤醒体，我们希望她在不依赖盾击的玩法里也能承担生存定位。

3. 盾击体系会不会继续经营：会。但整体方向上应该是半 C。正因为她攻防兼备，大多数时候我们不会把盾击做成主要伤害玩法，否则会和伤害型唤醒体产生严重的平衡问题。

两次回答之所以不同：第一次我答应了会看看；之后我们讨论、审视，反复确认了珊的表现和评估，所以第二次给的是判断。

Harsh words, but I won't dodge the questions.

1. The "offense and defense" assessment comes from multiple rounds of collective testing by our internal combat design team: with the right team built around Sanga, her performance is genuinely near the top. But we've also noticed the gap between how it feels to play and what our internal tests show, and we'll keep looking into it.

2. The earlier buffs went to Tentacles because she is, first of all, an Aequor Awakener, and we wanted her to fill a survival role even in builds that don't rely on Shield-Strike.

3. Will the Shield-Strike system continue to be supported: yes. But the overall direction should be a semi-DPS role. Precisely because she's built for both offense and defense, we generally won't make Shield-Strike a primary damage playstyle; doing so would create serious balance problems against damage-dealer Awakeners.

Why my two answers differed: the first time, I promised to take a look. We then discussed and reviewed it, and confirmed Sanga's performance and our assessment repeatedly, so the second time I gave you the conclusion.

1. 凝视的回合数和敌人的生命，是按每个关卡自己的推荐等级、预期的体验，以及敌人的特性来平衡的。

2. 命轮预设我们还没决定要做，所以标记、打点这些细节现在谈还为时过早。

3. 秘典书库的领取是有意放在「收集」这一步的：如果解锁时就直接到手，收集和确认这个过程就没有意义了。

4. 我们确实有不少教程没有更新，但也不一定会为每个功能都提供教程。

5. 曜闪的重点不只是样式本身，还有它和其他 UI、其他特效的相容性。有好概念很棒，但落到实际产品里是另一回事，所以第一次尝试我们选了更容易实现的版本，就像我们的第一件一星幻衣。

6. 性别转换我们不会做。玩家自己的同人创作我们不反对，但游戏要讲的故事、要刻画的角色，对我们来说是最重要的事。

1. Gaze timing and enemy HP are balanced around each stage's own recommended level, the intended experience, and the characteristics of its enemies.

2. We haven't decided to build Wheel presets at all yet, so details like markers or dots are premature to discuss.

3. The Library's rewards are deliberately placed at the "collect" step: if they were granted the moment something unlocked, the process of collecting and confirming would be meaningless.

4. It's true that quite a few of our tutorials haven't been updated, but we won't necessarily provide a tutorial for every feature.

5. With Scintilla, the point isn't just the visual design itself, but how it coexists with other UI and other effects. A good concept is great, but landing it in the actual product is another matter, which is why for our first attempt we chose the version that was easier to implement, much like our first one-star Garment.

6. We won't be doing a gender-swap feature. We have nothing against fan creations, but the story the game tells and the characters it portrays are the most important thing to us.

是的，互乘是正常设计。少数情况下，角色的核心机制会是一个独立乘区。所以负誓·奥吉尔即便在最初版本也有不错的潜力，但我们听取大家的声音做了紧急加强、而且加强的侧重点又在伤害端之后，就失控了。我们认为这是负誓·奥吉尔自身的平衡问题，和忘却篇时代的塔薇一样：只能认可这个现状，但不能以他为标准去抬升其他所有内容。从这个案例里我们学到的是，未来不会再在唤醒体推出不久就做草率的强化。

Yes, the multiplication is intended. In a few cases, an Awakener's core mechanic is its own independent multiplier. So Ogier: Oathbound had solid potential even in his original version, but after we rushed a buff in response to feedback, with the emphasis on the damage side, he went out of control. We see this as a balance problem with Ogier: Oathbound himself, much like Tawil back in the Faded Legacy era: we can only accept the situation as it is, but we can't raise everything else to his level as the standard. What we learned from this case is that going forward, we won't be making hasty buffs so soon after an Awakener's release.

posts.title: Day 19: UI and Rewards
posts.titleTr: 第 19 天：UI 和奖励

op.content:
Today's improvements once again come mainly from the feedback you've given us. The team has been deep in development, and some of the issues you raise have, over time, simply become habits to us. That's exactly the value of this kind of exchange: it helps us step out of our blind spots. I wrote these down, discussed them with the team, and we've decided to improve a number of the issues you reported.

## UI

### Awakeners

- **Arc filter**: when browsing Awakeners, you can filter by the arc they belong to.
- **Advanced Realm icons**: the Realm icons shown when viewing Awakeners and in lineups now come in two versions, Classic Realm and Advanced Realm.
- **Derived Card info**: when viewing an Awakener's skills, you can see the effects of their Derived Cards.
- **Quick upgrade**: when leveling an Awakener or their skills doesn't require Gnosis Primers, a checkbox lets you jump straight to the maximum level.

### Responsiveness

Our servers serve Keepers from every region at once, so many actions feel sluggish to some of you. We plan to gradually change this so that an action first shows its result as if everything went through, and only corrects it afterwards if the server data disagrees. Most of the time this should make the interface feel noticeably faster. But this change runs very deep, so it will take longer than the other items to roll out step by step. Today is just a preview.

## Rewards

### Library: Enemies

You can now view information on every enemy you've encountered! Unlocking the collection grants up to 960 Silver.
op.tr:
今天的改进再次主要来自您给我们的反馈。团队一直在深入发展，随着时间的推移，您提出的一些问题已经成为我们的习惯。这正是这种交流的价值：它帮助我们走出盲点。我写下了这些内容，与团队进行了讨论，我们决定改进您报告的一些问题。

## 用户界面

### 觉醒者

- **弧线过滤**：浏览觉醒者时，可以按其所属弧线进行过滤。
- **高级领域图标**：查看觉醒者和阵容时显示的领域图标现在有两个版本：经典领域和高级领域。
- **衍生卡牌信息**：查看觉醒者技能时，可以看到其衍生卡牌的效果。
- **快速升级**：当觉醒者升级或他们的技能不需要Gnosis Primers时，复选框可以让您直接跳到最高级别。

### 响应能力
我们的服务器同时为来自每个地区的守护者提供服务，因此许多操作对你们中的一些人来说感觉缓慢。我们计划逐步改变这一点，以便一个操作首先显示其结果，就好像一切都已完成一样，然后仅在服务器数据不一致时才更正它。大多数时候，这应该会让界面感觉明显更快。但这一变化的影响非常深远，因此需要比其他项目更长的时间才能逐步推出。今天只是预览。

## 奖励

### 图书馆：敌人

您现在可以查看遇到的每个敌人的信息！解锁收藏品最多可获得 960 银币。

### Gifts from Mythag

You asked for more Rose Scrip, more Covenant materials, and more pulls, so we've reworked the Gifts from Mythag rewards for days 8–28. Compared to before, that's an extra 270,000 Rose Scrip, 600 Thousand Faces Seals, 60 Remembrance Quills, and 6 Ethereal Cores in total!

- **Week 2**: 25,000 Rose Scrip, 100 Thousand Faces Seals, 25,000 Rose Scrip, 500 Investigation Badges, 25,000 Rose Scrip, 10 Remembrance Quills, 1 Ethereal Core
- **Week 3**: 50,000 Rose Scrip, 200 Thousand Faces Seals, 50,000 Rose Scrip, 1,000 Investigation Badges, 50,000 Rose Scrip, 20 Remembrance Quills, 2 Ethereal Cores
- **Week 4**: 75,000 Rose Scrip, 300 Thousand Faces Seals, 75,000 Rose Scrip, 1,500 Investigation Badges, 75,000 Rose Scrip, 30 Remembrance Quills, 3 Ethereal Cores

With these improvements, we hope to make your day-to-day experience smoother and help you build the team you want sooner. Keep the feature requests coming! We're past the halfway point of the challenge, and even if something doesn't make it this time, we'll keep it in mind for the future.

> To keep the discussion focused, if you have something to say to me that isn't related to the 30-day improvements, please head to [#messages-to-the-cat](https://discord.com/channels/1131791637933199470/1564326525640118523). I can't reply to every message there, but I promise I'll read every one. Off-topic or repeated posts in this thread may be redirected there by the moderators. Thank you for understanding.

messages.content:
# 第十九天：界面与奖励

今天的改进仍然主要来自此前大家给我们的反馈。团队一直在紧张开发，大家提的一些问题对团队来说有时候久而久之成了习惯。这正是这种交流形式的价值：它帮我们跳出盲区。我把这些记录下来、和团队讨论之后，决定对其中一些反馈的问题做出改进。

## 界面

### 唤醒体

- **篇章筛选**：查看唤醒体时，可以按所属篇章筛选。
- **神圣界域标识**：查看唤醒体和编队时显示的界域图标，分为经典界域和神圣界域两个版本。
- **衍生卡信息**：查看唤醒体技能时，可以查看其衍生卡的效果。
- **快速升级**：在不需要消耗原初灵核的情况下，升级唤醒体等级或技能时，可以勾选一键提升至最大等级。

### 流畅响应

游戏服务器要同时服务全球各地区的守密人，所以很多操作会让一部分守密人感觉反应迟缓。我们计划逐步改为：操作先按一切正常来显示结果，随后如果与服务器数据不一致，再以服务器为准修正。大多数时候，这会让界面反馈明显更快。不过这项改动非常底层，需要比其他内容更多的时间逐步实装，今天先作预告。

## 奖励

### 秘典书库：敌人

可以查看所有你遭遇过的敌人情报了！通过收藏解锁，最多可获得 960 银芯。

### 学园礼赠

大家提到希望有更多金券、密契材料和抽卡机会，我们重做了学园礼赠第 8–28 天的奖励。与过去相比，总共增加了 27 万蔷薇金券、600 千面印章、60 追念羽笔和 6 空幻之芯！

- **第二周**：2.5 万蔷薇金券、100 千面印章、2.5 万蔷薇金券、500 调查徽章、2.5 万蔷薇金券、10 追念羽笔、1 空幻之芯
- **第三周**：5 万蔷薇金券、200 千面印章、5 万蔷薇金券、1000 调查徽章、5 万蔷薇金券、20 追念羽笔、2 空幻之芯
- **第四周**：7.5 万蔷薇金券、300 千面印章、7.5 万蔷薇金券、1500 调查徽章、7.5 万蔷薇金券、30 追念羽笔、3 空幻之芯

通过这些改进，我们希望进一步改善大家的日常体验，帮助大家更快养成心仪的队伍。欢迎继续提出其他功能性改进的愿望！挑战已经过半，就算这次来不及，我们未来也会参考。

> 为了让讨论有序，如果你有和 30 天改进无关的其他话题想对我说，请移步 [#给校猫的留言](https://discord.com/channels/1131791637933199470/1564326525640118523)。那里我无法做到每一条都回应，但我保证每一条都会看。因此本帖里无关或重复的内容，版主可能会引导移到那边去，敬请理解。

这确实不太统一。我们会看看有没有办法改善！
That's true, it isn't very consistent. We'll see what we can do to improve it!

1. 我们也非常希望未来有机会做，但这对我们来说仍然是个大工程。
2. 等基本的玩法丰富度问题解决之后，这些更休闲、更生活化的场景会是我们的下一个目标！
3. 我正在为此努力：用初始四小强的阵容打主线困难，还在推进中。

1. We'd very much like to do it someday too, but it's still a major undertaking for us.
2. Once the basic question of gameplay variety is sorted, these more relaxed, slice-of-life scenes will be our next goal!
3. I'm working on it: clearing the main story on Hard with the four starter Awakeners, still in progress.
4. Early in 2.0, we launched the entire Astral Reign plan with little more than drafts, and a lot of content genuinely wasn't ready in time. Once we had slightly more resources than before, we wanted to make him into a rather different kind of Awakener.
5. Enemies you've met in Investigation stages will be unlocked retroactively; for other stages, technical and time constraints may make that impossible. Most of the collection should be backfilled automatically, and a small remainder may still need to be encountered again to unlock.

messages.content:
我们的原则没变：除非是确定性的恶性 bug，否则不削弱守密人已经拥有的能力，负誓·奥吉尔也一样，哪怕是「削一处补一处」的调法。他的问题我们会从环境和之后的新角色设计上去平衡，而不是动已经在大家手里的东西。

我们以前讨论过一种方式：提供不同的技能模组让大家自己选，这更符合新理念和原设定。但它会继续加大游戏的复杂度。我们已经有多个篇章、多个界域，如果唤醒体再迎来不同版本的技能模组，最终可能让人望而生畏。

Our principle hasn't changed: unless there's a confirmed critical bug, we don't nerf abilities Keepers already have, and that goes for Ogier: Oathbound too, even as a "trim one thing, strengthen another" adjustment. We'll balance his situation through the environment and future Awakener design, not by touching what's already in your hands.

We did once discuss another approach: offering different skill modules for you to choose from, which would fit both the new philosophy and the original design better. But it would add yet more complexity. We already have multiple arcs and multiple Realms; if Awakeners also came in different skill-module versions, it could end up overwhelming.

也许我们可以做成：购买或获得时如果带有 8 的属性，就自动锁定？这样剩下的就可以放心批量分解了。
Maybe we could make it so that a Covenant with an attribute at 8 gets auto-locked when you buy or obtain it? Then everything else could be batch-disassembled without worry.

messages.content:
1. 确实，2.0 篇章我们取舍掉了探索环节。理由很明确：这类关卡设计耗费很多成本，而等你足够熟悉之后，有意义的体验可能却很少。星辰篇初期资源紧张，我们没有可能继续保持。第二章那个特殊关卡其实就是我设计的，我也很希望未来有机会再做这样的叙事关卡。

2. 这类细节当初确实花了不少心思，但也正因如此，后面的更新我们负担不起。谢谢你喜欢它们，这些设计虽然没有继续更新，但并没有白费。我们希望未来有机会少而精地带来一些探索关卡。

3. 早前也有守密人问过这个。整个游戏的设计思路确实一直在演进：直到星辰篇后半，我们才逐渐有了强度和设计标准；之前的测试甚至没有一个真正可靠的验证环境。为了补齐这种参差，我们确实多次做过数值增强，但主要目的都是让配队更多样。

考虑到游戏里能力来源实在太复杂，我们有意合并简化，同时让基础技能模组本身就有完整的核心功能和体验。

第 2 启灵多是小效果、而且确实多见打击和防御，是因为我们需要让打击和防御也参与唤醒体的玩法，这样出每一张牌才更有趣。但这不该成为定势，我们会再注意！

至于主属性的多样化，是因为我们不希望所有配装都基于同一种性能考虑。如果所有伤害唤醒体都是暴击率和暴击伤害，配装和体验就会非常单一，这是我们不想看到的。

messages.content:
1. It's true that we cut the exploration element in the 2.0 arc. The reason is clear: those stages cost a lot to build, and once you're familiar enough with them, the meaningful experience can be quite thin. With resources tight early in Astral Reign, we had no way to keep it up. The special stage in Chapter 2 was actually designed by me, and I'd very much like the chance to make narrative stages like that again.

2. Those details took a lot of care back then, and precisely because of that, we couldn't afford to keep them up in later updates. Thank you for loving them; even though those designs weren't continued, they weren't wasted. We hope to bring back a few exploration stages in the future, fewer but better.

3. Other Keepers have asked this before. The game's design thinking really has kept evolving: it wasn't until the second half of Astral Reign that we gradually established standards for power and design, and before that our testing didn't even have a truly reliable validation environment. To close that gap we did bring several rounds of numerical buffs, but the main purpose was always to make team-building more varied.

Given how complex the sources of power in the game have become, we've deliberately been merging and simplifying, while making sure the base skill kit itself delivers the complete core function and experience.

The second Enlighten tends to be a small effect, and often involves Strike and Defense, because we need Strike and Defense to take part in an Awakener's gameplay too, so that every card you play is more interesting. But that shouldn't become a fixed pattern, and we'll keep an eye on it!

As for diversifying the main attributes, it's because we don't want every build to revolve around a single performance consideration. If every damage dealer were about crit rate and crit damage, builds and the experience would become extremely one-note, and that's something we want to avoid.
messages.tr:
1.我们确实在2.0弧线中砍掉了探索元素。原因很明显：这些阶段的建造成本很高，一旦你足够熟悉它们，有意义的体验就会变得很薄弱。由于《星界王朝》早期的资源紧张，我们没有办法维持下去。第二章的特殊舞台实际上是我设计的，我非常希望有机会再次制作这样的叙事舞台。

2. 这些细节当时需要非常小心，正因为如此，我们无法在以后的更新中保留它们。谢谢你对他们的爱；尽管这些设计没有继续，但它们并没有浪费。我们希望未来能带回一些探索阶段，更少但更好。

3.其他Keeper之前也问过这个问题。游戏的设计思维确实在不断发展：直到《Astral Reign》的后半段，我们才逐渐建立了功耗和设计的标准，而在此之前我们的测试甚至没有真正可靠的验证环境。为了缩小这一差距，我们确实带来了几轮数值增益，但主要目的始终是让团队建设更加多样化。
考虑到游戏中的力量来源变得多么复杂，我们有意进行合并和简化，同时确保基本技能套件本身提供完整的核心功能和体验。

第二个启蒙往往是一个小效果，并且经常涉及攻击和防御，因为我们也需要攻击和防御来参与觉醒者的游戏，这样你打的每张牌都会更有趣。但这不应该成为固定模式，我们会密切关注！

至于主要属性的多样化，是因为我们不希望每个构建都围绕单一的性能考虑。如果每个伤害经销商都关注暴击率和暴击伤害，那么构建和体验将变得非常单一，这是我们想要避免的事情。

messages.content:
从第一个版本开始，我们就坚持事无巨细地公告游戏里有什么内容，这些公告至今都可以查看。目的就是让大家知道我们不会暗改。这是我们的理念。

我们的人手确实有限，往往只有在设计某类新内容时才会发现原来存在的异常。修正它们，是为了让游戏更统一、更可被理解。我们明白这些修正确实让大家不快，所以后来也改变了方式：让 BUG 尽早被发现、尽早公告，说明我们会修正什么。

这类 BUG 修正，无论理由和时机，只要动的是大家已经习惯的内容，就总会让人不快，这一点我们无可否认，也深知它会造成得来不易的信任损失。但我们能做的，仍然只有把这些事做得更好，减少未来再出现类似的问题，在长期的实践中赢回信任。

From the very first version, we've insisted on announcing every detail of what's in the game, and those announcements are still available today. The point is for you to know that we don't make hidden changes. That's our principle.

Our team is small, and we often only discover an existing anomaly when designing some new kind of content. Fixing them is about keeping the game consistent and understandable. We understand these fixes have genuinely upset people, which is why we've since changed our approach: find bugs earlier, announce them earlier, and state what we're going to fix.

Whatever the reason or timing, a bug fix that touches something you've grown used to will always sting. We can't deny that, and we know it costs hard-won trust. But all we can do is handle these things better, reduce the chance of similar problems in the future, and win that trust back through what we do over the long run.

posts.title: Day 17: Crossing the Language Barrier
posts.titleTr: 第 17 天：跨越语言障碍

op.content:
On the very first day of this challenge, Keepers were already reporting language problems. I've watched you recommend the game enthusiastically to friends who then couldn't join because of the language barrier. That's why, back when 2.0 was announced, we also announced the plan to replace AI translation with human English localization.

At the same time, we've heard that you'd like more ways to communicate inside the game. But the Morimens community comes from countries all over the world, and communication runs into the same language barrier.

Neither of these is a small problem, but today we're taking a step forward in two directions:

## English Localization

From announcing human localization in 2.0 to reaching an expected 100% coverage in 2.7, we're finally close to finishing this goal. Catching up on the large backlog of text while keeping pace with every version's new content hasn't been easy. We hope it lets more Keepers get past the language barrier, follow the story of Morimens, and feel its details and emotions.
op.tr:
在本次挑战的第一天，Keepers 就已经报告了语言问题。我看到你热情地向朋友推荐这款游戏，但后来由于语言障碍而无法加入。所以，在2.0发布的时候，我们也宣布了用人类英语本地化取代人工智能翻译的计划。

同时，我们听说您希望有更多的方式在游戏内进行交流。但 Morimens 社区来自世界各地，沟通遇到相同的语言障碍。

这些都不是小问题，但今天我们在两个方向上迈出了一步：

## 英文本地化

从2.0宣布人类本地化到2.7达到预期的100%覆盖率，我们终于接近完成这个目标了。赶上大量积压的文本，同时跟上每个版本的新内容并不容易。我们希望它能让更多的守护者跨越语言障碍，跟随莫里门斯的故事，感受它的细节和情感。

messages.content:
## Emote Comments

The comment button will show the comment count directly, so you can see where the discussion is, and you'll be able to send Traphase emotes in comments. Emotes cross language barriers, and we hope they'll help everyone communicate better.

While we're here, a quick update on other languages: human Korean localization is expected to reach 70%, other languages are moving forward step by step with the help of volunteers, and the AI translation technology that serves as our fallback is being improved for better accuracy. You've probably noticed that parameters and code showing incorrectly has become rarer, but inconsistent old and new terminology and content shown in the wrong language are still there. There's a lot of work left on the language experience, and we'll keep at it. Once again, thank you to the volunteers and Keepers who have been helping us with languages all along.

Today is a small-change day, so whichever language you play in, we've prepared 1,000 Silver <:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662> <:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662> <:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662> for everyone. Have a great weekend, Keepers!

messages.content:
# 第十七天：跨越语言

挑战开始的第一天，就有守密人反馈语言问题。我见过大家热情地把游戏推荐给朋友，朋友却因为语言障碍而无法加入。所以早在 2.0 宣布的那段时间，我们就一并宣布了用英语真人本地化取代 AI 翻译的计划。

与此同时，我们也收到了希望游戏内有更多交流功能的声音。但《忘却前夜》的社区来自全球各个国家，交流同样面临语言障碍。

这两个都不是小问题，但今天我们从两个方向各向前推进一步：

## 英语本地化

从 2.0 宣布引入人工本地化，到预计在 2.7 实现 100% 覆盖，我们终于快要完成这个目标。补齐过去积累的大量文本、同时跟上每个版本的新内容并不容易。希望这能让更多守密人跨过语言这道门，读懂《忘却前夜》的故事，感受其中的细节与情感。

## 表情评论

评论按钮将直接显示评论数，方便看到哪里有讨论；评论里也将支持发送相位对弈表情。我们希望借助表情跨越语言的特性，帮助大家更好地交流。

顺便也向大家报告一下其他语言的进展：韩语的人工本地化有望推进到 70%，其他语言在志愿者的帮助下逐步推进，作为兜底的 AI 翻译技术也在改进、提高正确率。大家应该能感觉到参数和代码错误显示的情况少了，但新旧术语不统一、内容显示成错误语言的问题仍然存在。语言体验还有很多工作要做，我们会继续努力。再次谢谢一直在语言方面帮助我们的志愿者和守密人。

今天是一个小改动日，不论你用哪种语言，我们都准备了 1000 银芯<:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662> <:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662> <:ICON_Silver:1561693456274030662> 。祝各位守密人周末愉快！

音乐专辑、CG、相位对弈唤醒体界面，这些地方都有评论按钮！看来我们把这个功能做得太隐蔽了？文字评论一直都可以发，表情只是多一个选择。
It's on the music albums, the CGs, and the Traphase Awakener screens, they all have a comment button! Looks like we made this feature a little too well hidden? Text comments have always been there; emotes are just an extra option.

挑战开始的时候，我们确实没有细致的规划，只有一些粗糙的想法。即便是现在，手上也只有 2–3 天的准备，而且随时会因为社区的讨论或内部的讨论而变化。不过可以肯定的是：大家最关心的强化，会是最后一周的内容。

另外请注意：唤醒体自带的造物都无法触发套装效果。造物套装属于星辰篇规则，而唤醒体的能力应该是跨篇章通用的。

When the challenge started, we honestly didn't have a detailed plan, just some rough ideas. Even now, we're only about 2 to 3 days ahead, and that can change at any time because of discussions in the community or inside the team. What I can say for sure is that the buffs everyone cares about most will be the content of the final week.

Also, please note that Relics granted by an Awakener can't trigger set effects. Relic sets are an Astral Reign rule, while an Awakener's abilities should work across all arcs.

messages.content:
1. 套装效果是按每个系列造物的共性来设计的，所以暂时不会单独做护盾、回血套。不过原初、血祭这类提供资源的套装，本身也在间接提高生存能力。

2. 帖子里的数值统一按 60 级写，是为了方便横向比较，所以绝对值看起来小。30 点力量到后期会随等级涨上去，和 10% 最终伤害不是同一量级的比较。各套装之间的强弱我们会盯着，确实弱了就调。

3. 免费刷新和更多刷新次数，我们更倾向于做成某些场景下的额外奖励，比如特定事件或精英结算，而不是写进基础规则。基础规则一旦放宽，每一局就会越来越像；留在局内奖励里，每一局才有变化。

4. 命轮和唤醒体一起，都在最后一周。

5. 考虑过把溢出的中毒转成别的收益，但要么强得过分，要么数值上很难维护。上限的意义，正是让大家在上毒能力、触发条件和生存之间做取舍，而不是把溢出的部分再变成一层收益。

1. Set effects are designed around what the Relics in each series have in common, so we won't be adding a dedicated Shield or healing set for now. That said, resource sets like Origin and Blood Sacrifice already improve survivability indirectly.

2. All the numbers in the post are written at Keeper level 60 so they can be compared side by side, which is why the absolute values look small. 30 Strength scales up with level in the late game, so it isn't on the same scale as 10% Final DMG. We'll keep an eye on the balance between sets, and adjust any that turn out too weak.

3. Free rerolls and more refreshes are something we'd rather offer as extra rewards in specific situations, such as certain events or elite clears, than write into the base rules. Once the base rules loosen, every run starts to feel the same; keeping it as an in-run reward is what keeps runs varied.

4. Wheels of Destiny come together with the Awakeners, in the final week.

5. We've considered turning overflow Poison into something else, but it ends up either far too strong or very hard to maintain numerically. The point of the cap is precisely to make you weigh Poison application, trigger conditions, and survivability against each other, rather than turning the overflow into yet another bonus.

不做聊天功能，背后有几层考虑。

第一是本帖提到的语言。

第二是维护人手。其实相关的界面我们早就做过，但我们预料到它一定会被广告和垃圾信息充斥，需要持续的人力管理，就像很多 MMO 或任何带聊天功能的游戏一样。团队虽然比两年前多了人手，但每一份需要持续投入的功能，我们仍然要很小心；一个功能一旦需要长期投入，在我们的优先级评估里就会大大降低。我们宁愿把这部分交给 Discord 这样的平台。

第三是交流秩序。我最不愿意看到的事情之一，就是守密人之间在游戏里发生冲突。我希望游戏内的体验更沉浸在世界里；即便有社交，也希望大家留下的回忆是共鸣，是有来自不同世界线的守密人与自己同行。

至于好友之间的合作模式，我们一直在找机会！产能比以前有改善，但还不够。

There are several reasons we haven't built chat.

The first is language, as mentioned in today's post.

The second is maintenance. We actually built the interface for it a long time ago, but we knew it would inevitably fill up with ads and spam that need constant moderation, as in most MMOs and any game with a chat feature. Our team is bigger than it was two years ago, but we still have to be very careful with anything that needs ongoing investment; once a feature requires sustained effort, its priority drops a lot in our evaluation. We'd rather lean on platforms like Discord for this.

The third is keeping communication friendly. One of the things I least want to see is Keepers coming into conflict with each other inside the game. I'd like the in-game experience to stay immersed in the world; and if there is social interaction, I'd like the memories you take from it to be ones of resonance, of Keepers from different worldlines walking alongside you.

As for a co-op mode between friends, we've been looking for the chance to do it! Our capacity is better than it used to be, but still not enough.

messages.content:
我理解大家想要什么：一个功能最好就是纯资源、纯进攻或纯防御。这种极致能把战术意图发挥到最大，随心所欲地组合效果。

但有时候，如何把不同的效果拼在一起，本身就是游玩。就像七巧板，乐趣正来自那些不规整、不统一的形状。所以猩红熔炉的第二选项，我们不打算加：它会把一个需要权衡的决定，变成一个按钮。

不过，把某些角色的重要能力绑在这里，确实是一个带有预设倾向的情景。即便没有这次繁育·血肉界域的强化，这也是我们有意的设计，不会调整。谢谢你的意见，我们会在未来的设计中更多地考虑这一点。

I understand what everyone wants: ideally, each function would be purely resource, purely offense, or purely defense. Taking that to the extreme lets you express tactical intent to the fullest and combine effects however you like.

But sometimes, figuring out how to fit different effects together is the play itself. Like a tangram, the fun comes precisely from the pieces that aren't neat or uniform. So we won't be adding a secondary option to Crimson Furnace: it would turn a decision you have to weigh into a button you simply press.

That said, tying some Awakeners' key abilities to this one button does create a situation with a built-in bias. Even without this round of Propagation: Caro buffs, that's intentional on our part and won't change. Thank you for the feedback; we'll keep it more in mind in future designs.

1. 你的担心正好和另一些守密人的担心相反，这就是「平衡」难做的具体体现。正式更新前，许多效果还会经过更多测试和平衡工作，具体数值都可能调整，有的会提高，有的会下降。我们会尽力让它们落在合适的位置。

2. 融灾黑潮独立编队页的建议，我们记下了。

1. Your concern is the exact opposite of what some other Keepers are worried about, which shows precisely why "balance" is hard. Before the official update, many of these effects will go through more testing and balancing, and the specific numbers may change, some up, some down. We'll do our best to land them in the right place.

2. The separate D-Tide lineup page is noted.

1. 后面还有一些小版本。
2. 同上，超维我们没忘。
3. 是为了在新的制约下设计更多、更有趣的内容，有时候带着镣铐才能跳得更出彩。经典界域中许多战术策略性已经随着环境变化失效，而我们无法回头修改它。
4. 神圣界域的数值并不是为了「更强」，而是补偿新界域失去的灵活度。最终我们会看经典界域和神圣界域的实际表现来做平衡，希望两边都能适应环境。

1. There are still a few smaller versions to come.
2. Same as above, and Ultra hasn't been forgotten.
3. It's so we can design more and more interesting content under new constraints; sometimes you dance better in chains. Much of the tactical depth in the Classic Realms has been lost as the environment changed, and we can't go back and rewrite it.
4. The Divine Realm numbers aren't there to make them stronger; they compensate for the flexibility the new Realms gave up. In the end we'll balance Classic and Divine Realms based on how they actually perform, and we hope both can thrive in the environment.

今天就先到这里！感谢大家的反馈与讨论，周末愉快，我们下次见！
That's all for today! Thank you for all the feedback and discussion. Have a great weekend, and see you next time!

posts.title: Day 16: Relic Sets
posts.titleTr: 第 16 天：遗物套装

op.content:
In Astral Reign, Dimensional Image Relics were a new experiment in exploration rewards: a low chance for an Awakener to pick up extra, powerful, tailor-made abilities. The experiment received a lot of positive feedback.

But as we kept going, we also ran into its contradiction: past a certain point, that random surprise turns into part of a character's kit that has to be carefully balanced. Many of you said the same in your feedback. So we're trying a different direction, and that's today's improvement:

## Relic Set Effects

- Collect **3 Relics** from the same group to gain that group's set effect; collect **6 or more** and the set effect is upgraded.
- Each **Gold Relic counts as 2 pieces**.
- Cursed Relics also count toward their group.
- Values below are at Keeper level 60 and scale with level.
op.tr:

messages.content:
# 第十六天：造物套装

在星辰篇中，我们尝试加入了一种全新的探索奖励：维度影像造物。我们希望它们成为探索途中的偶遇惊喜，让唤醒体有机会获得额外、强大的定制能力。这个尝试收到了不少积极的反馈。

但随着探索逐渐深入，我们也发现了其中的矛盾：当这份额外能力的影响超出合适的范围，原本偶然获得的惊喜，就容易变成大家期待角色完整发挥时必须具备的一部分。大家的许多反馈，也让我们看到了这个问题。

因此，我们希望从另一个方向继续尝试，为探索中的收集与选择带来新的价值。这就是今天要介绍的改进：造物套装效果！

## 套装如何生效？

- 在星辰篇中，集齐同一分组的 **3 件**造物，即可获得该分组的专属套装效果；集齐 **6 件或以上**，套装效果还会升级。
- 每件**黄金造物按 2 件**计入对应套组的收集进度。
- 当前套装效果如下，数值以 60 级为标准。

### 原初

- 3 件套：手牌上限 +1，回合开始时有 33% 概率将 1 张「灵感」置入手中。
- 6 件套：手牌上限 +3，回合开始时将 1 张「灵感」置入手中。

### 主宰

- 3 件套：伤害强效 +20%。
- 6 件套：伤害强效 +60%。

### 潜能

- 3 件套：每场战斗首次使用银钥觉醒后，将 1 张「银钥曦光」置入手中。
- 6 件套：每场战斗前 3 次使用银钥觉醒后，各将 1 张「银钥曦光」置入手中。

### 统御

- 3 件套：每场战斗首次「灵知觉醒」，使对应唤醒体本回合下一次狂气爆发获得晋升。
- 6 件套：每场战斗前 3 次「灵知觉醒」，使对应唤醒体本回合下一次狂气爆发获得晋升。

### 处决

- 3 件套：回合开始时获得 20 点力量。
- 6 件套：回合开始时获得 60 点力量。

### 腐蚀

- 3 件套：所有唤醒体和造物造成的固定中毒提高 10%，并能够施加相当于所造成主动伤害和固定伤害 2% 的中毒。
- 6 件套：所有唤醒体和造物造成的固定中毒提高 30%，并能够施加相当于所造成主动伤害和固定伤害 6% 的中毒。

### 洞察

- 3 件套：所有唤醒体和造物造成的固定反击提高 10%，并能够获得相当于所造成主动伤害和固定伤害 1% 的反击。
- 6 件套：所有唤醒体和造物造成的固定反击提高 30%，并能够获得相当于所造成主动伤害和固定伤害 3% 的反击。

### 凋亡

- 3 件套：所有唤醒体造成的最终伤害提高 10%。
- 6 件套：所有唤醒体造成的最终伤害提高 30%。

### 血祭

- 3 件套：回合开始后，使狂气最低的唤醒体获得 15 点狂气。
- 6 件套：回合开始后，使狂气最低的唤醒体获得 50 点狂气。

### 无明

- 3 件套：每回合首次钥令强度提高 30%。
- 6 件套：每回合首次钥令强度提高 100%。

### 深海

- 3 件套：所有唤醒体造成的触腕伤害提高 10%，回合开始时获得 2 层触腕集结。
- 6 件套：所有唤醒体造成的触腕伤害提高 30%，回合开始时获得 6 层触腕集结。

### 血肉

- 3 件套：每回合首次触发「吞噬」时，返还 15% 胚胎融合。
- 6 件套：每回合首次触发「吞噬」时，返还 50% 胚胎融合。

### 超维

- 3 件套：进入超维回合后，下 1 张指令卡额外生效 1 次。
- 6 件套：进入超维回合后，下 3 张指令卡各额外生效 1 次。

### 漫溢、汇流、交融

以下效果分别对应这三个套组：

- 3 件套：界域精通 +150。
- 6 件套：界域精通 +500。

## 最后

我们希望，造物套装能够为星辰篇的战斗带来新的助力，也让大家在收集黑印、购买和升级造物时，多一层值得考虑的选择：除了眼前这件造物的效果，它还能否帮助你凑成一套适合当前队伍的组合？

> 以上为计划中的调整，具体实装内容请以版本公告为准。

打击确实还没有自己的专向套装，这一批 16 组还没覆盖到每个细分玩法。整体思路是：任何套装任何流派都能显著获益，打击队也一样，只是不一定是最优搭配。

凑套难度上，我们的设计预期是 3 件套比较容易在一局里成型，6 件套可能好几局才凑齐一次。

第一次加这类机制，我们宁可保守一点，别把整个游戏的平衡破坏掉。如果合适，我们会在未来继续改进效果或者收集难度。

Strike doesn't have its own dedicated set yet. These first 16 groups don't cover every specific playstyle. The overall idea is that the general sets give a significant benefit to any playstyle, Strike teams included, even if they aren't always the optimal fit.

On how hard sets are to complete: our design expectation is that a 3-piece is fairly easy to form within a single run, while a 6-piece may take several runs to complete once.

Since this is the first time we're adding a mechanic like this, we'd rather be conservative than risk breaking the overall balance of the game. If it makes sense, we'll keep improving the effects or the collection difficulty in the future.
messages.prev:
On day 14 you answered in detail about gaze mechanic. I'm glad it conveyed devs thought on the design.
but continuing from our discussion, I still have several questions.

1. " Caps are mainly there to keep the rewards of continued scaling from becoming excessive in certain situations or modes. They don’t mean an Awakener has to reach the cap to be effective."

Usually in such game, chasing caps to reach a character's full potential is the norm. Although it feels quite bad that I can't reach the full potential but I do understand the choice now. However, usually these kind of caps are realized by "soft caps", which comes from level designs and other invisible restrictions. This "hard cap" directly applying to a character really does making player feels "crippled". Can we have a better solutions to this?

2. "Gaze is not intended to restrict every slow-building strategy. It is meant to put a limit on approaches where victory involves almost no risk and only requires more time."  "From our design perspective, scaling mechanics and Gaze are therefore not usually in conflict, because those abilities are designed within this combat framework from the outset."

I agree with what you said, but I think there's more nuance to it. "Interesting gameplay" is player, or rather, humans nature will intuitively pursue.
Gating "boring plays" purposefully, will cause collateral damage on some interesting ideas.

As matter of fact, a few D-waves back, people already came up a cheese team that got gazed 100 times, just to get player's max HP to 1, and then one shot every enemy using Salvador.

You can say this is clever and interesting, which is to say gaze only adds annoyance to this play.
You can also say this is boring, just wait and pop death resistance, then you can one shot everything, which is to say gaze did nothing to stop this kind of behaviors.

Imo gaze mechanic hurt all sides. What do you think?

6. To avoid another round of patching one thing and then patching the patch, we need more time to prepare these changes, since they're meant to stay fixed rather than shift with each chapter update. So they may come last.

融灾禁区的不同地图，本来就是按不同的长短来塑造的：有些落地战就能见效、有优势，有些则要在长线里才体现。套装造物确实在更长的地图里体验影响更显著，这项修改正是专注于解决探索路径上的决策。

另外，融灾禁区的初始黄金造物按 2 件计入套装，这是一个可以被利用的机会。

至于造物平衡的差异，这次所有修改加在一起应该已经改善了一部分，未来我们也会继续追踪。

The different maps in the D-Effect Zone are deliberately shaped for different lengths: some reward you right from the opening fight, while others only pay off over a longer run. Relic sets do have a more noticeable impact on the longer maps, and that's exactly what this change is focused on: the decisions you make along your exploration path.

Also, the starting Gold Relic in the D-Effect Zone counts as 2 pieces toward a set, that's an opportunity worth taking advantage of.

As for the balance gaps between Relics, all of this round's changes taken together should have already closed part of that gap, and we'll keep tracking it going forward.

messages.content:
1. 内部测试的回放和数据不会公开：它们在工作室内网，而且常常包含未上线内容。另外说明一下，我们做设计决定并不是只听一面之词，回放和每项数据构成都会一起看。至于为什么不花时间在正式服上给大家证明：早几年我做过类似的证明，意义并不大。我知道信任很难建立，但我们会靠持续的沟通和对游戏切实的改良去建立它，而不是对每一次疑问逐条证明、逐条反驳。

2. 敌人血量会随等级涨，这点不会变。但等级本身目前没有计划继续涨。未来的涨幅会比星辰篇慢得多，到第三篇尾声甚至会控制在相近的水准。我对这个趋势有信心，因为这段时间我们解决了越来越多的历史问题，内部的方法、标准和工具也越来越完善。

3. 唤醒体等级上限，目前没有计划。我们不会为了加数值而加数值，通常只有为了解决某些问题才会这么做。

4. 侵蚀最初的目的，是在强乘区效应下让每个回合都有动力去做攻防交互。但有些设计确实偏离了：让大量侵蚀在单个回合内反复利用、叠加，变成了一种更大倍率的易伤。以后我们不会再用这种方式提供侵蚀。百分比伤害是另一件我们没做好的事，我们会尽力避免再推出，并考虑怎样让已有的更平衡。

5. 你对三个篇章问题的理解很准确。篇章机制就是让我们在复杂的游戏环境里探索新乐趣，同时保证游戏能持续改善的办法。这是我们的下一个大课题。

感谢你的意见，我们会尽力做到最好。

messages.content:
1. Internal test replays and data won't be made public: they live on the studio's internal network and often contain unreleased content. For the record, our design decisions aren't based on one side's word; we review the replays and every piece of the data together. As for why we don't spend time proving it on the live server: I did that kind of proof years ago, and it didn't achieve much. I know trust is hard to build, but we'll build it through continued communication and real improvements to the game, not by proving and rebutting every single doubt one by one.

2. Enemy HP follows level; that won't change. But there are currently no plans to keep raising levels themselves, and whatever growth does come will be much slower than in Astral Reign, possibly held at a similar level by the end of Arc 3. I'm confident in that trend, because over this time we've been solving more and more legacy problems, and our internal methods, standards and tools keep improving.

3. No plans for raising the Awakener level cap at the moment. We don't add numbers for the sake of adding numbers; usually we only do it to solve a specific problem.

4. Corrosion was originally meant to give you a reason to engage in attack-and-defense interaction every turn under strong multiplicative scaling. Some designs did drift from that: letting large amounts of Corrosion be reused and stacked within a single turn turned it into a bigger Vulnerable multiplier. We won't provide Corrosion that way again. Percentage-based damage is another thing we didn't do well; we'll do our best not to introduce more of it, and we'll think about how to balance what already exists.

5. Your read on the problems of the three arcs is accurate. The arc system is how we explore new kinds of fun in a complex game environment while keeping the game sustainable and improvable. That's our next big topic.

Thank you for your feedback. We'll do our best.

2.敌方生命值随等级变化；这不会改变。但目前还没有计划继续提高自己的水平，无论增长如何，都将比《星界王朝》慢得多，到《Arc 3》结束时可能会保持在类似的水平。我对这种趋势充满信心，因为在这段时间里，我们一直在解决越来越多的遗留问题，并且我们的内部方法、标准和工具不断改进。

戒备目前确实没有继续扩展的打算。它在我们的游戏里是一个比较容易失控的属性：不同队伍获得护盾的次数差异太大了。如果找到了能合理控制平衡的办法，我们会考虑。

拉蒙娜的最后一个启灵，我们是有意把它放在很远的地方的。它不是一道要尽快跨过的门槛，而是一段路：你走了多久，她就陪了多久。所以这一处我们不会改。

We currently have no plans to expand Alert further. In our game it's a stat that gets out of control fairly easily: the number of times different teams can gain Shield varies far too much. If we find a way to keep that properly balanced, we'll consider it.

Ramona's final Enlighten was deliberately placed far down the road. It isn't a threshold to clear as fast as possible; it's a distance. However long you've walked, that's how long she has walked beside you. So this is one thing we won't change.

1. Thank you for understanding. Normally a soft cap is indeed enough, but some extreme cases can still go far beyond what we expect. In the Faded Legacy D-Tide, for example, we once introduced a mechanic that sharply reduced Counter and Poison based on damage already dealt, as a way to balance it, but we know how bad that felt. The mix of soft and hard limits in Astral Reign is our attempt to control the total amount of stacking instead. For now, each approach has its pros and cons. We'll most likely change the method in the future, but within Astral Reign, we've chosen to adjust the numbers.

2. This is an awkward case, I admit. If certain extreme teams have enough tools to deal with Symptoms, Gaze is no longer a threat to them. It's like a defensive net: there will always be gaps. But we still don't think a whole rule should be removed because of individual cases like this. Going forward, we'll look at how to do this better.

posts.title: Day 15: Relic Buffs and New Relics
posts.titleTr: 第 15 天：遗物爱好者和新遗物

op.content:
Over the past two weeks, some Keepers told us that the rewards found during exploration haven't kept up with the game: Strength falls off late, and Poison and Counter are in an even tougher spot. Today's changes address that feedback, and bring 21 brand-new mixed-Realm Relics!

## Strength and Tentacle DMG

In Faded Legacy, Strength was the most basic damage bonus and once overshadowed DMG Amplification. In Astral Reign, we pushed the balance too far toward DMG Amplification and Base DMG. Today we bring Strength Relics back so they can shine again. Tentacle DMG is in a similar position, so we're adjusting it as well.

- Filigree Agate: Strength +17%
- Iron Lock, Silent Prelude: Strength +20%
- Tiny Music Box: Strength +29%; temporary Strength triggers halved, but each trigger grants double temporary Strength
- Highest Honor: temporary Strength +36%
- Our Home, Crimson Brooch: Strength +40%
- Swarm Mind: Strength +100%
- Omen Ritual Bird: Strength +100%
- Lemurian Delight: Tentacle activation DMG multiplier 100% → 150%
- Yellow Snail: Tentacle activation DMG multiplier 50% → 100%
- Sparganum: Tentacle DMG +30%
- Sacred Agony: when losing a Tentacle, additionally gain 80 temporary Tentacle DMG
op.tr:
在过去的两周里，一些守护者告诉我们，在探索过程中发现的奖励并没有跟上游戏的步伐：力量后期下降，而毒药和反击的处境更加艰​​难。今天的更改解决了这一反馈，并带来 21 件全新的混合领域遗物！

## 力量和触手DMG

在《褪色的遗产》中，力量是最基本的伤害加成，一度盖过了伤害增幅。在《Astral Reign》中，我们将 DMG 增幅和基础 DMG 的平衡推得太远了。今天，我们将力量遗物带回来，让它们再次闪耀。触手DMG处于类似的位置，所以我们也在调整它。

- 花丝玛瑙：强度+17%
- 铁锁、无声前奏：力量+20%
- 小音乐盒：力量+29%；临时力量触发减半，但每次触发都会赋予双倍临时力量
- 最高荣誉：暂时力量+36%
- 我们的家，深红胸针：力量+40%
- 群体意识：力量+100%
- 预兆仪式鸟：力量+100%
- 利穆里亚喜悦：触手激活伤害倍数100% → 150%
- 黄蜗牛：触手激活伤害倍数50%→100%
- 三棱：触手伤害+30%
- 神圣痛苦：失去触手时，额外获得80点临时触手伤害

messages.content:
## Poison and Counter

We strengthened Archive Mark on Day 3 and raised the stack caps for Poison and Counter on Day 10. But we also know you need more ways to gain Poison and Counter in the first place:

- Other Tongue: Poison conversion from Strikes 10% / 20% → 15% / 30%
- Prophet's Lamp: Poison and Counter gained +100%
- Deceased's Chrono: temporary Counter gained +43%
- Occult Research: above Keeper level 60, each level now provides more Occult Research. Using Neurotoxin's Poison as an example: level 70 is 21% higher than before, level 80 is 69% higher, level 90 is 137% higher, and level 100 is 234% higher.

## Realm Relics

Of course, we know what you really want isn't just reasonable numbers, but new choices. So we're introducing 21 brand-new mixed-Realm Relics! The two values in each effect are for Silver and Gold quality respectively.
messages.tr:
## 毒药与反击

我们在第 3 天加强了档案标记，并在第 10 天提高了毒药和克制的堆栈上限。但我们也知道您首先需要更多方法来获得毒药和克制：

- 其他舌头：攻击毒力转化 10% / 20% → 15% / 30%
- 先知之灯：毒药和克制物获得+100%
- 死者的时空：临时计数器获得+43%
- 神秘学研究：守护者等级60以上，每个级别现在提供更多的神秘学研究。以神经毒素的毒为例：70级比之前提升21%，80级提升69%，90级提升137%，100级提升234%。

## 领域遗物

当然，我们知道您真正想要的不仅仅是合理的数字，而是新的选择。因此，我们将推出 21 件全新的混合领域遗物！每个效果中的两个值分别针对银品质和金品质。

messages.content:
### "Overflow" series (<:aequor_caro:1437285487323644014> Aequor × Caro)

- **Candle Tears**: After each Tentacle attack, Embryo Fusion +2/4, up to 20 times per turn. Raging Waves charge: Embryo Fusion gained from this effect is doubled this turn.
- **Spyglass**: When generating an Embryo, for every 100 Embryo Fusion consumed, Tentacle DMG +10/20, up to 6 times per turn.
- **Portable Faith**: After an Aequor Awakener grants Shield or healing, Caro Awakeners' base Shield and healing this turn are increased by 5/10%, stacking up to 25/50%.
- **Bloody Glory**: After using an Embryo directly on an Aequor Awakener, they gain 30/60 Aliemus and 30/60 stacks of Crimson Frenzy. 3-turn cooldown.
- **Folded Route**: Crimson Furnace charge: for every 1% of Max HP consumed from Crimson Furnace, Tentacle DMG this turn +2/4%, stacking with Raging Waves.
- **Sunken Device**: At turn start, for each Permanent Tentacle, all Awakeners gain 3/6 stacks of Crimson Frenzy, up to 30/60 stacks.
- **Sinful Smelting** (Cursed Relic): Max HP +20%, Tentacle Limit +2. At turn start, gain Crimson Furnace equal to 5% of lost HP and generate 1 Tentacle. Arithmetica cap and cards drawn at turn start -1.
messages.tr:
###“溢出”系列（<:aequor_caro:1437285487323644014>Aequor×卡罗）

- **蜡烛之泪**：每次触手攻击后，胚胎融合+2/4，每回合最多20次。狂怒波冲锋：本回合由此效果获得的胚胎融合力翻倍。
- **望远镜**：生成胚胎时，每消耗100个胚胎融合，触手伤害+10/20，每回合最多6次。
- **便携式信仰**：在Aequor觉醒者授予护盾或治疗效果后，卡罗觉醒者本回合的基础护盾和治疗效果提高5/10%，最多叠加25/50%。
- **血腥荣耀**：直接在 Aequor 觉醒者上使用胚胎后，他们获得 30/60 Aliemus 和 30/60 层猩红狂热。 3回合冷却时间。
- **折叠路线**：赤红熔炉充能：赤红熔炉每消耗最大生命值1%，本回合触手伤害+2/4%，与狂暴波叠加。
- **沉没装置**：回合开始时，对于每个永久触手，所有觉醒者都会获得 3/6 层猩红狂热，最多 30/60 层。
- **罪恶熔炼**（诅咒遗物）：最大生命值+20%，触手限制+2。回合开始时，获得相当于损失生命值5%的赤红熔炉，并生成1条触手。算术上限和回合开始时抽出的牌 -1。

### "Confluence" series (<:aequor_ultra:1437285493749452890> Aequor × Ultra)

- **Effective Vision**: Each time a Tentacle attacks, gain 1 stack of Vision, up to 100. At the start of an Ultra Round, consume all Vision; for every 2 stacks consumed (Gold: 1), Command Cards moved from Ultra Space to your hand gain 1 additional stack of Singularity Beacon.
- **History of Change**: Annihilation charge: Tentacle DMG +60/120.
- **Cabin Chronometer**: After the first 3 Ultra Awakener Command Cards played each turn, all Aequor Awakener Command Cards in hand gain 3/6 stacks of Singularity Beacon; if Dimension Shuttle was triggered, the Beacon gained is doubled.
- **Triumphant Voice**: When triggering Dimension Shuttle, gain 3/6 stacks of Tentacle Gathering, and the card placed in Ultra Space gains "Gain 3/6 stacks of Tentacle Gathering."
- **Kindly Mineral**: Each time a Permanent Tentacle is generated or Tentacle Overflow triggers, gain 3/6 stacks of temporary Singularity Prism, up to 3 times per turn.
- **Hyperdimensional Spectrum**: After an Aequor Awakener deals Active DMG, Ultra Awakeners' Final DMG this turn +5/10%, stacking up to 10 times.
- **Weathervane** (Cursed Relic): Tentacle Limit -1, Ultra Space slots +1. At turn start, gain 10 stacks of temporary Singularity Prism and Tentacle DMG +28; after entering an Ultra Round, trigger the above turn-start effect once more.

- **有效视野**：触手每次攻击时，获得1层视野，最多100层。超级回合开始时，消耗所有视野；每消耗 2 层（金：1），从超空间移至手上的命令卡将额外获得 1 层奇点信标。
- **变更历史**：歼灭冲锋：触手 DMG +60/120。
- **客舱计时器**：每回合打出前 3 张超级觉醒者命令卡后，手上所有 Aequor 觉醒者命令卡获得 3/6 层奇点信标；如果触发次元穿梭，获得的信标就会翻倍。
- **凯旋之声**：触发次元穿梭时，获得3/6层触手聚集，放置在超空间的卡牌获得“获得3/6层触手聚集”。
- **仁慈矿物**：每次生成永久触手或触发触手溢出时，获得 3/6 层临时奇点棱镜，每回合最多 3 次。
- **超维光谱**：水族觉醒者造成主动伤害后，本回合终极觉醒者最终伤害+5/10%，最多叠加10次。
- **风向标**（被诅咒的遗物）：触手限制-1，超级空间插槽+1。 At turn start, gain 10 stacks of temporary Singularity Prism and Tentacle DMG +28;进入超级回合后，再次触发上述回合开始效果。

messages.content:
### "Fusion" series (<:ultra_caro:1437287847114706974> Caro × Ultra)

- **Bird-Eating Spider**: After a Caro Awakener uses an Exalt, Ultra Awakeners gain 10/20 stacks of Crimson Frenzy; doubled if that Exalt triggered Devour.
- **Blooming Hour**: After consuming an Embryo, the target Awakener gains 6/12 stacks of temporary Singularity Prism; repeated triggers do not stack.
- **Crossed Shears**: After a Command Card enters Ultra Space, the Awakener it belongs to gains 25/50 stacks of Crimson Frenzy.
- **Causality**: After an Ultra Awakener's Command Card triggers Dimension Shuttle, the next Caro Awakener Command Card played this turn takes effect 1/2 additional times. 3-turn cooldown.
- **Thought Shuttle**: Crimson Furnace charge: remove the leftmost card in Ultra Space, make the next Command Card trigger Dimension Shuttle, and grant it and its temporary copies 25/50 stacks of Singularity Beacon.
- **Old Friend**: At turn start, Embryo Fusion +15/30. After entering an Ultra Round, each Embryo consumed this turn grants 1 Embryo / Scion of Purity with Fleeting, up to 3 times per turn.
- **Lady Ian** (Cursed Relic): Crimson Furnace charge: randomly select 1 Command Card from each Awakener's cards in Ultra Space and gain a Basic Copy of each, but shuffle 1 Symptom Card into your draw pile. Annihilation charge: recover HP equal to 50% of your Crimson Furnace, but shuffle 1 Symptom Card into your discard pile.

###“融合”系列（<:ultra_caro:1437287847114706974>卡罗×Ultra）

- **食鸟蜘蛛**：卡罗觉醒者使用尊崇后，超级觉醒者获得 10/20 层猩红狂热；如果该崇拜触发了吞噬，则翻倍。

### Chaos Bonus <:realm_chaos:1437283650809888768>

Chaos has no series of its own, and it doesn't affect the appearance of other Realms' Relics. When your team includes a Chaos Awakener, the chance of Dimensional Image Relics appearing for all Awakeners is doubled!

# Day 15: Relic Buffs and New Relics
messages.tr: # 第 15 天：圣物增益和新圣物

messages.content: # 第 15 天：造物强化与上新

这两周的讨论中，有一些守密人告诉我们，探索过程中的奖励有些跟不上时代：力量在后期表现不佳，中毒、反击的情况更为严峻。今天我们就针对这些反馈做出如下改进，并带来 21 枚全新的界域混编造物！

## 力量与触腕伤害

力量在忘却篇曾是最基础的伤害增益，一度盖过伤害强效。但在星辰篇，我们把天平往伤害强效与基础伤害那边推得过头了。今天把力量造物调回来，让它们重新发光发热！深海的触腕伤害处境与力量类似，所以也一并修正。

- 缠丝玛瑙：力量 +17%
- 重锁、寂静序曲：力量 +20%
- 小八音盒：力量 +29%；临时力量触发次数减半，但每次获得的临时力量翻倍
- 无上荣宠：临时力量 +36%
- 我们的家、红宝石胸针：力量 +40%
- 虫群意识：力量 +100%
- 厄运仪式鸟：力量 +100%
- 螺湮的欢愉：激发的触腕伤害倍率 100% → 150%
- 小黄螺：激发的触腕伤害倍率 50% → 100%
- 裂头蚴：触腕伤害 +30%
- 苦痛圣腕：失去触腕时额外获得 80 点临时触腕伤害

## 中毒与反击

我们在第 3 天强化了归档刻痕，第 10 天提高了中毒与反击的堆叠上限。但我们知道，还需要帮助大家获得更多的中毒与反击：

- 异种喉舌：打击的中毒转化 10% / 20% → 15% / 30%
- 先知的许愿灯：获得的中毒和反击 +100%
- 故人的怀表：获得的临时反击 +43%
- 灵识研究深度：守密人 60 级之后，每级提供的灵识研究深度更多。以神经毒素提供的中毒为例：70 级比调整前提高 21%，80 级提高 69%，90 级提高 137%，100 级提高 234%。

## 界域专属造物

当然，我们深深知道，大家真正希望的不只是合理的数值，而是全新的选择。我们为此带来了 21 枚全新的界域混编造物！效果中的两个数值分别对应白银与黄金品质。

### 「漫溢」系列（<:aequor_caro:1437285487323644014> 深海 × 血肉）

- **烛泪**：每次触腕攻击后，胚胎融合 +2/4，每回合最多触发 20 次。怒涛充能：该效果本回合获得的胚胎融合翻倍。
- **望远设备**：生成胚胎时，每消耗 100 点胚胎融合，触腕伤害 +10/20，每回合最多触发 6 次。
- **便携式信仰**：深海唤醒体造成护盾或生命回复后，血肉唤醒体本回合造成的护盾和生命回复基础效果提高 5/10%，最多叠加至 25/50%。
- **血腥荣耀**：对深海唤醒体直接使用胚胎后，使其获得 30/60 狂气和 30/60 层猩红狂热，3 回合冷却。
- **航线折叠**：猩红熔炉充能：每消耗等同于 1% 最大生命的猩红熔炉，本回合触腕伤害提高 2/4%，与怒涛的效果叠加。
- **沉没装置**：回合开始时，每有 1 条永久触腕，所有唤醒体获得 3/6 层猩红狂热，最多提供 30/60 层。
- **罪恶熔炼**（诅咒造物）：生命上限 +20%，触腕上限 +2。回合开始时获得等同于已损失生命 5% 的猩红熔炉，并生成 1 条触腕。算力上限和回合开始抽牌数 -1。

### 「汇流」系列（<:aequor_ultra:1437285493749452890> 深海 × 超维）

- **有效视野**：每当 1 条触腕攻击时，积攒 1 层视野，至多 100 层。超维回合开始时消耗所有视野，每消耗 2 层（黄金：1 层），使超维空间置入手中的指令卡额外获得 1 层奇点信标。
- **变迁史**：湮灭充能：触腕伤害 +60/120。
- **机舱车钟**：每回合前 3 次打出超维唤醒体的指令卡后，为手牌中所有深海唤醒体的指令卡添加 3/6 层奇点信标；若触发了维度穿梭，获得的奇点信标翻倍。
- **高奏之声**：触发「维度穿梭」时，获得 3/6 层触腕集结，并为置入超维空间的卡牌赋予「获得 3/6 层触腕集结」的效果。
- **善良的矿物**：每生成 1 条永久触腕或触发 1 次触腕满溢，获得 3/6 层临时奇点棱镜，每回合最多触发 3 次。
- **高维频谱**：深海唤醒体造成主动伤害后，超维唤醒体本回合最终伤害提高 5/10%，最多叠加 10 次。
- **风向标**（诅咒造物）：触腕上限 -1，超维空间栏位 +1。回合开始时获得 10 层临时奇点棱镜，触腕伤害 +28；进入超维回合后，额外触发 1 次上述回合开始效果。

### 「交融」系列（<:ultra_caro:1437287847114706974> 血肉 × 超维）

- **捕鸟蛛**：血肉唤醒体释放狂气爆发后，超维唤醒体获得 10/20 层猩红狂热；若本次狂气爆发触发了吞噬，效果翻倍。
- **绽放时间**：消耗胚胎后，目标唤醒体获得 6/12 层临时奇点棱镜，重复触发无法叠加。
- **交错剪**：指令卡进入超维空间后，使该卡牌归属的唤醒体获得 25/50 层猩红狂热。
- **因果关系**：超维唤醒体的指令卡触发维度穿梭后，本回合下 1 张血肉唤醒体打出的指令卡额外生效 1/2 次，3 回合冷却。
- **思维穿梭**：猩红熔炉充能：移除超维空间最左侧的卡牌，使下一张指令卡触发「维度穿梭」，并为其和临时复制附加 25/50 层奇点信标。
- **老朋友**：回合开始时，胚胎融合 +15/30。进入超维回合后，本回合每消耗 1 个胚胎，获得 1 个附加虚无的胚胎 / 圣洁之子，每回合最多触发 3 次。
- **伊恩女士**（诅咒造物）：猩红熔炉充能：从超维空间中每名唤醒体的指令卡里各随机选择 1 张，获得其原始复制，但将 1 张症状卡洗入抽牌堆。湮灭充能：回复等同于猩红熔炉 50% 的生命，但将 1 张症状卡洗入弃牌堆。

### 混沌特别加成 <:realm_chaos:1437283650809888768>

混沌没有自己的专属系列，也不影响其他界域造物的出现。队伍中有混沌唤醒体时，所有唤醒体的维度影像造物出现概率翻倍！

## 最后

由于此前我们强化了归档刻痕奖励，收集钥令带来的物象研究深度、灵识研究深度还会进一步强化这些造物。两项改动叠加后，这些造物将重新具有竞争力，让大家在探索过程中的努力与选择更有意义。

有哪些造物你从来不拿？又有哪些造物是你的最爱？欢迎在帖子下与我分享你的体验！

> 以上为计划中的调整，具体实装内容请以版本公告为准。

messages.prev:
<@1487626955791663208>, is it possible to give Propagation Caro an alternative way of spending Realm Charges?

I believe the biggest frustration with playing PCaro comes from the realm mechanics pulling the player in several different directions. Crimson Furnace has too many functions to be tied to a single button.

Crimson Furnace currently is:
-The primary defensive panic button
-The offensive power up button (it gives Crimson Frenzy now)
-The utility cooldown for Roused PCaro units (Aliemus for Saya, draw and cost reduction for Caraboo)

The primary function of being a heal that stops the player from dying is obviously the most important one, but this is amplified even more by how heavily PCaro incentivizes staying on low HP by changing healing generation to be based on missing HP. This however makes it difficult to use Saya's and Caraboo's rouse (and Caraboo's wheel).

The player wants to save the Furnace to remain at low HP, so they can enjoy all the buffs and healing generation that comes from it, but they also want to use it whenever it's available to activate Saya's and Caraboo's bonus effects. However, using the Furnace for this purpose also consumes the heal, slowing down the embryo and healing generation. This is a very frustrating loop that leads players to feel like PCaro is the designated support realm, because using the furnace to benefit PCaro units makes the team weaker and focusing the team on units from other realms instead mitigates this issue, forcing Saya and Caraboo into idle support roles.

I would like to suggest adding a secondary option when using Crimson Furnace, that shares a cooldown with the current effect, but does not restore HP or consume stored healing. It would only activate effects that trigger when Crimson Furnace is used, like Caraboo's draw and the Crimson Frenzy, as mentioned in Day 2.
If needed, to keep it balanced, this option could also do 10% of player's current HP as damage or consume 10-20% of the stored healing.

后悔的事情？

所有的弯路和错误，都是在为当时、或更早的认知付出代价。

有时候，这份责任过于沉重，甚至超出了我们当时的能力与资源，以至于其他人都望而生畏、犹豫不前。

现实中没有环行·拉蒙娜，但每一次失败都要吸取教训，然后继续前进、不放弃，这一点不会变。

如何面对尖锐的批评？

那些声音毫无疑问会让我在意，也会影响脑缸组的其他人。

然而，真正的伤害是，如果我因此一蹶不振，那么团队，以及其他支持《忘却前夜》的守密人，该怎么办？

所以，每当想到这一点，我就没有时间沉沦在这样的情绪里。

意义并非天赐，唯此双手筑成。

而我此刻的意义，就是尽自己所能，将《忘却前夜》的故事讲到最后。

所以，无论声音多么尖锐，我都必须从中汲取对整个游戏有用的反馈，然后安抚团队，鼓舞并带领大家一起继续前进。

There's no problem that can't be solved in three swings. And if there is, then give it three more!

What do I regret?

Every wrong turn and every mistake comes at the cost of the understanding we had at the time, or the understanding we should have gained much earlier.

Sometimes, that burden is simply too heavy for the abilities and resources we have at the time. Heavy enough that others may hesitate or even shy away from taking it on.

There is no Ramona in the real world. But one thing will never change: we must learn from every failure, keep moving forward, and never give up.

How do I deal with harsh criticism?

Those voices undoubtedly get to me, and they affect the other members of the Brain Vat team, too.

But what would truly hurt us is if I let them bring me down to the point where I could no longer move forward. What would happen then to the team, and to all the Keepers who continue to support Ash Echoes?

Whenever I think about that, I realize I simply don't have the time to sink into those feelings.

Meaning isn't bestowed upon us by fate. It is built with our own hands.

And right now, my purpose is to do everything I can to tell the story of Morimens all the way to its end.

So no matter how harsh the voices may be, I must find whatever feedback can help the game as a whole, then support the team, lift everyone's spirits, and lead us forward together.

messages.content:
谢谢你的反馈！确实，在经历了忘却篇后期较为狂野的平衡环境之后，我们一开始把各种限制收得太紧了。

问题究竟出在哪里？是造物？是 R 命轮？还是唤醒体本身的资源供给能力？又或者是数值模型的算法存在问题？

当时我们刚刚经历复活，在还没有彻底想清楚这些问题之前，采取更保守的设计是比较稳妥的选择。毕竟，先收紧限制，之后再逐步放宽，相对来说更容易控制风险。

但我们也明白，这些限制确实在很大程度上影响了大家尝试不同玩法和构筑的空间。

未来，我们会继续从这些经验中吸取教训，在确保游戏平衡的同时，尽可能保留构筑的自由度与游玩的乐趣。

Thanks for your feedback! After experiencing the rather wild balance environment of the late Faded Legacy era, we initially tightened our restrictions a little too much.

Where exactly did the problem lie? Was it the Relics? The R-Roulette? The resource generation of Awakeners themselves? Or were there flaws in the algorithms behind our numerical balance model?

At the time, we had only just brought the game back to life. Until we had a clearer understanding of these issues, taking a more conservative approach felt like the safer choice. After all, it's generally easier to loosen restrictions later than to tighten them after the fact.

However, we also understand that these restrictions have significantly limited players' freedom to experiment with different playstyles and builds.

Moving forward, we'll continue learning from these experiences and strive to preserve both game balance and the freedom and fun of experimenting with different builds.

messages.content:
The probability system for Relics is actually quite simple: all eligible Relics have equal weight by default. When we say the appearance rate is doubled, it's more accurately described as doubling the weight. However, this concept can be a little too complicated to explain in detail, so we chose this simplified wording instead.

其实，我们造物的概率机制很简单：默认情况下，所有符合出现条件的造物都拥有相同的权重。所谓出现概率翻倍，更准确地说是权重翻倍。不过，这个概念解释起来有些复杂，所以我们选择了这种近似的说法。

Thank you for such detailed feedback! We do intentionally create situations where not every need can be perfectly met, as meaningful choices often come from having to make trade-offs. That said, finding the right balance between strategic trade-offs and the overall gameplay experience is something we continually need to work on. We'll keep exploring how to preserve strategic depth while making character mechanics feel more intuitive and satisfying to use.

posts.title: Day 14: Traphase
posts.titleTr: 第 14 天：Traphase

op.content:
Our hope for Traphase has always been that even after you’ve experienced all of Morimens’ PvE content, you can still enjoy a different kind of card battle here.

Over the past few months, however, our development schedule has been tighter than ever, and we had to temporarily pause content updates for the mode. We also promised that we would continue supporting it with new features.

Here’s what’s coming.

## 1. Stats and Trends

You’ll be able to view Awakeners’ win rates and relative pick rates in Traphase over the past two months. Filter by mode, rank, and role to find the information you’re interested in and better understand changes in the meta.

> *Work-in-progress example. The figures shown do not represent actual gameplay data.*
> *开发中示例图，不代表真实数据。*

messages.content:
## 2. Spectating

Recently, many Keepers told us they wanted a spectator feature for Traphase. You’ll be able to use it soon!

You’ll be able to watch online matches that are currently in progress. However, a player’s card information will only be visible to mutual followers, and only if that player’s visibility settings allow it. Players can change these settings at any time.

## 3. Content Updates Resume

During the pause, we received many messages asking for Traphase updates to return soon. Seeing the mode gradually develop a community of players who genuinely enjoy it and continue to care about it has meant a lot to us.

So we’ve decided to resume Traphase content updates starting with this update!

The first Awakener joining the battlefield will be **Caraboo**! It will still take a few versions to catch up with the latest character releases, but we hope this will be a new beginning.

We’re also preparing balance adjustments for Traphase. Which cards do you think most need nerfs, and which need buffs? What new mechanics would you like to see?

Let us know in the comments! Sharing specific experiences from your matches, including what felt too strong, too weak, or simply not enjoyable enough, would also help us better understand your feedback.
messages.tr:
## 2. 观看

最近，许多 Keepers 告诉我们他们希望 Traphase 具有旁观者功能。您很快就能使用它！

您将能够观看当前正在进行的在线比赛。但是，玩家的卡牌信息仅对共同关注者可见，并且仅当该玩家的可见性设置允许时才可见。玩家可以随时更改这些设置。

## 3. 内容更新恢复

在暂停期间，我们收到许多消息，要求尽快返回 Traphase 更新。看到这个模式逐渐发展出一群真正喜欢它并继续关心它的玩家社区，这对我们来说意义重大。

因此，我们决定从本次更新开始恢复 Traphase 内容更新！

第一个加入战场的觉醒者将是**卡拉布**！仍然需要几个版本才能赶上最新的角色发布，但我们希望这将是一个新的开始。

我们还正在准备 Traphase 的平衡调整。您认为哪些卡最需要削弱，哪些需要加强？您希望看到哪些新机制？
请在评论中告诉我们！分享您在比赛中的具体经历，包括感觉太强、太弱或根本不够有趣，也将帮助我们更好地理解您的反馈。

messages.content:
# 第 14 天：相位对弈

对于相位对弈，我们一直希望：即使你已经体验完《忘却前夜》的所有 PVE 内容，也依然可以在这里享受另一种卡牌战斗的乐趣。

不过，过去几个月，团队的开发安排确实比以往更加紧张，我们不得不暂时停下这个模式的内容更新。我们也向大家承诺过，仍会继续提供功能支持。

下面就是即将带来的变化。

## 一、数据走势

大家将可以查看唤醒体在相位对弈中近两个月的胜率和相对登场热度，并按模式、段位和定位筛选，找到自己关心的信息，更好地了解环境动态。

## 二、观战功能

前阵子，许多守密人告诉我们，希望相位对弈能够加入观战功能。很快，大家就能用上了！

届时，大家可以观看当前正在进行的线上对局。不过，只有与对局玩家互相关注的校友，才有可能看到该玩家的卡面信息；具体是否可见，由对局玩家的设置决定，玩家也可以随时修改这一设置。

## 三、恢复更新

暂停更新的这段时间，我们收到了不少希望相位对弈尽早恢复更新的留言。看到这个玩法逐渐有了一群真正喜欢它、持续关心它的玩家，我们十分欣慰。

因此，我们决定从本期开始，恢复相位对弈的内容更新！

第一位即将抵达战场的是**卡拉布**！虽然要追上最新的角色进度，还需要几个版本的时间，但我们希望，这会是一个新的开始。

与此同时，我们也正在准备相位对弈的平衡调整。大家觉得哪些卡牌最需要削弱，哪些最需要加强？又希望在相位对弈中看到什么新机制？

欢迎留言告诉我们。如果能一起说说具体的对局经历，以及哪些地方让你觉得过强、乏力或不够有趣，也会更有助于我们理解大家的感受！

明天白天还有其他重要会议，所以今天凌晨得稍微赶一赶，哈哈！

关于造物，这些造物在其他环境下通常是平衡的，问题出在那一个，而不是其他造物，所以我们不会为了它去调整其他造物。这对我们来说确实很两难。但具体怎么玩、要不要“逃课”，我们认为这个选择权应该留给大家。

最初将这个造物加入玩法时，我们就考虑过可能会出现这样的情况，但对随机获取它所需付出的成本，确实考虑得不够周全。我们会在未来的玩法设计中吸取经验，但不打算针对这个问题改动列车。在不削弱、不移除这个造物的前提下，围绕它调整其他内容，会带来许多新的问题。

I have other important meetings during the day tomorrow, so I need to move things along a little tonight, haha!

As for Relics, these are generally balanced in other situations. The issue lies with that particular one, not the others, so we won’t change the other Relics just to address it. It does put us in a difficult position. But how you play, including whether you choose to “cheese” a challenge, is a choice we believe should be yours.

When we first added this Relic to the mode, we knew this situation might eventually arise. However, we didn’t fully account for the time and effort involved in obtaining it at random. We’ll learn from this when designing future modes, but we don’t plan to change Hectic Skybound Rail in response to this issue. Without nerfing or removing the Relic itself, adjusting other parts of the mode around it would create many new problems.

收到，谢谢！

Got it, thank you!

messages.content:
**0. 关于亲自体验游戏**

对于“设计者必须亲自体验自己设计的内容”这一点，我非常赞同。对于其他推测的部分，我不做解释。

**1. 关于密契与配置自由**

这次改版希望提供一种新的选择，而不是取消原有的自由更换方案。你可以逐步投入更多资源，获得更有针对性的优势；也可以继续采用更泛用、方便更换的配置，有时两者也可以兼顾。

我理解，你担心的是新方案会影响过去的投入。无论是系统更新、环境变化，还是推出新的密契，都可能带来这种影响。我们需要在提供新目标、新乐趣的同时，尽力兼顾已有投入的价值。

**2. 关于伤害转化与失衡**

多个机制相乘时，只要其中一个参数失控，就可能造成很大的失衡。有时问题不完全在于机制形式，而在于数值和叠加关系的控制。

例如，日服也有伤害转化为反伤、毒的设计，但整体表现相对更健康。我们也听到过相反的反馈，认为我们对机制复用越来越保守。这些都是设计中需要权衡的取舍，但即便如此，也仍然可能出现某个参数没有控制好的情况。

**3. 关于“继续观察”与角色调整**

很抱歉让你觉得是在敷衍。我们确实需要仔细讨论每项改动的影响，不仅看当下，也要考虑后续环境。

例如，在忘却篇，强效曾被认为作用有限，星辰篇逐渐改变了这一点；而如今，力量又显得有些弱势。不同能力的价值会随环境变化，有些影响需要更长的过程才能看清。

这并不是说大家只能一直等待，而是我不能仅凭一条反馈，在没有和设计团队充分讨论、形成判断之前，就立即承诺加强。这样的承诺可能暂时让人满意，却未必是负责任的做法。

**4. 关于灵塑适性与后续篇章**

灵塑适性的适用规则已经在说明中明确。新的篇章会有重新开始、逐步获得新能力的过程；旧篇章的规则与能力，也会在部分玩法中继续发挥作用。

因此，不能把星辰篇内的完整能力配置，直接视为角色进入所有后续篇章时都会保留的基础状态。

**5. 关于随机性**

你提到的这种“要么轻松获胜，要么几乎无法应对”的巨大落差，确实是我们需要尽量避免的。我认同这一点，也承认我们还没有做好。

我们希望随机性能带来变化和选择，而不是让结果过度取决于一次随机。让不同情况下的结果差异保持在合理范围内，是我们需要持续改进的目标。

**6. 关于融灾难度与奖励**

我们已经考虑把相对不那么关键的养成奖励放在高难。不过，我也理解，奖励如何分配，直接影响大家对挑战压力的感受。

游戏同时存在养成与策略两方面的差异，同一难度对不同玩家的要求可能相差很大。因此，无论怎样划分奖励门槛，都很难让所有人满意，这也是我们需要权衡的地方。

**7. 关于商店调整与公告**

首先，这不是有意隐瞒的调整。从开服起，我们一直坚持尽可能完整地说明更新内容，不希望任何修改含糊过去。但实际整理公告时，确实可能遗漏细节，这一点不能回避。

关于取消这部分兑换，当时我们分别提高了兑换奖励和溢出奖励，却没有充分考虑两项提高叠加后产生的放大效果。在某些玩法影响下，这条获取与兑换路径的潜在收益会变得过高，因此进行了调整。

我们希望更多奖励来自玩法和活动，而不是集中在商店兑换上。我理解，取消原有兑换会影响已经习惯这条获取路径的玩家，但这就是当时调整的考虑。

至于后来的金券商店调整，定价考虑了旧规则下为买到足够商品，还需要额外花费金券刷新商店的成本。因此，整合后的价格并不是直接沿用原先最低的单件售价，也不是原先最高的价格，而是结合原有获取成本重新制定的。

messages.content:
**0. Playing the Game Ourselves**

I strongly agree that designers must personally play the content they create. I won’t comment on the other assumptions.

**1. Covenants and Build Flexibility**

This rework is intended to offer a new option, not remove the existing freedom to swap Covenants. You can gradually invest more resources to gain more specialized advantages, or continue using more versatile setups that are easier to switch between. Sometimes, both approaches can work together.

I understand your concern that the new system may affect the value of your previous investment. System updates, changes to the meta, and new Covenants can all have that effect. We need to do our best to preserve the value of existing investments while introducing new goals and new ways to enjoy the game.

**2. Damage Conversion and Balance**

When several mechanics multiply together, a single parameter getting out of control can cause a major imbalance. Sometimes, the problem is not entirely the form of the mechanic, but how its numbers and interactions are managed.

For example, the Japanese version also has mechanics that convert damage into reflected damage or Poison, but their overall performance is relatively healthier. We’ve also heard the opposite criticism: that we’ve become increasingly conservative about reusing mechanics. These are trade-offs we have to weigh in design, and even then, a parameter can still end up poorly balanced.
messages.tr:
**0。自己玩游戏**

我强烈同意设计师必须亲自发挥他们创造的内容。我不会评论其他假设。

**1.契约和构建灵活性**

这次重做的目的是提供一个新的选择，而不是取消现有的交换契约的自由。您可以逐渐投入更多资源来获得更专业的优势，或者继续使用更易于切换的更通用的设置。有时，两种方法可以一起发挥作用。

我理解您担心新系统可能会影响您之前投资的价值。系统更新、元数据更改和新契约都可以产生这种效果。我们需要尽最大努力保护现有投资的价值，同时引入新的目标和享受游戏的新方式。

**2.伤害转换和平衡**

当多个机制相乘时，单个参数失控可能会导致严重不平衡。有时，问题并不完全在于机制的形式，而在于如何管理其数量和交互。
例如，日版也有将伤害转化为反射伤害或毒害的机制，但它们的整体表现相对更健康。我们也听到了相反的批评：我们对重用机制变得越来越保守。这些是我们在设计中必须权衡的权衡，即使如此，参数仍然可能会出现不平衡的情况。

messages.content:
**3. “Continuing to Monitor” and Character Adjustments**

I’m sorry our responses have felt dismissive. We genuinely need to carefully discuss the impact of each change, considering not only the current environment but also what comes next.

For example, Amplification was once considered to have limited value in Faded Legacy, and Astral Reign gradually changed that. Now, Strength is looking somewhat weaker. The value of different abilities changes with the environment, and some effects take longer to become clear.

That doesn’t mean everyone should simply wait indefinitely. But I cannot promise a buff based on a piece of feedback before thoroughly discussing it with the design team and reaching a considered judgment. Such a promise might be satisfying in the moment, but it would not necessarily be responsible.

**4. Soulforge Aptitude and Future Arcs**

The rules explaining where Soulforge Aptitude applies are already stated in its description. A new arc involves starting afresh and gradually gaining new abilities, while the rules and abilities of older arcs will continue to have a place in certain modes.

The full set of abilities available within Astral Reign should therefore not be treated as a character’s baseline kit that will carry over into every future arc.

**5. Randomness**

The extreme gap you describe, between winning easily and being almost unable to respond, is something we need to try to avoid. I agree with you on that, and I acknowledge that we haven’t handled it well enough yet.

We want randomness to create variety and choices, rather than make the outcome depend too heavily on a single roll. Keeping the differences between possible outcomes within a reasonable range is something we need to continue improving.
messages.tr:
**3. “持续监控”和角色调整**

很抱歉我们的回应让人感到不屑一顾。我们确实需要仔细讨论每个变化的影响，不仅要考虑当前的环境，还要考虑接下来会发生什么。

例如，在《褪色的遗产》中，增幅曾经被认为价值有限，而星界统治逐渐改变了这一点。现在，实力看起来有些弱了。不同能力的数值会随着环境的变化而变化，有些效果需要更长的时间才能显现出来。

这并不意味着每个人都应该无限期地等待。但在与设计团队充分讨论并做出深思熟虑的判断之前，我不能根据反馈来承诺增强。这样的承诺可能在一时令人满意，但不一定是负责任的。

**4.灵魂锻造能力和未来弧**

解释 Soulforge Aptitude 适用范围的规则已在其描述中说明。新的弧线涉及重新开始并逐渐获得新的能力，而旧弧线的规则和能力将继续在某些模式中占有一席之地。
因此，《星界王朝》中可用的全套能力不应被视为角色的基线套件，它将延续到未来的每个弧线中。

**5.随机性**

您所描述的轻松获胜和几乎无法做出反应之间的极端差距是我们需要尽力避免的。我同意你的观点，并且我承认我们还没有处理得足够好。

我们希望随机性能够创造多样性和选择，而不是让结果过于依赖于单次掷骰。将可能结果的差异保持在合理范围内，是我们需要继续改进的地方。

messages.content:
**6. D-Effect Zone Difficulty and Rewards**

We have already considered placing relatively less essential progression rewards at higher difficulty levels. However, I also understand that how rewards are distributed directly affects how much pressure players feel to take on these challenges.

Both character progression and strategy can make a substantial difference, so the same difficulty can demand very different things from different players. Whatever reward thresholds we set, it is difficult to satisfy everyone. That is another trade-off we have to consider.

**7. Shop Changes and Update Notices**

First, this was not a change we deliberately concealed. Since launch, we’ve consistently tried to explain updates as fully as possible, rather than leave changes unclear. But details can be missed when preparing update notices, and we cannot ignore that.

Regarding the removal of these exchanges, we had increased both the exchange rewards and the rewards for excess duplicates, without fully accounting for the amplifying effect of combining those two increases. With the effects of certain modes, the potential returns from this acquisition-and-exchange route could become too high, which is why we adjusted it.

We want more rewards to come from gameplay and events, rather than be concentrated in shop exchanges. I understand that removing an existing exchange affects players who have become accustomed to that route, but that was the reasoning behind the change.

As for the later changes to the Rose Scrip shop, the pricing took into account the extra Rose Scrip previously needed to refresh the shop and purchase enough items. The consolidated prices therefore do not simply use the lowest previous unit prices, nor are they the highest previous prices. They were recalculated with the previous overall acquisition costs in mind.
messages.tr:
**6。 D-效应区难度和奖励**

我们已经考虑过在较高难度级别上放置相对不太重要的进度奖励。不过，我也明白，奖励的分配方式直接影响玩家接受这些挑战的压力有多大。

角色进程和策略都会产生很大的差异，因此相同的难度对不同玩家的要求可能会截然不同。无论我们设定多少奖励门槛，都很难让所有人都满意。这是我们必须考虑的另一个权衡。

**7.商店变更和更新通知**

首先，这并不是我们刻意隐瞒的变化。自发布以来，我们一直试图尽可能全面地解释更新，而不是让更改变得不清楚。但在准备更新通知时可能会遗漏细节，我们不能忽视这一点。
关于取消这些兑换，我们增加了兑换奖励和超额重复奖励，但没有充分考虑这两项增加相结合的放大效应。由于某些模式的影响，这种获取和交换路径的潜在回报可能会变得过高，因此我们对其进行了调整。

我们希望更多的奖励来自游戏玩法和活动，而不是集中在商店兑换中。我知道删除现有的交换会影响已经习惯该路线的玩家，但这就是更改背后的原因。

至于后来玫瑰纸币商店的改动，定价考虑了之前刷新商店和购买足够物品所需的额外玫瑰纸币。因此，合并价格并不简单地使用之前的最低单价，也不是简单地使用之前的最高单价。他们是根据之前的总体购置成本重新计算的。

I honestly think Draft Pick is already interesting and fun enough conceptually that it doesn't need relics, at least not relics that change the gameplay and cause RNG swings to this degree. I also think it's difficult for many people to learn it even before the relics come into play...

messages.content:
1. 我们在评估时会识别并排除这些异常情况，样本量越小，数据的参考权重也会越低。当然，我们也不会只看数据。
2. 这确实是个问题。对于想学习相位对弈的守密人来说，目前的环境有些太残酷了！未来在开发安排允许的情况下，我们会考虑如何提供更循序渐进的学习过程。
3. 分数和排名的起伏确实会让人沮丧。以目前的玩家规模，要让相位对弈这样一个偏休闲的玩法通过评分十分精确地反映玩家水平，是很困难的。而增加更多附加规则，又可能让分数更容易靠反复游玩来刷取。因此，我们暂时不会调整这套机制，但会继续寻找更好的办法。

1. When evaluating balance, we’ll identify and exclude these anomalies. The smaller the sample size, the less weight we’ll give the data. Of course, we won’t rely on data alone.

messages.content:
1. 我们平衡角色时，依据的是通常情况下能够达到的表现，而不是理论上的最高上限。设置上限，更多是为了确保在一些特殊场合和玩法中，持续积累带来的收益不会高得离谱，并不意味着角色必须叠满才能发挥作用。

2. 凝视想要限制的，并不是所有慢热玩法，而是一些几乎没有风险、只需要不断花时间就能获胜的打法。例如，纯防御构筑可以让你每回合都不损失生命，你知道自己迟早会赢，剩下的只是等待。

这种玩法可能耗费大量时间，却没有多少变化和决策。即使最后赢了，也可能只剩下疲惫，然后直接关掉游戏。相比之下，我们倒宁愿你吐槽：“Light 到底有什么毛病，为什么对六回合这么执着？”

3. 所以，在我们的设计思路中，慢热机制和凝视通常并不矛盾，因为这些能力本来就是在这个战斗框架下设计的。例如，一个每三回合产生一次收益的能力，理论上可以随着战斗无限持续而获得无限收益，但我们平衡它时，并不会把这些收益全部算进去，有时甚至不会把第六回合的那次收益计入预期表现。

我们希望在一定的边界内，让启动速度、每次收益的大小，以及战斗中的选择都有实际意义，而不是让问题最后变成“只要时间足够，就能积累多少”的数学计算。
