posts.title: Day 8: Pure Realm II
posts.titleTr: 第 8 天：清净境界 II

op.content:
Back in Faded Legacy, Aequor, Caro, and Ultra Awakeners could only team up with Awakeners from their own realm or Chaos. That separation gave each realm a distinct identity. Many Keepers found a favorite realm, much like having a favorite class in an MMO. That turned out to be even cooler than we had imagined!

But it also meant that new Awakeners from other realms often brought no new possibilities to your favorite teams. So, early in version 2.0, we introduced mixed-realm teams, and placed even more emphasis on mixing when designing the second-generation realms. There are still plenty of balance issues to address, but team-building now offers far more possibilities than it did two years ago.

However, more and more Keepers who enjoy pure teams have told us that mixing in another realm now feels almost mandatory, because they lose too much otherwise. We want mixing to broaden your choices while keeping specialization worthwhile, without making you feel you have to give up the way you enjoy building teams.

With that in mind, here is today's planned improvement:

**For <:realm_chaos:1437283650809888768> Primordia: Chaos , <:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777> Benthos: Aequor, <:realm_caro:1437283648134058004> Propagation: Caro, and <:realm_ultra:1437283545784651926> Singularity: Ultra, a team made up entirely of Awakeners from the corresponding realm color will gain an additional 250 Realm Mastery. This bonus will also benefit from the existing doubled Realm Mastery effect for pure teams!**
op.tr:
回到《褪色的遗产》中，Aequor、卡罗和终极觉醒者只能与来自自己领域或混沌的觉醒者组队。这种分离赋予了每个领域独特的身份。许多守护者找到了自己最喜欢的领域，就像在 MMO 中拥有最喜欢的职业一样。结果比我们想象的还要酷！

但这也意味着来自其他领域的新觉醒者往往不会给你喜欢的球队带来新的可能性。所以，在2.0版本初期，我们引入了混合领域团队，并且在设计第二代领域时更加强调混合。仍然有很多平衡问题需要解决，但现在的团队建设比两年前提供了更多的可能性。

然而，越来越多喜欢纯粹团队的守护者告诉我们，现在在另一个领域混合几乎是强制性的，因为否则他们会失去太多。我们希望通过混合来扩大您的选择，同时保持专业化的价值，而不会让您觉得必须放弃您喜欢组建团队的方式。

考虑到这一点，这是今天计划的改进：
**对于<:realm_chaos:1437283650809888768>原基：混沌、<:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777>底栖生物：Aequor、<:realm_caro:1437283648134058004>传播：卡罗和<:realm_ultra:1437283545784651926>奇点：超，完全由相应领域颜色的觉醒者组成的团队将额外获得 250 领域掌握度。此奖励还将受益于纯团队现有的双倍领域掌握效果！ **

messages.content:
### Realm Mastery Bonus Preview

1. <:realm_chaos:1437283650809888768> **Primordia: Chaos**
   An additional 25% Posse Strength.

2. <:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777>  **Benthos: Aequor**
   Benthos: Tranquil Sea Stance grants additional Shield equal to 12.5% of Max HP. Benthos: Raging Waves Stance grants an additional +12.5% Tentacle DMG bonus.

3. <:realm_caro:1437283648134058004> **Propagation: Caro**
   All Awakeners gain 5 additional stacks of Crimson Frenzy at the start of each turn. Each Awakener also gains 10 additional stacks of Crimson Frenzy the first time they consume a Propagule Embryo each turn.

4. <:realm_ultra:1437283545784651926> **Singularity: Ultra**
   Before rounding, this adds 3.75 stacks to the Singularity Prism granted at the start of a stage, and 6.25 stacks to the Singularity Beacon granted to cards entering Ultra Space. The resulting total stack counts are rounded up.

Mixed teams can still combine the powerful mechanics of two realms. Specializing in one realm, meanwhile, will further strengthen its distinctive mechanics and give pure teams clearer advantages of their own!

This adjustment is a first step toward giving Keepers who choose pure teams a more tangible benefit. It won't solve every team-building issue, and we'll continue to observe how individual realms and Awakeners perform in practice.

Even when we need to introduce some restrictions, our long-term goal remains the same: to give everyone more interesting, more varied team compositions and strategic experiences. We hope Keepers who enjoy pure teams will like today's changes!
messages.tr:
### 领域掌握奖励预览

1. <:realm_chaos:1437283650809888768> **原基：混沌**
   额外 25% 的队伍强度。

2. <:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777> **底栖生物：Aequor**
   底栖生物：平静的海姿态额外提供相当于最大生命值 12.5% 的护盾。底栖生物：狂暴波浪姿态额外提供 +12.5% 触手伤害加值。

3. <:realm_caro:1437283648134058004> **传播：卡罗**
   所有觉醒者在每回合开始时额外获得 5 层猩红狂乱。每个觉醒者每回合第一次消耗繁殖体胚胎时还会额外获得 10 层猩红狂乱。

4. <:realm_ultra:1437283545784651926> **奇点：超**
   在四舍五入之前，这会为阶段开始时授予的奇点棱镜增加 3.75 层，为进入超级空间的卡牌授予的奇点信标增加 6.25 层。所得总堆栈计数将向上舍入。

混合团队仍然可以结合两个领域的强大机制。同时，专攻某一领域，也会进一步强化其独特的机制，让纯粹的队伍拥有更明显的优势！
这一调整是让选择纯粹球队的守护者获得更切实利益的第一步。它并不能解决所有团队建设问题，我们将继续观察各个领域和觉醒者在实践中的表现。

即使我们需要引入一些限制，我们的长期目标仍然是一样的：给每个人更有趣、更多样化的团队组成和战略体验。我们希望喜欢纯粹团队的守护者会喜欢今天的变化！

## What's next?

We've now spent eight days of this 30-day community challenge discussing and improving realm mechanics. Next, we'll turn our attention to other parts of the game! What game modes would you like us to improve? Which enemies make you want to shout, “Nerf this one!”? And which systems or features could be easier to use? Keep sharing your thoughts with me!

> *These changes are still planned. Please refer to the version announcements for the final implementation.*
messages.tr:
## 接下来是什么？

在这个为期 30 天的社区挑战中，我们现在已经花了 8 天的时间讨论和改进领域机制。接下来我们就把注意力转向游戏的其他部分！您希望我们改进哪些游戏模式？哪些敌人让你想大喊“削弱这个！”？哪些系统或功能更容易使用？继续与我分享你的想法！

messages.content:
## 第八天：至纯界域 II

在忘却篇时代，深海、血肉、超维的唤醒体，只能与同界域或混沌界域的唤醒体组队。这样的区隔，让每个界域都有鲜明的个性。许多守密人也找到了自己钟爱的界域，就像在 MMO 中拥有喜欢的职业一样。这比我们最初想象的还要酷！

但这也意味着，其他界域的新唤醒体，往往无法为自己喜欢的队伍带来新的可能。因此，我们在 2.0 初期引入了界域混编，并在二代界域的设计中进一步重视混编体验。如今，虽然仍有不少平衡问题，但配队的可能性确实比两年前丰富了许多。

不过，越来越多喜欢至纯队伍的守密人告诉我们：现在感觉不得不混入其他界域，否则损失就太大了。我们希望混编拓宽选择，也希望专精一个界域仍然值得，而不是让大家放下自己喜欢的配队方式。

为此，今天我们计划带来这项改进：

**在原初·混沌、晦瞑·深海、繁育·血肉、奇点·超维中，如果队伍仅由对应颜色界域的唤醒体组成，将额外获得 250 点界域精通。这部分加成也会享受至纯队伍原有的界域精通翻倍效果！**

### 界域精通加成效果换算预览

1. <:realm_chaos:1437283650809888768> **原初·混沌**
   钥令强度额外提高 25%。

2. <:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777> **晦瞑·深海**
   「晦瞑·静海姿态」额外提供相当于最大生命 12.5% 的护盾；「晦瞑·怒涛姿态」额外提供 12.5% 触腕伤害提高效果。

3. <:realm_caro:1437283648134058004> **繁育·血肉**
   每回合开始时，全体唤醒体额外获得 5 层「猩红狂热」；每名唤醒体每回合首次消耗「繁育·胚胎」时，额外获得 10 层「猩红狂热」。

4. <:realm_ultra:1437283545784651926> **奇点·超维**
   关卡开始时获得的「奇点棱镜」，理论上额外增加 3.75 层；进入超维空间的卡牌获得的「奇点信标」，理论上额外增加 6.25 层。实际总层数会向上取整。

混编仍然能够结合两个界域的强大机制；而选择专精于一个界域，则能进一步强化它独有的机制，让至纯队伍拥有更鲜明的优势！

这次调整，是先为选择至纯队伍的大家补上一份更明确的收益。它并不能解决所有配队问题，我们还会结合各界域与唤醒体的实际表现继续观察。

## 接下来？

即便有时我们需要在游戏中加入一些限制，但从更长远的规划来看，我们始终希望为大家带来更有趣、更多样的配队组合与策略体验。希望喜欢至纯队伍的守密人，会喜欢今天的调整！

这次 30 天回归社区挑战，我们已经用了 8 天来讨论和改进界域机制。接下来，我们会把目光转向游戏的其他部分！还有哪些玩法希望改进、哪些敌人让你特别想喊一句“削弱它！”，或者哪些系统功能用起来不够顺手，都欢迎继续告诉我！

> *以上为计划中的调整，具体实装内容请以版本公告为准。*

1. 通常我们会尽量避免同一界域的唤醒体连续推出，除非有叙事安排或其他特殊考量。具体排期还是交给后续公告揭晓吧！

2. 至纯超维缺少生命回复手段的问题，我们收到了！护盾和回血确实不能完全互相替代，我们会在后续强化时考虑这一点。

3. 我们很乐意继续分享角色的设计过程，不过整理这些内容也需要不少精力，目前还是需要优先确保游戏更新。美术设定集也确实在待办清单里，而且我们已经取得了曾参与项目的美术团队成员们的许可！只是制作起来需要投入更多时间和精力，暂时还不能给大家一个时间表。

4. 地形信息如何标注得更清楚，我们还在审视。你提到让地形造物进入更多玩法商店的建议，也很有意思！不过，目前能发挥作用的地形还比较少，我们暂时不打算把它加入融灾和列车的商店，未来也许会有机会。

5. 关于阿格里帕，我之前说的是她的设计定位，并不是说她目前已经很好地承担了这个定位。你指出的实际表现与定位之间的差距，我们会在基础机制调整实装后再次评估。

1. We generally try to avoid releasing Awakeners from the same realm back to back, unless there are narrative reasons or other special considerations. As for the actual release schedule, we'll leave that to future announcements!

2. We've heard your concerns about the lack of healing options for pure Ultra teams! Shields and healing aren't fully interchangeable, and we'll take this into account when considering future buffs.

3. We'd love to share more about our character design process, but putting those features together takes quite a bit of work, and right now we need to prioritize game updates. An art book is indeed on our to-do list, and we've already received permission from former members of the art team who contributed to the project! It would still take considerable time and effort to produce, though, so we can't give you a timeline just yet.

4. We're still looking at how to make terrain information clearer. Your suggestion to make terrain-related Relics available in more game modes' shops is interesting too! However, there are still relatively few terrains with meaningful gameplay effects, so we don't currently plan to add it to the D-Effect Zone or Railway shops. That may be something we revisit in the future.

5. Regarding Agrippa, I was describing her intended role, not saying that she currently fulfills it well. We'll reassess the gap you've pointed out between that role and her actual performance once the changes to the underlying mechanics are live.

这里需要区分两种限制：跃迁是整个队伍竞争同一次触发机会，而「回合唯一」是限制某个效果每回合至多触发一次。后者在大多数常规玩法中不会造成太大影响，却能帮助我们控制大量复制卡牌时的极端收益。这些队伍很强，我们并不打算因此削弱它们，但也需要避免它们成为游戏的唯一解。忘却篇早期，我们很少加入这类限制，后来确实为此付出了很大的平衡代价。这并不意味着跃迁带来的取舍没有价值，只是两者要解决的问题不同。

谢谢你对汀克特的喜爱，透过屏幕我都感受到了！你担心的不只是她的强度，也包括她帮助触发跃迁的能力，会不会越来越难找到配合对象。这一点我们理解，汀克特会是我们重点关注的唤醒体之一！

不再沿用跃迁的卡牌设计后，我们确实需要为超维唤醒体探索新的界域特色。日服已有一种设计：使用「湮灭」或进入超维回合后，狂气爆发能够获得额外效果。我们会考虑国际服是否也有机会引入这样的设计，但目前还不能保证具体方案。

超维的防御能力一直被有意设计得相对弱一些，但这不意味着它的生存困难可以被忽略。这次经典·超维的调整，也有望改善队伍的防御表现。不过，护盾与持续回血并不能完全互相替代，我们会在这些调整的基础上，继续观察超维队伍是否需要额外帮助。

尽管要在策略深度与上手体验之间找到平衡并不容易，我们仍会继续努力，让喜欢更复杂策略的守密人也能享受其中的乐趣！

There's an important distinction here: Leap effects compete for a shared opportunity across the whole team, while Turn Unique limits a particular effect to once per turn. The latter usually has little impact on regular play, but helps us keep extreme card-copying combinations in check. These teams are powerful, and we don't intend to nerf them simply for that, but we also need to prevent them from becoming the only viable way to play. We used very few restrictions like this early in Faded Legacy, and that eventually created some serious balance problems. That doesn't mean Leap's trade-offs have no value; the two restrictions simply address different problems.

Thank you for showing Tinct so much love. I can feel it through the screen! Your concern isn't just about her power, but also whether her ability to enable Leap will have fewer and fewer opportunities to shine. We understand that, and Tinct will be one of the Awakeners we pay particular attention to!

As we move away from designing cards around Leap, we do need to explore new ways to express Ultra's identity through its Awakeners. The Japanese version already has one such approach: Exalts gain additional effects after using Annihilation or entering an Ultra Turn. We'll consider whether something similar could work in the global version, though we can't promise a specific implementation yet.

Ultra has always been designed with relatively weaker defensive capabilities, but that doesn't mean its survival problems should be ignored. The changes to classic Ultra may also improve teams' defensive performance. Still, shields and sustained healing aren't fully interchangeable, and we'll keep assessing whether Ultra teams need additional help once these changes are in place.

Finding the right balance between strategic depth and accessibility isn't easy, but we'll keep working to make sure Keepers who enjoy more complex strategies have plenty to enjoy too!

我们理解，精心准备的组合被限制挡住，确实会扫兴。但游戏中的组合收益非常强，如果没有适当制约，快速爆发或一次性爆发就容易成为最优解，让防御、治疗和成长型角色失去空间。

我们希望通过不同的敌人与环境，让各种打法都有发挥机会。当然，限制也不一定都合理，单次伤害上限对希洛这类角色的影响，需要单独评估。这也是我在帖子结尾希望继续听取的反馈。

We understand how frustrating it is when a restriction stops a carefully planned combo. But our combos can be extremely powerful. Without some constraints, teams that end fights quickly or defeat a boss in a single burst can dominate, leaving little room for defensive supports, healers, or characters who need time to build up.

We want varied enemies and battle conditions to give different playstyles room to shine. That doesn't make every restriction justified, though. The impact of per-hit damage caps on characters like Helot needs to be assessed separately. This is exactly the kind of feedback I invited at the end of my post.

我们当然会考虑加入更多地形！不过，比起让各种地形都有同样多的机制，我们更看重这些元素如何帮助我们讲故事。

你提到的敌人，以及置顶已关注校友、方便点赞的建议，都记下来了！谢谢你的反馈！

With my responsibilities within the team, it's hard to promise a fixed time to show up, but I usually aim to post the mini dev logs in the afternoon, UTC+8!

Some of our current one-star skins were developed from fairly polished alternative designs left by the early art team. That's also why we usually offer them for free through events when they first launch. They feature some visual differences but largely use the original combat model. A completely different outfit would require more production work, though it's something we'll consider for the future!

We'd certainly consider adding more terrain types! Rather than giving every terrain the same amount of mechanical support, though, we're more interested in how these elements can help us tell stories.

We've noted the enemies you mentioned, along with your suggestion to pin followed players so it's easier to give your friends daily likes. Thanks for the feedback!

这里的免疫能力，设计上需要提前投入资源来获得，用于预防封印。我们理解觉醒卡被封住时会很难受，但目前不打算让它在被封印后仍能直接使用。尤乌哈希的整体表现我们会继续关注，尤其是力量体系的支持环境确实需要改善，但调整未必会从这一点入手。

This immunity is designed to require an investment of resources in advance to prevent Seal. However, this particular interaction may not be where we make adjustments.

Your point about Singularity: Ultra starting an Ultra Turn with a fixed amount of Arithmetica, even when the cap has increased, makes sense. We'll consider correcting this!

I understand that seeing a useful effect become unavailable because the terrain condition isn't met can feel disappointing. Still, advantages tied to particular environments, enemies, or teammates are part of what gives characters their specialties and creates different team-building choices. 我理解，行动限制太多，确实会让人玩得不够畅快。适当的限制可以带来不同的应对思路，让挑战不只取决于数值。但如果限制过头，带来的挫败感超过了克服挑战的成就感，那就偏离了我们的初衷。我会关注这个问题。

I understand that too many restrictions on your actions can take the fun out of playing. Some restrictions can encourage different approaches, making challenges about more than just numbers. But if they go too far and the frustration outweighs the satisfaction of overcoming the challenge, that's not what we want. I'll take a closer look at this!
messages.prev: I would like to raise the issue of Xu’s spellbound limit for enlightments between OE and AA, which becomes significant when you have Xu’s portrait. The spellbound limit without AA is 10, whilst OE alone grants 6. The portrait grants 1 spellbound per turn, and 2cost grants an additional one. In practice, it is very difficult not to exceed the limit and lose spellbounds: until you load OE, it is difficult to have no more than 3 stacks (assuming that you will be able to remove spellbounds immediately on the turn following OE; you will get 1 at the start of that turn anyway), so some spellbounds go to waste
messages.prevTr: 我想提出徐氏对OE和AA之间启蒙的令人着迷的限制问题，当你有徐氏的肖像时，这个问题就变得很重要。没有 AA 的施法限制为 10，而单独的 OE 则为 6。肖像每回合提供 1 点施法，2 成本额外提供 1 点。在实践中，不超过限制并失去咒语束缚是非常困难的：在您加载OE之前，很难拥有不超过3层的咒语束缚（假设您将能够在OE之后的回合立即移除咒语束缚；无论如何，您将在该回合开始时获得1个咒语束缚），因此一些咒语会被浪费

1. 可以！和经典·混沌唤醒体混编时，也能享受这次的加成！
2. 目前没有进一步增加常规复刻卡池数量的计划，但我们会考虑在特殊时间推出更灵活的特殊卡池，提供更多获取机会。

5. 现在把高启灵的收益移到基础技能组，可能会让已经投入较多的守密人感到自己的投入被削弱，我们希望尽量避免这一点。如果负誓·奥吉尔的基础表现确实不佳，我们会优先考虑其他改善办法。
6. 我们也想多做呀！但幻衣的制作成本对我们来说真的很高，目前还无法在大量制作幻衣的同时，保证游戏基础内容的更新。说实话，几年前我们甚至不敢想能做出现在这些幻衣。我们也希望未来能有更多机会！

1. Yes! Teams that include classic Chaos Awakeners can also receive this bonus!
2. We currently have no plans to increase the number of regular rerun banners further. However, we'll consider offering more flexible special banners on certain occasions to provide more opportunities to obtain Awakeners.
3. Skins of this quality take a great deal of work, but we're working on it! It may still be quite a while before we can share more with you.
4. Thanks for your feedback! We'll be more careful about how these restrictions affect the experience of playing.
5. Moving benefits from higher Enlightenment levels into the base kit now could make Keepers who have already invested heavily feel that their investment has lost value. We'd like to avoid that where possible. If Genesis Ogier's base performance does prove insufficient, we'll look at other ways to improve it first.
6. We'd love to make more, too! But skins really are costly for our team to produce. Right now, we can't make them in large numbers while also keeping up with the game's core content updates. Honestly, a few years ago, even making the skins we have today felt out of reach. We hope there will be more opportunities in the future!

谢谢你继续解释自己喜欢跃迁的原因！此前我没有把设计上的难点说完整：普通回合中，跃迁只有有限的触发机会；但到了超维回合，多张卡牌都能触发，组合起来可能把收益放大十几倍甚至几十倍。这使我们很难给单次跃迁设计足够强、又不在超维回合中失控的效果。

因此，很多跃迁的收益最终只能控制在约 1 点算力的差异。它确实带来了你喜欢的取舍感，但在我们的评估中，对实际战术的影响往往还不够大。我们希望找到更好的方案，既保留这种选择的乐趣，也让它更切实地影响战斗。

之前我解释过，适当的限制也能为不同打法保留空间。这次想再补充一个主题上的角度：《忘却前夜》希望传达的，也包括面对不可名状之物时的压迫感。因此，我们不会总让玩家凭借强大的连招轻松消灭敌人，有时也希望大家感受到危险，需要谨慎应对。

但这种压迫感如何转化为有趣的挑战，而不是单纯的束手无策，是我们需要不断把握的分寸。你提到的负面体验，我们也会更谨慎地衡量。

Thank you for explaining what you enjoy about Leap! My earlier answer didn't fully explain the design challenge: Leap has limited opportunities to trigger during normal turns, but during an Ultra Turn, many cards can trigger it. Combined effects can amplify the payoff tenfold or even more. That makes it difficult to give individual Leap effects substantial impact without letting them become overwhelming during Ultra Turns.

As a result, many Leap effects ended up offering a benefit roughly equivalent to 1 Arithmetica. They do create the sense of trade-off you enjoy, but in our assessment, their impact on actual tactics often isn't substantial enough. We want to find a better approach that preserves the enjoyment of making those choices while giving them a more meaningful impact on battles.

I've previously explained how some restrictions can help preserve room for different playstyles. I'd like to add another perspective: Morimens also aims to convey the dread of facing something beyond comprehension. That means we won't always let powerful combos make short work of enemies. Sometimes, we want players to feel threatened and approach a fight carefully.

The balance we need to keep working on is turning that pressure into an engaging challenge, rather than simply leaving players feeling helpless. We'll be more mindful of the frustrating experiences you've described.

messages.content:
在《忘却前夜》中，不同构筑、不同熟练程度的守密人，体验可能相差很大。传统肉鸽卡牌游戏的一些制胜思路其实很反直觉：精简牌库，用卡牌获取资源，再把资源转化为更多出牌机会，最终形成接近无限的连锁。这确实很帅气，我们早期也希望提供这种乐趣，所以才会给最初的唤醒体拉蒙娜设计如此强大的狂气爆发。

但到了忘却篇后期，我们也看到了这条路的问题：一旦形成无限循环，常规的攻防安排就不再重要，不参与这套循环的唤醒体也很难竞争。与此同时，没有掌握这类玩法的守密人，甚至仍然觉得主线非常困难。如今幻梦深潜的后期体验，也让我们看到了继续沿着这条路发展可能遇到的问题：即使敌人的数值很高，当玩家能够不受限制地扩大资源循环时，也未必能持续带来新的挑战和乐趣。

因此，我们开始限制部分效果的反复触发，希望缩小这种过大的差距，也给其他构筑留下空间。我理解，对喜欢钻研连锁的玩家来说，这确实会损失一部分乐趣。我们需要继续寻找平衡，让精彩的组合依然值得追求，也让更多不同的打法能够成立。

对于未来的扩展更新，我们更希望玩法围绕有意义的取舍展开，而不是以每回合打出五十张牌、资源越打越多为主要追求。当所有卡牌都能被打出时，“这一回合该用什么、放弃什么”的分量就会减轻，决策的重心也会转向如何维持和放大资源循环。这同样有它的乐趣，但不是我们希望整个游戏最终都围绕的唯一方向。

messages.content:
In Morimens, the experience can vary enormously depending on your build and how familiar you are with the game's systems. Some winning strategies in traditional roguelike card games are quite counterintuitive: keep your deck small, use cards to generate resources, then turn those resources into more card plays, eventually creating an almost endless chain. That really is exciting, and our early designs embraced that enjoyment. It's why Ramona, the very first Awakener, received such a powerful Exalt.

But toward the end of Faded Legacy, we also saw the problems with that approach. Once an infinite loop was established, conventional offensive and defensive decisions stopped mattering, and Awakeners that couldn't contribute to those loops struggled to compete. Meanwhile, Keepers who hadn't learned those strategies could still find even the main story extremely difficult. The later stages of Phantasmal Dive also illustrate the problems we could face by continuing down that path: even enemies with very high stats don't necessarily provide lasting variety or challenge when players can keep expanding their resource loops without limits.

That's why we began limiting repeated triggers on certain effects: to narrow that enormous gap and leave room for other builds. I understand that, for players who love experimenting with chains and combos, this does take away some of the fun. We need to keep finding a balance where exciting combos remain rewarding to pursue, while more kinds of builds can also succeed.

As we expand the game in future updates, we want gameplay to focus more on meaningful trade-offs, rather than making fifty-card turns and ever-growing resources the main goal. When you can play every card, deciding what to use and what to give up this turn carries less weight. The focus instead shifts toward sustaining and expanding the resource loop. That has its own appeal, too, but we don't want it to become the only direction the entire game revolves around.
messages.tr:
在《莫里门斯》中，体验可能会有很大差异，具体取决于您的构建以及您对游戏系统的熟悉程度。传统 Roguelike 卡牌游戏中的一些获胜策略非常违反直觉：保持牌组较小，使用卡牌生成资源，然后将这些资源转化为更多的卡牌游戏，最终形成几乎无限的链条。这确实令人兴奋，我们早期的设计也体现了这种享受。这就是为什么第一位觉醒者雷蒙娜获得了如此强大的尊崇。

但在《褪色的遗产》接近尾声时，我们也看到了这种方法的问题。一旦建立了无限循环，传统的进攻和防御决策就不再重要，而无法为这些循环做出贡献的觉醒者将难以参与竞争。与此同时，没有学会这些策略的守护者仍然会觉得连主线故事都极其困难。 《Phantasmal Dive》的后期阶段也说明了我们继续沿着这条路可能面临的问题：当玩家可以无限制地不断扩大资源循环时，即使是具有非常高统计数据的敌人也不一定会提供持久的多样性或挑战。
这就是为什么我们开始限制某些效果的重复触发：缩小巨大的差距并为其他构建留出空间。我知道，对于喜欢尝试连锁和连击的玩家来说，这确实会失去一些乐趣。我们需要不断寻找平衡点，让令人兴奋的组合仍然值得追求，同时更多种类的构建也可以成功。

当我们在未来的更新中扩展游戏时，我们希望游戏玩法更多地关注有意义的权衡，而不是将五十张卡牌回合和不断增长的资源作为主要目标。当你可以打出每张牌时，决定本回合使用什么和放弃什么的分量就更轻了。相反，重点转向维持和扩大资源循环。这也有其自身的吸引力，但我们不希望它成为整个游戏围绕的唯一方向。

messages.content:
我们可能会更新幻梦深潜与融灾禁区采用的篇章规则，也可能带来新的玩法！希望你继续玩得开心！
We may update the arc rulesets used in Phantasmal Dive and the D-Effect Zone, and we may also introduce new game modes! We hope you continue to enjoy the game!

我理解，花了很多资源培养的唤醒体，因为环境变化突然难以上场，确实让人不好受。

新玩法、新关卡、新篇章，甚至界域调整和强化补丁，都可能改变不同唤醒体的表现。游戏要继续发展，我无法保证这些波动不会发生。但无论版本怎么变，我们都希望每位唤醒体保有独特的价值，有适合自己发挥的场合。这也是这些年我们一直在做强化调整的原因，只是这些工作确实需要时间。

至于“培养了角色，却没有足够有趣的内容可玩”，这也是我们需要解决的问题。完成这几个月的大型更新后，我们会把更多精力投入新玩法，也希望让大家喜欢的角色有更多上场的机会！

I understand how disappointing it is to invest so much in an Awakener, only to struggle to find a place for them after the game changes.

New modes, stages, story arcs, and even realm changes or buffs can all affect which Awakeners perform well. The game has to keep moving forward, so I can't promise there will never be shifts like this. But we do want every Awakener to have something unique to offer and a chance to shine, whatever the version. That's why we've kept buffing and adjusting characters over the years, though it does take time.

You've also raised another important point: having characters you've built, but not enough enjoyable content to use them in. Once we're through the major updates we're currently preparing over these next few months, we'll put more effort into new game modes. We want to give you more reasons to bring out the characters you love!

我理解，你在意的是卡手和运转不顺，而不只是数值够不够高。不过，目前我们不会直接取消这项抽牌代价。他的强大能力正是以此为交换，如何承担和缓解这个风险、在进攻与防守之间取舍，是他的核心玩法。

因此，他确实不像茉夏这类唤醒体那样爽快，这是我们选择的另一种体验。但有意设置代价，并不意味着所有不顺手的地方都理所当然。负誓·奥吉尔的设计确实引起了不少争议，我们也会从这些反馈中继续寻找更好的平衡方式，在保留唤醒体特色的同时，兼顾乐趣、自由度、策略、叙事与强度。

I understand that you're concerned about awkward hands and how difficult it feels to keep his kit running, not just his numbers. For now, though, we won't simply remove the draw penalty. That cost is part of what allows his abilities to be so powerful. Managing that risk and weighing offense against defense are central to his playstyle.

He won't feel as straightforward or immediately satisfying as someone like Mouchite, and that difference is intentional. But that doesn't mean every frustrating part of playing him is justified. Clearly, Oathbound Ogier's design has been divisive. We'll keep learning from this feedback and looking for better ways to balance fun, freedom, strategy, storytelling, and power while preserving what makes each Awakener distinct.

这是个有趣的建议！我们记下来了！
That’s an interesting idea! We’ve noted it down!
messages.prev:
One of the things which I really enjoy in Morimens is using the large amount of Awakeners to make and use a bunch of different teams. (Even if it is difficult to get the right ones for a team sometimes, and all of my Awakeners are probably weaker than they could be if I focused my resources on just one team.) So I loved the mechanics in the last levels of the arc 1 chapters that gave bonuses to specific realms, and the unique mechanics of the different versions of the gaze in chapter 9 which required unusual strategies to deal with, encouraging me to use different teams to clear different levels. I would like to see more of those sort of things in the future.

On the other hand, Astral Reign seems... very unfriendly to some strategies. Everything switch to Gaze after a few turns shuts down counter (as others have pointed out), Bottomless Scar makes healing (including a large part of the Caro realm) much weaker, and Arithmetica Harmony makes playing tons of cards in one turn nearly impossible. I'd believe it if I was told there was some sort of game-breaking combos or strategies that more experienced players were using which these were meant to curb, but as someone who isn't as experienced or skilled in the game, from my perspective it just shuts down strategies and means that my Helot: Catena based team is way weaker than it was in Faded Legacy. I hope that those mechanics don't return in arc 3 or future rulesets, maybe with some other way of stopping fully game-breaking stuff which doesn't stop almost any use of some strategies.

One of my favorite things in any roguelike is the gradual growing in power during the run, and getting stuff like relics during a level is great for that; one of my least favorite parts of Astral Reign is that Rouse is per-battle in posse, because of this. I do love the Dimensional images though!

我真正喜欢 Morimens 的一件事是使用大量的觉醒者来组建和使用一堆不同的团队。 （即使有时很难为一个团队找到合适的觉醒者，而且如果我将资源集中在一个团队上，我的所有觉醒者可能都比他们要弱。）所以我喜欢弧线1章节最后关卡中为特定领域提供奖励的机制，以及第9章中不同版本凝视的独特机制，这需要不寻常的策略来处理，鼓励我使用不同的团队来清除不同的级别。我希望将来能看到更多这样的事情。
另一方面，星界王朝似乎……对某些策略非常不友好。几回合后一切都会切换到凝视，从而关闭计数器（正如其他人指出的那样），无底伤疤使治疗（包括卡罗领域的很大一部分）变得更弱，而算术和谐使一回合打出大量牌几乎不可能。如果有人告诉我有某种破坏游戏的连击或策略，经验丰富的玩家正在使用这些组合或策略，这些组合或策略是为了遏制，但作为一个在游戏中经验不足或技术不那么丰富的人，从我的角度来看，它只是关闭了策略，意味着我的 Helot: Catena 团队比《褪色的遗产》中的团队要弱得多。我希望这些机制不会在 Arc 3 或未来的规则集中回归，也许会通过其他方式来阻止完全破坏游戏的东西，而这不会阻止几乎任何策略的使用。

在任何 Roguelike 游戏中，我最喜欢的事情之一就是在奔跑过程中力量逐渐增强，在关卡中获得诸如圣物之类的东西对此非常有用； 《星界王朝》中我最不喜欢的部分之一是，劳斯每场战斗都会以团队的形式出现，正因为如此。不过我确实喜欢立体图像！

op.content:
Today, it's finally Aequor's turn!<:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777><:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777><:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777>

Following the community's feedback over the past few days, we've also taken another look at Aequor. Benthos: Aequor's issues may be less pronounced than those of the other second-generation realms, but there's still room for improvement!

Aequor has always been a realm built around growing stronger throughout a battle. Currently, however, Raging Waves in both versions of the realm focuses too heavily on burst damage. We want it to offer valuable offensive opportunities for more team compositions and be worth using more actively even early in a battle. With that in mind, we're planning three changes:

### 1. Strengthening Classic Aequor's Pure Aequor

At the start of each battle, **increase the Tentacle Limit by an additional 1**.

This will let Pure Aequor support more Tentacles and further build on its distinctive strength in Tentacle combat!

### 2. Adding a Scaling Effect to Classic Aequor's Raging Waves

Each stance switch will **increase the Final DMG dealt by Tentacle Dominion and Tentacle Assembly by 25% for the rest of the battle**.

Switching stances will help with your immediate offensive and defensive plans while also building up stronger Tentacle attacks for later.

### 3. Broadening the Benefits of Benthos: Raging Waves

Each stance switch will **increase the team's DMG Amplification by 25% for the rest of the battle**.

We hope this more broadly useful bonus will help more Awakeners benefit from Raging Waves and open up more team-building options for Benthos: Aequor. Together with the Realm Charge mechanic introduced on Day 1, this should give you more to consider when deciding when to switch stances, save charges, and launch an attack.

With these changes as our foundation, we'll continue reviewing the balance and performance of individual Awakeners. We hope Keepers who love Aequor will enjoy these adjustments!

messages.content:
> *These changes are still planned. Please refer to the official patch notes for the final implementation details.*

## 第七天：深海界域

今天，终于轮到深海了！<:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777><:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777><:realm_aequor:1437283645051375777>

基于社区这几天的反馈，我们也重新审视了深海界域。相比其他二代界域，晦瞑·深海的问题或许没那么显著，但仍然有改进空间！

深海一直是一个强调成长的界域，但目前两种深海界域的怒涛姿态都过于侧重爆发。我们希望怒涛能为更多配队提供有价值的进攻机会，也值得在战斗前期更积极地使用。因此，我们计划带来三项调整：

### 1. 加强经典·深海的「至纯深海」

每场战斗开始时，**额外使触腕上限 +1**。

让至纯深海能够容纳更多触腕，进一步发挥触腕作战的独特优势！

### 2. 为经典·深海的「怒涛姿态」加入成长效果

每次切换，都会使本场战斗中**「触腕统御」与「触腕集结」造成的最终伤害提高 25%**。

让姿态切换不仅服务于眼前的攻防安排，也为后续的触腕进攻积累更强的力量。

### 3. 扩大晦瞑·深海「晦瞑·怒涛姿态」的收益范围

每次切换，都会使本场战斗中**队伍的伤害强效提高 25%**。

我们希望这份更通用的加成，能让更多唤醒体从怒涛姿态中获益，为晦瞑·深海带来更多配队选择。结合第一天介绍的界域充能机制，何时切换姿态、积攒充能、发起进攻，也将有更多值得考量的空间。

我们会以这些改动为基础，进一步审视各位唤醒体的平衡表现。希望喜欢深海界域的守密人会喜欢这次调整！

> *以上为计划中的调整，具体实装内容请以版本公告为准。*

一启的设计确实有不少争议。我们不希望被动能力过多地散落在不同地方，让大家更难记住和理解。因此，我们目前的做法是：一启即使没有刻意堆叠特定属性，也能提供基础收益；如果围绕这个属性配装，则能获得更多奖励。

我们也可以像第一篇的一些设计那样，把技能组中的部分功能放进启灵。但我们更希望未启灵时，角色的核心机制就尽可能完整，避免缺少某个启灵，基础体验或整个流派就难以成立。

至于为什么一些角色追求的属性，看起来与定位不那么一致，这是为了让配装有更多差异和取舍。如果同一定位的唤醒体都追求同样的属性，选择就会变得单调。我们希望通过属性转换，让原本不直观相关的属性也能服务于角色的能力，带来更多样的搭配。

The design of the first Enlightenment has certainly been controversial. We don't want too many passive abilities scattered across different parts of a kit, making them harder to remember and understand. Our current approach is for the first Enlightenment to provide a baseline benefit even without deliberately stacking a particular stat, with additional rewards if you build around it.

We could also place individual kit functions behind Enlightenments, as some Arc 1 designs did. But we would rather keep an Awakener's core mechanics as complete as possible without Enlightenments, so that missing a particular one doesn't undermine the basic experience or prevent a playstyle from working.

As for why some Awakeners prioritize stats that don't seem like an obvious fit for their role, the aim is to create more variety and trade-offs in their builds. If everyone in the same role pursued the same stats, those choices would become repetitive. Through stat conversion, we want less obvious stats to support an Awakener's abilities and open up different builds.

这些数值加成，确实是为了补偿冷却等限制带来的灵活性损失，也让二代界域拥有不同的优势。因此，我们需要把收益与限制放在一起衡量，而不只是单独比较属性数值。

但补偿是否恰当、经典界域是否仍有足够的竞争力，确实需要持续检验。这也是我们最近仍在加强经典界域与旧唤醒体的原因：我们希望它们继续有用武之地。

至于我们是否真正做到了这一点，就让时间和后续的实际调整来证明吧。

These stat bonuses are indeed intended to compensate for the loss of flexibility caused by cooldowns and other restrictions, while giving second-generation realms different strengths. That's why we need to assess their benefits and limitations together, rather than compare the stat bonuses in isolation.

But whether that compensation is appropriate, and whether classic realms remain competitive enough, are questions we need to keep evaluating. That's also why we're continuing to strengthen classic realms and older Awakeners: we want them to retain a meaningful place in the game.

As for whether we truly deliver on that goal, we'll let time and the changes we make speak for themselves.

messages.content:
谢谢你的建议。投入了不少界域精通，却可能整场都没触发，这种失落我完全理解。

最初我们考虑过类似方案，但担心额外的计数与概率变化会让规则更复杂。加入之后，也需要考虑暴击等其他随机机制是否采用类似规则。如果还要保持原本的长期期望收益，就需要重新调整基础触发概率。这样确实能减少连续不触发的情况，但也会改变原本的随机体验，有些守密人会欢迎，另一些则未必喜欢。

所以目前我们没有决定采用这个方案，但你指出的问题我们明白。未来设计时，我们会尽量避免让一项属性的投入过于依赖这种随机触发。

Thank you for the suggestion. I completely understand how disappointing it feels to invest heavily in Realm Mastery and potentially go an entire battle without a single trigger.

We considered a similar approach early on, but were concerned that the extra tracking and changing probabilities would make the rules more complicated. We'd also need to consider whether other random mechanics, such as critical hits, should follow similar rules. If we wanted to preserve the same long-term expected benefit, we'd need to rebalance the base trigger chance. This would reduce streaks of failed triggers, but also change the experience of randomness. Some Keepers would welcome that, while others might not.

So we haven't decided to adopt this approach, but we understand the issue you're raising. In future designs, we'll try to avoid making investment in a stat depend too heavily on this kind of random trigger.

messages.content:
对于经典·深海，这项提升确实只作用于触腕在回合结束时的自动攻击。

对于晦瞑·深海，伤害强效加成则作用于全队，主要让不依赖触腕伤害的队伍受益，同时也会为基础触腕伤害带来少量提升。

我理解你的担忧。增加新的能力时，我们都会考虑它对现有唤醒体价值的影响。界域机制会影响整个队伍的构筑，因此通常也需要占据一定的强度比重，但这个比例是否合适，仍然需要持续评估。

至于原初·混沌，虽然它改变了钥令的使用方式，但并没有引入新的专属资源。钥令与钥能本身也能服务于其他界域，因此相关联动很难像胚胎、触腕或超维空间那样，形成鲜明的专属特色。

在唤醒体的设计上，我们仍然延续经典·混沌的思路，希望他们的能力更纯粹，不必围绕某种界域专属资源才能发挥作用。

原初·混沌的核心优势，应该体现在这些随机钥令本身的强度上。我们后续计划加强这部分，让随机得到的钥令更值得使用。这项调整会让所有界域受益，而原初·混沌拥有更多钥令触发机会，也会从中获得更多收益。

I understand your concern. Whenever we add new abilities, we consider how they may affect the value of existing Awakeners. Realm mechanics shape the entire team's composition, so they generally need to account for a meaningful share of its strength. Whether that share is appropriate still needs ongoing evaluation.

As for Primordia: Chaos, it changes how Posses are used without introducing a new realm-exclusive resource. Posses and Keyflare also serve other realms, so interactions built around them are less distinctly realm-specific than those involving Embryos, Tentacles, or Ultra Space.

For its Awakeners, we're continuing the approach of classic Chaos: keeping their abilities more self-contained, without needing to revolve around a realm-exclusive resource to function.

Primordia: Chaos's core advantage should come from the strength of the random Posses themselves. We plan to improve this by making those random Posses more worthwhile to use. This will benefit all realms, while Primordia: Chaos will gain more from its greater number of Posse activations.

op.content:
Now, let's turn our attention to Ultra!

Classic Ultra emphasizes flexible control over Ultra Space, while Singularity: Ultra makes the choice of which Command Cards to place there more important through Singularity Beacon. Today, we're planning three changes to improve the Ultra experience:

1. **Removing classic Ultra's mixed-realm penalty**
   In mixed-realm teams, damage, Shield, HP recovery, Keyflare, Aliemus, STR changes, Poison, Counter, and Bleed effects during Ultra Turns will no longer be reduced by 25%.

2. **Updating classic Ultra's Pure Ultra effect**
   The effect that removes the penalty above will be replaced: during the first turn of each battle, the first **2** Command Cards played can both trigger Dimension Shuttle. The doubled Realm Mastery effect remains unchanged.

3. **Improving Annihilation in Singularity: Ultra**
   Command Cards retrieved through Annihilation will have their **Arithmetica cost set to 0**!

These changes will make classic Ultra more suited to mixed-realm teams, while allowing Pure Ultra to reach its Ultra Turn sooner and handle minion battles more easily. Together with the Realm Charge mechanic introduced on Day 1, Singularity: Ultra will also gain stronger tactical opportunities outside Ultra Turns.

We hope you enjoy these changes!
op.tr:
现在，让我们把注意力转向Ultra！

Classic Ultra强调对Ultra Space的灵活控制，而Singularity: Ultra则通过Singularity Beacon让选择放置哪些命令卡变得更加重要。今天，我们计划进行三项更改来改善 Ultra 体验：

1. **删除经典 Ultra 的混合领域惩罚**
   在混合领域团队中，超级回合期间的伤害、护盾、生命恢复、钥匙耀斑、阿里穆斯、力量变化、中毒、反击和流血效果将不再减少 25%。

2. **更新经典Ultra的Pure Ultra效果**
   取消上述惩罚的效果将被替换为：每场战斗的第一个回合中，打出的前**2**张指令卡都可以触发次元穿梭。双倍领域掌握效果保持不变。

3. **改进奇点湮灭：超级**
   通过歼灭获取的命令卡的**算术成本将设置为 0**！
这些变化将使经典 Ultra 更适合混合领域团队，同时让 Pure Ultra 更快地达到 Ultra Turn 并更轻松地处理小兵战斗。与第一天引入的领域冲锋机制一起，奇点：终极还将在终极回合之外获得更强大的战术机会。

我们希望您喜欢这些变化！

messages.content: Day 6: Ultra Realm
messages.tr: 第六天：超境界

messages.content:
## 第六天：超维界域

现在，让我们把目光转向超维界域！

经典·超维强调灵活控制超维空间，奇点·超维则通过「奇点信标」，让放入哪张指令卡变得更加重要。今天，我们计划带来三项调整来改善超维界域的体验：

1. **取消经典·超维的混编惩罚**
   混编时，超维回合内的伤害、护盾、生命回复、银钥能量、狂气、力量变化、中毒、反击和出血效果，不再降低 25%。

2. **调整经典·超维的「至纯超维」**
   原本免除上述惩罚的效果，替换为：每场战斗的首个回合内，前 2 张打出的指令卡都能触发「维度穿梭」。界域精通效果翻倍保持不变。

3. **加强奇点·超维的「湮灭」**
   使用「湮灭」取出的指令卡，算力消耗变为 0！

这些调整将让经典·超维更适合混编，同时让至纯超维更早迎来超维回合，能更轻松地处理爪牙战。而奇点·超维则能结合第一天介绍的界域充能机制，在超维回合之外创造更强的战术机会。

希望大家会喜欢！

谢谢你喜欢我们设计的跃迁效果，设计师看到一定会很高兴！你举的这些例子确实体现了跃迁的价值：选择每回合的首张牌时，需要权衡眼前的效果和超维空间中的卡牌。这种取舍确实存在。

但继续扩展时，我们也遇到了难题：每回合全队都在争取这一次机会。如果跃迁只是让卡牌换一种效果，影响可能比较有限；如果给予很强的奖励，不同唤醒体又会争抢首张牌的位置。因此，我们逐渐尝试把更多选择放在指令卡本身，而不再主要围绕这一个机会展开设计。当然，这并不意味着原本的取舍没有价值，也不意味着数值增强就能替代它。

超维界域本身的机制很强，但要在其中做出细腻、多样的差异并不容易。我们也明白，一些新唤醒体的卡牌与超维机制缺少直接联系，会让界域特色变淡。这确实是需要继续改进的地方，我们会探索怎样在未来的设计中，更好地体现这种联系和取舍。

Thank you for appreciating the Leap effects we designed. Our designers will be happy to hear that! Your examples do show what makes Leap valuable: choosing the first card of each turn means weighing its immediate effect against the card you're placing in Ultra Space. That trade-off is real.

But as we expanded on the mechanic, we also ran into a difficulty: the whole team competes for that one opportunity each turn. If Leap simply gives a card an alternative effect, its impact can be fairly limited; if the reward is very strong, different Awakeners compete for that first-card slot. So we gradually shifted toward putting more choices into the Command Cards themselves, rather than designing primarily around that single opportunity. Of course, this doesn't mean the original trade-offs had no value, or that bigger numbers can replace them.

Ultra's core mechanics are powerful, but creating subtle, varied interactions within them isn't easy. We also understand that when some new Awakeners' cards have little direct connection to Ultra's mechanics, the realm's identity can feel weaker. That is something we need to keep improving, and we'll explore ways to better express those connections and trade-offs in future designs.

We won't be making this change. Arachne is the first Singularity: Ultra Awakener, and her story led us to give her the ability to control fate. That happened to coincide with the new realm's introduction; it wasn't a case of taking an ability out of the realm and putting it into her kit.

Future Singularity: Ultra Awakeners will still offer powerful gameplay through the realm's mechanics and benefit from these buffs, while Arachne's degree of control will remain a relatively distinctive part of her kit.

We understand the desire for greater control, but we won't offer complete freedom of control over every mechanic. We've discussed the reasoning behind this several times over the past few days, and you're welcome to look through those earlier conversations for more context on these decisions.

As the game continues to grow, some overlap is difficult to avoid. We can't make every ability of every Awakener entirely unique; that would make the game increasingly difficult to understand and leave less common ground for synergies. But that doesn't mean uniqueness isn't important. Each Awakener's distinctive play experience is something we've always wanted to protect, and we'll be more mindful of that.

第一天的改进中，我们已经为所有二代界域的主动能力引入了更灵活的界域充能机制：战斗开始时获得 3 点，每回合结束时积攒 1 点，每次使用消耗 3 点，最多储存 5 点。

积攒到 5 点后，你可以连续两个回合使用「湮灭」，延缓超维回合的到来；也可以保留一次可用机会，同时继续积攒充能，直到达到上限。我们希望通过这种方式提供一定的控制弹性。

In the Day 1 changes, we introduced a more flexible Realm Charge system for the active abilities of all second-generation realms: you gain 3 points at the start of battle and 1 at the end of each turn. Each use costs 3 points, and you can store up to 5.

Once you've saved up 5 points, you can use Annihilation on two consecutive turns to delay entering an Ultra Turn. You can also keep one use available while continuing to accumulate charges until you reach the cap. This is how we aim to provide some flexibility in controlling the timing.

I've run into many problems running my well built Wanda team, and I have no trouble surviving or otherwise dealing direct damage, but the 6 turn gaze makes fights that would otherwise be trivial thanks to her consistent STR down turn into dps races because "the window for doing damage is going away."

BIAV introduced rouse scaling for both Poison and Counter compositions to perform despite the limits on both those effects - however, you can only rouse once a turn, and you're not at your full power right away. Counter compositions are left at the mercy of the stage design (if the enemy does multi attack hits often) and they're basically unplayable above SS difficulty. Is the intended vision for how these compositions fight against Arc 2 battles to borrow damage from one of the newer Awakeners instead of playing to their strengths?

BIAV had Arc 2 rules made because the tempo of the game became way too fast in Arc 1 - but this part specifically feels like it encourages that kind of tempo instead.

If the soft turn limit (6 turns for intention to turn into gaze) were to be adjusted, increased to something more forgiving like 12 or 13 turns, I think we'd see a lot more Counter/Poison clears on the higher difficulties without affecting the performance of compositions that directly do damage themselves.

messages.content:
这里先澄清一下：「重现」一直不会获得同调率，但自动战斗仍然可以获得，手动战斗则积累得更快。

我们希望同调率记录的是你真正与唤醒体共同战斗的时间。它是一份伴随这个过程的额外回报，可以在自然游玩时逐渐积累，并不是希望大家为了它反复刷同一关。当然，我理解，当两种方式的收益不同，也会让你觉得不用手动就有所损失。

我们重视大家的时间，这也是让「超验存在」支持重现的原因。不过，同调率承载的是另一种体验，我们仍希望为这份共同战斗、逐渐熟悉的过程保留一些空间。

Let me clarify one point first: replay clears have never granted Synchronization, but auto-battles still do, and manual battles build it faster.

We want Synchronization to reflect the time you actually spend fighting alongside your Awakeners. It's an additional reward for that experience, something you can gradually earn through normal play. Our intention isn't to make everyone repeatedly farm the same stage for it. That said, I understand that when the rewards differ, choosing not to play manually can feel like missing out.
We value Keepers' time, which is why we made replay clears available for the Transcendent Existence stages.

Synchronization serves a different purpose, though, and we'd still like to preserve some space for that experience of fighting together and gradually growing closer.

Primero, quisiera aclarar algo: completar una fase de forma instantánea nunca ha otorgado Sincronización. El combate automático sí la otorga, y el combate manual permite acumularla más rápido.

Queremos que la Sincronización refleje el tiempo que realmente pasas luchando junto a tus despertadores. Es una recompensa adicional por esa experiencia, que puedes ir acumulando mientras juegas con normalidad. Nuestra intención no es que repitas la misma fase una y otra vez solo para conseguirla. Aun así, entiendo que, cuando las recompensas son distintas, elegir no jugar manualmente pueda sentirse como perder algo.

Valoramos el tiempo de los guardianes, y precisamente por eso permitimos completar de forma instantánea las fases de Existencias Trascendentes. Sin embargo, la Sincronización busca ofrecer una experiencia diferente, y queremos conservar un espacio para ese proceso de luchar juntos e ir estrechando el vínculo.

在创作某一位唤醒体时，我们不会从性别比例出发，而是深入角色本身的故事、设定与能力。

但在长期规划上，我们希望维持过往整体的男女角色比例，没有必要时不会轻易改变。过去两年，产能安排、较长的制作周期，以及中途调整的困难，确实让实际推出的节奏与原本计划有了一些偏差。

我们理解，连续较长时间等不到自己期待的角色，会让人失落。未来我们会更留意这方面的安排，尽可能让社区对角色推出的节奏保持稳定的预期。

When creating an individual Awakener, we don't start with a gender ratio in mind. We focus on the character's story, background, and abilities.

For our long-term planning, however, we aim to maintain our historical overall ratio of male and female characters, rather than change it without a clear reason. Over the past two years, production capacity, long development cycles, and the difficulty of making changes mid-production have caused the actual release schedule to deviate somewhat from our plans.

We understand that waiting a long time for the kinds of characters you look forward to can be disappointing. We'll pay closer attention to these arrangements in the future, so the community can have more consistent expectations about our character releases.

posts.title: Day 5: Crimson Frenzy
posts.titleTr: 第五天：猩红狂热

op.content:
We know that the biggest shortcoming of Propagation: Caro is that it hasn't adequately supported classic Caro Awakeners. Keepers who love Caro have shared plenty of feedback, and now it's time to address these issues!

### 1. Giving classic Caro access to Crimson Frenzy

In classic Caro, directly using an Embryo or Scion of Purity will grant the selected Awakener **10 stacks of Crimson Frenzy**.

"Propagation Fiesta" will be renamed "Crimson Frenzy," with its effects unchanged: each stack increases the final effectiveness of the Awakener's next Exalt this turn by **1%** for the following effects: damage, fixed STR increases, Tentacle DMG increases, fixed Poison, fixed Counter, fixed Shield, fixed healing, and STR reduction.

### 2. Additional benefits for certain Caro Awakeners

- **Aigis**: Each stack of Crimson Frenzy adds **0.2%** to the final damage bonus that the Exalt, Eye of Eternity, grants all Awakeners for the current turn.
- **Faint**: Each stack of Crimson Frenzy adds **1%** to the Death Resistance granted by the Exalt, Cradle of Stars.
- **Helot: Catena**: Each stack of Crimson Frenzy adds **0.25%** to the Bleed ratio applied by the direct damage of the Exalt, Sanguine Fetters.
- **Pickman**: Each stack of Crimson Frenzy adds **0.2%** to the bonus to Exalt final damage, Shield, and healing granted by the Exalt, Truth in Delusion.
- **Thais**: For every **10 stacks of Crimson Frenzy**, Command Cards copied by the Exalt, Ritual of Abundance, gain **1 stack of Temporary Enhancement**.
op.tr:
我们知道《Propagation: Caro》最大的缺点是它没有充分支持经典的卡罗觉醒者。喜爱卡罗的饲养员分享了大量反馈，现在是时候解决这些问题了！

### 1. 为经典卡罗提供猩红疯狂的访问权限

在经典卡罗中，直接使用纯洁之胚胎或接穗将授予选定的觉醒者**10 层猩红狂乱**。

“传播嘉年华”将更名为“猩红狂乱”，其效果不变：每次叠加都会使觉醒者本回合下一次崇拜的最终效果提高**1%**，效果如下：伤害、固定力量增加、触手伤害增加、固定毒药、固定反击、固定护盾、固定治疗和力量减少。

### 2. 某些卡罗觉醒者的额外好处

- **艾吉斯**：每层猩红狂乱都会使永恒之眼尊崇者在当前回合给予所有觉醒者的最终伤害加成增加**0.2%**。
- **微弱**：每层猩红狂乱都会为星辰摇篮尊者授予的死亡抗性增加**1%**。
- **Helot：连锁**：每层猩红狂乱都会增加 **0.25%** 至尊者、血色羁绊的直接伤害所造成的流血率。
- **皮克曼**：每层猩红狂乱都会增加 **0.2%** 至尊崇最终伤害、护盾和由尊崇、妄想中的真理所授予的治疗效果。
- **泰人**：每**10层猩红狂乱**，由尊者、丰盛仪式复制的命令卡，获得**1层临时增强**。

messages.content:
### 3. Fixes and buffs for Helot

During our review, we found two bugs in the current version: both the Basic Strike damage bonus gained through Devour and the damage bonus from Helot's talent are incorrectly affected by Exalt final damage bonuses.

Alongside fixing these interactions, we will incorporate their benefits into her intended mechanics and strengthen them further, making Helot stronger than she is now in almost all situations.

**Talent: Pain Sigil**

- **New effect**: Surviving Impasse grants Helot an additional temporary **15%** final damage bonus. Each stack of Crimson Frenzy adds another **0.6%** to this new bonus.
- **Existing effect improved**: For every **1%** DMG Amplification Helot has, the temporary final damage bonus granted by Surviving Impasse increases from **0.3% to 0.6%**.

**Exalt: Surviving Impasse**

- The Basic Strike damage bonus gained through Devour increases from **10% to 15%**.

We hope these changes will help both classic Caro and Propagation: Caro feel more complete and cohesive, opening up more possibilities for team compositions and builds. We look forward to hearing your feedback!
messages.tr:
### 3. Helot 的修复和增强

在我们的审核中，我们发现当前版本中的两个错误：通过吞噬获得的基本打击伤害加成和黑洛特天赋的伤害加成都错误地受到了崇拜最终伤害加成的影响。

除了修复这些相互作用之外，我们还将把它们的好处融入到她的预期机制中，并进一步加强它们，使黑洛特在几乎所有情况下都比现在更强大。

**天赋：痛苦印记**

- **新效果**：幸存的僵局给予Helot额外的临时**15%**最终伤害加成。每层猩红狂乱都会为这个新奖励增加 **0.6%**。
- **现有效果改进**：苦劳每拥有**1%**伤害增幅，绝境求生给予的临时最终伤害加成从**0.3%增加到0.6%**。

**崇拜：摆脱僵局**

- 通过吞噬获得的基本打击伤害加成从 **10% 增加到 15%**。

我们希望这些变化将有助于经典卡罗和传播：卡罗感觉更加完整和有凝聚力，为团队组成和构建提供更多可能性。我们期待听到您的反馈！

messages.content:
## 第五天：猩红狂热

我们知道，繁育·血肉最大的遗憾，就是没能很好地支持经典·血肉唤醒体。喜欢血肉界域的守密人已经给了我们大量反馈，现在，是时候着手解决这些问题了！

### 1. 让经典·血肉也能获得「猩红狂热」

在经典·血肉中，直接使用「胚胎」或「圣洁之子」，将使选中的唤醒体获得 **10 层「猩红狂热」**。

「繁育庆典」将重新命名为「猩红狂热」，效果不变：每层使该唤醒体本回合下一次狂气爆发的伤害，以及固定力量提高、触腕伤害提高、固定中毒、固定反击、固定护盾、固定生命回复和力量降低类效果的最终效果提高 **1%**。

### 2. 让部分血肉唤醒体获得额外支持

- **艾继丝**：每层「猩红狂热」使狂气爆发「万古之眸」在本回合内额外让所有唤醒体造成的最终伤害提高 **0.2%**。
- **菲茵特**：每层「猩红狂热」使狂气爆发「星之摇篮」获得的死亡抵抗 **+1%**。
- **血链·希洛**：每层「猩红狂热」使狂气爆发「缚身锁链」主动伤害附加的出血比例 **+0.25%**。
- **皮克曼**：每层「猩红狂热」使狂气爆发「真实，亦是幻想」提供的「狂气爆发最终伤害、护盾、生命回复提高」效果 **+0.2%**。
- **泰旖丝**：每 **10 层「猩红狂热」**使狂气爆发「丰穰之仪」复制的指令卡获得 **1 层「临时强化」**。

### 3. 希洛的修复与增强

检查中我们发现，当前版本的希洛有两处异常：吞噬获得的基础打击伤害加成，以及天赋带来的增伤效果，都会错误地受到狂气爆发最终伤害加成的影响。

我们会在修复这两处异常的同时，将这部分收益吸收到正式机制中，并进一步增强，让希洛在几乎所有情况下都比现在更强。

**天赋「痛苦刻痕」：**

- **新增效果**：狂气爆发「绝境求生」额外使希洛的临时最终伤害提高 **15%**；每层「猩红狂热」使这项新增加成额外提高 **0.6%**。
- **原有效果增强**：自身每 **1%** 伤害强效属性，使「绝境求生」带来的临时最终伤害加成从 **0.3% 提高至 0.6%**。

**狂气爆发「绝境求生」：**

- 吞噬获得的基础打击伤害加成从 **10% 提高至 15%**。

希望这些改动能让经典·血肉与繁育·血肉都更加完整、协调，为大家带来更多配队与构筑的可能。期待大家的进一步反馈！

我们会再看看杜勒赛因，以及大家反馈的其他一些唤醒体，但目前还不能保证会做出调整。

We'll take another look at Doresain and some of the other Awakeners Keepers have raised concerns about, but we can't promise any changes at this stage.

谢谢你的反馈。游戏中可以叠加的机制很多，我们经常面对这样的两难：效果太强，会让人觉得必须抽；效果太弱，又会让人觉得不值得投入。我们一直在寻找更可持续维护、也能让大家对启灵投入感到满意的设计方式。例如，我们会尽量将真正必要的能力放在不需要启灵就能获得的模组中，让角色在未启灵时也能拥有有特色的游玩体验。我们也会继续审视这些设计。

Thank you for the feedback. With so many interacting mechanics in the game, we often face a dilemma: if an effect is too strong, it can make pulling feel mandatory; if it's too weak, it can make the investment feel unrewarding. We're always looking for designs that are sustainable to maintain while making Enlightenment upgrades feel worthwhile. For example, we try to place essential abilities in modules that can be obtained without Enlightenment, so Awakeners can offer a distinctive gameplay experience even without it. We'll continue to review these designs.

messages.content:
我们目前不打算增加手动选择是否吞噬的功能。
我理解你说的冲突：保留理想的爆发顺序，与把有限的胚胎留给最需要的角色，有时无法同时做到。这种需要权衡的情况，确实是我们希望保留的战术取舍。
如果每一步都能自由选择，某些配队可能反而会形成固定的最优执行顺序，同时每次爆发都多一道操作。最初设计游戏时，我们也取消了部分同类卡牌肉鸽中的目标选择：看起来少了一个选择，却减少了操作负担，让大家能把精力放在其他决策上。
所以，我们会参考具体配队的体验，但不会只围绕某一套队伍设计通用机制，毕竟未来还会有更多唤醒体加入。

We don't currently plan to add a manual option to skip Devour.
I understand the conflict you're describing: keeping your preferred burst sequence and saving limited Embryos for the Awakener who needs them most aren't always both possible. That is a tactical trade-off we do want to preserve.
If every step can be freely adjusted, some teams may simply end up following a fixed optimal sequence, while every Exalt requires an additional input. When we first designed the game, we also left out target selection found in some other deckbuilding roguelikes. On the surface, that removed a choice, but it reduced the number of inputs and let Keepers focus on other decisions.
So we'll take specific team experiences into account, but we won't design shared mechanics solely around one composition, especially with more Awakeners still to come.

messages.prev: 感觉目前血肉界域的调整有点类似于水多了加面，面多了加水，只是一味堆叠数值会让设计陷入危险，血肉界域需要一些有趣、不卡手的机制。同时，不仅仅是胚胎，狂气，界域本身很多角色都有的卖血机制在星辰篇与无底创痕有一定冲突，导致很多时候掉血的风险相当之高，而与此同时这样的卖血机制却在血肉c里大范围使用。你当然可以选择卡住玩家的胚胎，熔炉cd，但与深海不同，血肉界域的角色一方面生存普遍不如深海，与此同时还有那个要命的百分比卖血机制，无疑给长线作战雪上加霜。或许可以考虑引入尖塔的奥斯提，有某个特定的角色能用熔炉的血量优先抵抗敌方伤害，或者改为界域特色，一方面可以适配大量血肉角色的卖血机制，不用担心无底创痕。并且新版本血肉界域吞噬甚至无法获得护盾，回血造成的无底创痕更加雪上加霜。玩家永远也无法真正安心地享受到收益，甚至血条越厚，这样的紧张感越严重，永远需要寻找更稳妥、更强力的伤害。或者，在后续的角色设计上，让我们和扣血的卡牌说再见，寻找新的，风险小的，更加有血肉特色的存在。

messages.content:
凝视开始加入症状卡，通常是在提醒这场战斗已经持续了较长时间。它的作用之一，是让长期生存和资源积攒也需要付出代价。
如果只要有足够的生存能力，就能无限拖延、积攒资源，甚至故意不击杀敌人，那么每场战斗都可能趋向这种保守的打法。这当然是一种合理的策略，但我们也不希望喜欢爽快战斗的守密人，觉得自己不这样做就吃亏。
我们仍在小心地平衡这两种体验，症状卡是其中一个重要机制。不过，你提到的问题也确实需要关注：目前不同队伍处理道中敌人的难度，可能存在过大的差异。我们希望保留各自的长短处，但不希望差异过于极端，这部分也需要持续改进。

When Gaze starts adding Symptom cards, it generally signals that a battle has been going on for a while. One of its purposes is to ensure that prolonging a fight and stockpiling resources also come at a cost.
If sufficient sustain lets a team stall indefinitely, accumulate resources, and even deliberately avoid finishing enemies off, every battle could lean toward that conservative approach. That's a valid strategy, but we don't want Keepers who enjoy faster-paced combat to feel disadvantaged for not doing the same.
We're still carefully balancing these two experiences, and Symptom cards play an important role. That said, your concern is worth looking at: the difficulty of dealing with regular enemy encounters may currently vary too much between teams. We want to preserve their different strengths and weaknesses without letting those differences become too extreme. This is something we need to keep improving.

op.content:
Today's changes also come from everyone's feedback over the past two days. We'll keep listening and looking for ways to improve!

We understand that the Discover mechanic for Posses can discourage players from unlocking more of them, especially in Primordia: Chaos. Increased randomness can also make players feel more dependent on Time Reversal.

To help address these concerns without introducing a complicated system for customizing the Posse pool, we are planning two changes.

### 1. A stronger Archive Mark in Astral Reign

We want collecting more Posses to offer more substantial long-term benefits:

- **For the first 33 Posses unlocked:** Each one increases both Esoteric Research and Occult Research by **1%**.
- **For the 34th through 66th Posses unlocked:** Each additional one increases both by **2%**.

For comparison, the current effect grants a 1% increase to both for each of the first 50 Posses unlocked.

> **Esoteric Research:** Determines the strength of STR bonuses, Tentacle DMG, Shield, healing, and STR reduction effects provided by Relics, Orisons, and Posses.
> **Occult Research:** Determines the strength of flat-value Poison, Counter, Fixed DMG, and Bleed effects provided by Relics, Orisons, and Posses.

Compared with other realms, **Primordia: Chaos will benefit more significantly from this change.**

### 2. Five free uses of Time Reversal each day

**All Keepers will be able to use Time Reversal five times a day for free, whether or not they have purchased Premium Topics.**

We want to give everyone a reasonable opportunity to try again when dealing with randomness in battle, while keeping combat decisions meaningful.

> These changes are still in development. Please refer to the official update announcements for the final implementation.
op.tr:
今天的改变也是来自于这两天大家的反馈。我们将继续倾听并寻找改进的方法！

我们知道，“发现”的“队伍”机制可能会阻碍玩家解锁更多的队伍，尤其是在《原基：混沌》中。随机性的增加也会让玩家更加依赖时间逆转。

为了帮助解决这些问题而不引入复杂的系统来定制团队池，我们计划进行两项更改。

### 1. Astral Reign 中更强的档案标记

我们希望收集更多的财产来提供更实质性的长期利益：

- **对于前 33 个解锁的物品：** 每一个都会将深奥研究和神秘研究增加 **1%**。
- **对于解锁的第 34 至 66 个拥有：** 每增加一个，都会增加 **2%**。

相比之下，当前效果为前 50 个解锁的物品中的每一个都提供 1% 的增幅。

> **深奥研究：** 确定由遗物、奥里森和拥有者提供的 STR 加值、触手 DMG、护盾、治疗和 STR 降低效果的强度。
> **神秘学研究：** 确定遗物、奥里森和拥有物提供的固定值毒药、反击、固定 DMG 和流血效果的强度。

与其他领域相比，**原基：混沌将从这一变化中受益更显着。**

### 2. 每天免费使用五次时间逆转

**所有守护者每天都可以免费使用时间逆转五次，无论他们是否购买了高级主题。**

我们希望为每个人提供合理的机会在处理战斗中的随机性时再次尝试，同时保持战斗决策的意义。

> 这些更改仍在开发中。最终实施请以官方更新公告为准。

messages.content:
## 第三天：混沌与随机

今天的内容同样来自前两天大家的反馈，我们会继续聆听并想办法改进！

我们理解，钥令的发现机制可能让大家不愿解锁更多钥令，尤其是在原初·混沌中。同时，随机性的增加也可能让大家更依赖时序逆行。

为了缓解这些问题，同时避免引入复杂的钥令自定义配置，我们计划带来两项调整。

### 【1】强化星辰篇的「归档刻痕」

让收集更多钥令带来更充分的长期收益：

- **前33个钥令：** 每解锁1个，物象研究深度和灵识研究深度各提高 **1%**。
- **第34至66个钥令：** 每解锁1个，两项研究深度各提高 **2%**。

作为对比，当前效果是：前50个钥令，每解锁1个，两项研究深度各提高1%。

> **物象研究深度：** 影响造物、刻印、钥令提供的力量、触腕伤害、护盾、生命回复与力量降低类效果的强度。
> **灵识研究深度：** 影响造物、刻印、钥令造成的固定中毒、固定反击、固定伤害与固定出血类效果的强度。

相比较其他界域，**原初·混沌界域能够从中得到更显著的增强。**

### 【2】每天5次免费时序逆行

**无论是否购买核心课题，所有守密人每天都可以免费使用5次时序逆行。**

我们希望在保留战斗决策分量的同时，为大家提供适度的重来机会，更好地应对战斗中的随机性。

它的设计初衷，就是探索一种不同于围绕携带钥令反复使用的玩法。免费触发3–4次携带钥令，是我们为它保留的特色。不过，这样的收益可能仍不足以弥补你在掌控感上的缺失。

The Posse experience and strategy in Primordia: Chaos are indeed very different from classic Chaos, and I understand why you feel disappointed.
It was designed to explore a different playstyle from repeatedly using the Posse you bring into battle. The ability to trigger your equipped Posse 3–4 times for free is one of its distinctive benefits. Still, that benefit may not feel sufficient to make up for the loss of control you've described.
As for Propagation: Caro, yesterday's changes only addressed part of the problem. We're still looking into the other aspects!
There is a natural tension between control and randomness, and we want to keep exploring ways to strike a better balance across the game.

La experiencia y la estrategia de las llaves en Primordia: Chaos son, sin duda, muy diferentes de las de Chaos clásico, y entiendo por qué te sientes decepcionado.
Su diseño busca explorar un estilo de juego distinto al de usar repetidamente la llave que llevas equipada. Poder activar esa llave gratis entre 3 y 4 veces es una de las ventajas distintivas que hemos conservado. Aun así, es posible que esa ventaja no compense la pérdida de control que describes.
En cuanto a Propagation: Caro, los cambios de ayer solo abordaron una parte del problema. ¡Seguimos estudiando los demás aspectos!
Existe una tensión natural entre el control y el azar, y queremos seguir explorando formas de encontrar un mejor equilibrio entre ambos en el conjunto del juego.

messages.content:
原初·混沌的钥令多次触发机制与界域精通，会进一步放大钥令基础效果的收益。因此，研究深度提升对它的意义会更明显。其他界域使用钥令时同样能够受益，但一些搭配更看重的是钥令提供的角色专属层数或资源，而这些通常不受研究深度影响。
至于开场优势，确实，目前这一点是在星辰篇规则下成立的。未来每个篇章是否都会保留同样的效果，我们还在研究，暂时无法给出确切答案。但无论如何，我们都会努力在各篇章中维持平衡，避免让某个玩法流派完全失去发挥空间。让不同策略都有选择的价值，始终是我们的目标。

Primordia: Chaos's multiple Posse activations and Realm Mastery further amplify the benefits of Posses' base effects. This is why increased Research can have a more pronounced impact on it. Other realms benefit when using Posses too, but some team compositions place more value on character-specific stacks or resources provided by those Posses, which usually aren't affected by Research.
As for its early-battle advantage, you're right that this currently depends on the Astral Reign rules. We're still exploring how future arcs will work, so we can't yet give a definite answer on whether every arc will preserve the same advantage. Regardless, we'll strive to maintain balance within each arc and avoid leaving an entire playstyle without a viable place. Keeping a diverse range of strategies meaningful is always our goal.

messages.content:
是的，篇章规则的好处之一，就是让我们有机会结合社区反馈，在适当的时候调整游戏环境，寻找更好的解决方案。对于已经逐渐步入尾声的星辰篇，我们更倾向于先调整现有机制，而不是再引入一套新系统。更长期的解决方案，我们也会继续思考。

我非常认同你希望增加策略选择的想法。我们考虑的是：面对不确定性，并通过自己的决策逐渐掌握局面，本身就是成就感的一部分，就像克服困难带来的满足感一样。当一切都过于可控时，一些选择反而会失去意义。因此，我们希望保留有价值的不确定性，同时给玩家适当的应对手段，而不是从一开始就让所有结果都可以完全掌控。

经典·深海的姿态机制就是一个例子。设计之初，我们讨论过，希望玩家能够自由安排姿态，而不是只根据冷却来决定何时切换。在早期比较简单的游戏环境中，这样的设计还能形成取舍。但随着其他机制和组合不断增强，切换姿态逐渐变得非常容易，很多时候最优选择也趋于固定：平时保持静海，只有在集中输出时切换到怒涛。当掌控变得过于容易，原本希望提供的策略选择，也可能变成一套固定操作。

这并不意味着限制越多越好，也不意味着我们现在已经找到了理想的平衡。我们仍然需要认真看待大家感受到的不便，以及这些限制是否真的带来了有意义的选择。

我愿意把这些考虑讲出来，是希望大家了解我们如何理解问题、为什么做出这些决定，而不是要求大家接受或喜欢我们的设计。如果每次都只回答“意见收到了”，大家也很难判断自己的反馈究竟有没有被认真考虑。

与此同时，不同玩家的期待确实会有冲突，我们无法同时照做每一条建议。有时根据一部分反馈作出调整，才发现此前没有发声的玩家很珍惜原来的体验。我们前不久就犯过这样的错误。所以，我们需要继续听取不同意见，也为最终的设计取舍负责。

Yes. One advantage of using arc-specific rules is that they give us opportunities to adjust the game environment at appropriate points, informed by community feedback, and look for better solutions. With Astral Reign gradually approaching its conclusion, we would rather adjust existing mechanics than introduce another new system. We'll continue thinking about longer-term solutions as well.

I very much agree with your desire for more strategic choices. Our thinking is that facing uncertainty and gradually gaining control through your decisions can itself be rewarding, much like overcoming a challenge. When everything becomes too controllable, some choices can lose their meaning. We therefore want to preserve meaningful uncertainty while giving players appropriate ways to respond, rather than making every outcome fully controllable from the start.

The stance system in classic Aequor is one example. During its initial design, we wanted players to choose their stances freely rather than switch simply because a cooldown allowed it. In the simpler early-game environment, this could still create meaningful trade-offs. But as other mechanics and combinations grew stronger, switching stances became much easier, and the best choice often settled into a familiar pattern: stay in Tranquil Sea most of the time, then switch to Raging Waves for a burst of damage. When control becomes too easy, what was meant to be a strategic choice can turn into a fixed routine.

我非常同意你对更多战略选择的渴望。我们的想法是，面对不确定性并通过决策逐渐获得控制权本身就是有益的，就像克服挑战一样。当一切变得过于可控时，有些选择就会失去意义。因此，我们希望保留有意义的不确定性，同时为玩家提供适当的应对方式，而不是从一开始就让每个结果完全可控。
经典 Aequor 中的姿态系统就是一个例子。在最初的设计中，我们希望玩家能够自由选择自己的立场，而不是仅仅因为冷却时间允许而改变立场。在更简单的早期游戏环境中，这仍然可以产生有意义的权衡。但随着其他机制和组合变得更强，切换姿势变得更加容易，并且最佳选择通常会陷入熟悉的模式：大部分时间留在平静之海，然后切换到狂暴波浪以造成爆发性伤害。当控制变得太容易时，原本的战略选择就会变成固定的例行公事。

That doesn't mean more restrictions are always better, or that we've already found the right balance. We still need to take the friction players experience seriously and examine whether those restrictions actually create meaningful choices.
I share this reasoning because I want everyone to understand how we see these problems and why we make these decisions, not because I expect everyone to accept or enjoy our designs. If all we ever say is "We've noted your feedback," it's hard for anyone to tell whether their concerns have genuinely been considered.

At the same time, different players can want conflicting things, and we can't act on every suggestion simultaneously. Sometimes we make a change based on one set of feedback, only to discover that players who hadn't spoken up valued the original experience. We made a mistake like that not long ago. That's why we need to keep listening to different perspectives while taking responsibility for the design decisions we ultimately make.

我分享这个推理是因为我希望每个人都能理解我们如何看待这些问题以及我们为什么做出这些决定，而不是因为我希望每个人都能接受或喜欢我们的设计。如果我们只说“我们已经注意到您的反馈”，那么任何人都很难判断他们的担忧是否得到了真正的考虑。

同时，不同的参与者可能想要相互冲突的东西，我们不能同时对每一个建议采取行动。有时，我们根据一组反馈进行更改，却发现没有发言的玩家更看重最初的体验。不久前我们就犯过这样的错误。这就是为什么我们需要不断倾听不同的观点，同时对我们最终做出的设计决策负责。

是的，这是有意的设计方向。我们希望第一篇的一些唤醒体，仍然能够凭借这些能力在队伍中保有独特的价值。如果大多数新唤醒体也具备同样的能力，就会挤压他们的出场空间。不过，这并不意味着未来的新角色完全不会拥有易伤或虚弱，只是我们会更谨慎地控制这类能力的分配比例。
在第一篇中后期，队伍施加易伤和虚弱的能力往往超出了实际需求，以至于玩家几乎不再需要关注这两种状态的维持与安排。这也是我们希望改善的问题。

Yes, this is an intentional design direction. We want some Arc 1 Awakeners to retain a distinctive role in team compositions through these abilities. If most new Awakeners also had the same tools, that would leave fewer reasons to bring those earlier characters. This doesn't mean future characters won't have Vulnerability or Weakness, but we will be more selective about how widely we distribute these effects.
By the middle and later stages of Arc 1, teams could often apply far more Vulnerability and Weakness than they actually needed. As a result, players rarely had to think about when to apply or maintain these effects. This is another issue we want to address.

I understand your concern, especially when you need a defensive response and can't reliably access one. Primordia: Chaos is designed to trade some certainty for bonuses and capabilities in other areas. If your strategy relies more heavily on reliably using your equipped Posse, a classic Chaos team should remain a viable and meaningful option.

Second-generation realms weren't designed to outperform classic realms in every respect, and replacing classic realms entirely is not our goal. We want both to offer distinct strategic choices.

Grouping Posses into categories and ensuring that each random selection includes all three categories would indeed make the results more balanced. However, it would also reduce the chance of exciting outcomes where several similar effects appear together. Once this round of realm adjustments is live, we'll continue observing Primordia: Chaos's performance and assess whether further changes are needed.

我理解大家希望能排除一小部分钥令，让随机结果更符合队伍的需要。我们主要有两点考虑：
1.  不同队伍想排除的钥令可能不同。即使排除数量不多，也可能让每次编队都多出一项需要设置和维护的内容；一旦加入，之后也很难再撤回这层操作负担。
2.  当前确实有一些钥令表现不佳。对于那些大家普遍不愿选、希望优先排除的钥令，我们会优先考虑增强，让它们本身更有使用价值。

I understand why Keepers would like to exclude a small number of Posses to make random outcomes better suited to their teams. We have two main considerations:
1.  Different teams may want to exclude different Posses. Even with only a few exclusions, this could add another setting to configure and maintain for each team. Once introduced, that extra layer would be difficult to remove later.
2.  Some Posses are indeed underperforming. We'll prioritize considering buffs for those that Keepers consistently avoid or would most want to exclude, so they become more worthwhile choices in their own right.

在经典超维中，出牌规划的一个重要目的，是触发跃迁效果。而在奇点·超维中，规划的价值更多来自卡牌本身能够获得的「奇点信标」加成。因此，我们不再需要依靠跃迁、超距来承担同样的作用。
这样的设计也会让超维空间的资源分配更有取舍：哪些卡牌应该优先获得这份加成，会成为更重要的决定。

Yes, in our newer character designs, we've largely moved away from Leap and Quasar. In yesterday's discussion, we also touched on the problems those mechanics were originally intended to address.
In classic Ultra, one important reason to plan your card plays is to trigger Leap. In Singularity: Ultra, more of that planning revolves around the Singularity Beacon bonus the cards themselves can receive. We therefore no longer need Leap and Quasar to serve the same purpose.
This design also makes allocating Ultra Space resources a more meaningful trade-off: deciding which cards should take priority for that bonus becomes more important.

谢谢你分享这个想法。在保留随机性的同时，为依赖特定钥令的队伍留出一些可控空间，这里确实可能存在更好的平衡点。目前还不能作出承诺，但我们会继续研究！

Thank you for sharing this idea. There may indeed be a better balance between preserving randomness and allowing some control for teams that rely on a specific Posse. We can't make any promises at this stage, but we'll keep exploring it!

我明白你的吐槽。“水多了加面，面多了加水”，这种反复调整的确有些尴尬。我们一直在尽量避免，但作为持续运营的游戏，有时犯了错，也只能在现有系统和大家已经投入的基础上，逐步修正。

有时候，我真的很羡慕一些单机游戏能够更自由地通过增强和削弱来调整平衡！但我们必须尽最大努力，避免削弱大家已经收集和培养的内容，并尽可能保留这些投入的价值。这也让调整更容易陷入一环牵动另一环的循环。

免费回溯并不能代替对随机机制本身的改进。我们会继续研究这些问题，希望每次调整都能让体验往更好的方向走。

I understand your criticism. It can feel like adding flour when the dough is too wet, then adding water when it gets too dry. That kind of back-and-forth is awkward, and we try to avoid it. But in a live-service game, correcting our mistakes sometimes means making gradual adjustments within existing systems while respecting what Keepers have already invested.

Sometimes I really envy the freedom some single-player games have to adjust their balance through buffs and nerfs! But we must do our utmost to avoid weakening what Keepers have already collected and built up, and to preserve the value of those investments as much as possible. That also makes it easier to fall into a cycle where one adjustment leads to another.

Free uses of Time Reversal aren't a substitute for improving the random mechanics themselves. We'll keep examining these issues and working to make each adjustment a step toward a better experience.

We don't currently plan to make a triple Posse activation count as three separate activations. By the later stages of Faded Legacy, stacking effects that trigger when a Posse is activated could provide far greater benefits than the Posse itself. This shifted the focus of team builds away from what Posses actually did and toward repeatedly triggering those additional benefits.
When designing Primordia: Chaos, we deliberately limited this interaction to bring the focus back to the effects of the Posses themselves.

messages.prev:
1. Structural Issues and Loss of Utility in "Breeding Bloodline"

Among all newly released territories, Breeding Bloodline is currently the least appealing choice. While other territories only impose turn-based cooldowns on their abilities, Breeding Bloodline not only adds turn limits but completely strips away its core utility skills. It loses all the versatile functions that Bloodline previously offered:

Madness and Devour mechanics via Embryos

Shields and temporary Strength buffs gained upon activating Devour

Combat sustain provided through Furnace

Temporary Critical Strike Chance granted to teammates via Embryo

In the current meta, many players prioritize sustain and stability over pure damage setups. However, Breeding Bloodline sacrifices all survival tools for raw damage output. Because Embryo generation itself is highly unreliable, players gain virtually no practical benefit from the recent patch.

Consequently, activating Devour becomes structurally difficult, causing Bloodline characters to lose their fundamental identity. Unless the Embryo supply system is rebalanced, this issue cannot be resolved. Furthermore, characters currently using Breeding Bloodline see high pick rates simply due to their strong base stats and skill kits, not because the territory itself offers any real merit.
messages.prevTr:
一、“育种血统”的结构性问题和效用丧失

在所有新发布的领地中，育种血统是目前最没有吸引力的选择。虽然其他地区只对他们的能力施加基于回合的冷却时间，但培育血统不仅增加了回合限制，而且完全剥夺了其核心实用技能。它失去了 Bloodline 之前提供的所有多功能功能：

通过胚胎的疯狂和吞噬机制

激活吞噬时获得护盾和临时力量增益

通过熔炉提供战斗维持

通过胚胎给予队友临时暴击率

在当前的元数据中，许多玩家优先考虑持续性和稳定性而不是纯粹的伤害设置。然而，繁殖血统牺牲了所有生存工具来换取原始伤害输出。由于胚胎生成本身非常不可靠，玩家实际上无法从最近的补丁中获得任何实际好处。
因此，激活吞噬在结构上变得困难，导致血统角色失去他们的基本身份。除非重新平衡胚胎供应系统，否则这个问题无法解决。此外，目前使用育种血统的角色之所以获得高选择率，仅仅是因为他们强大的基础统计数据和技能包，而不是因为领土本身提供了任何真正的优点。

messages.content:
这个问题足够做一篇访谈了！请容我简单回答。
1.  首先，出发点一定是故事：这个角色还有哪些不同的面向值得探索？美术与玩法是否都能找到合适的方向？我们希望在原先得到认可的基础上，做出既不同、又仍然“是这个人”的设计。不同制作环节之间的磨合，是游戏创作绕不开的事情。所以，确实会有美术设计根据Live2D的实现条件作出调整的时候，也会反过来，为了实现美术想法而调整技术方案。
2.  团队每位成员都有每周游玩游戏的目标，除特殊情况外，大家通常都会完成。我自然也不例外。坦率地说，我目前的游玩时间远比不上各位投入最多的守密人，但基本每周都会玩。现在，我更多的时间花在观看游玩过程、与团队探索更好的设计和制作方法、了解社区体验、收集反馈，以及长期规划和团队管理上。无奈时间总是不太够用。我希望随着游戏和团队的发展更加稳定，自己也能像上线前和初期那样，投入更多时间与大家一起游玩。
3.  这个涉及重要剧透，抱歉暂时不能回答！主要还是取决于剧本作家的故事安排，大家平时的呼声我们也会关注。

There's enough here for a whole interview! Let me give you a brief answer.
1.  The starting point is always the story: what other sides of this character can we explore, and can we find compelling directions for both the art and gameplay? We want to build on what resonated with everyone and create something different that still feels unmistakably like the same person. Working through the needs of different production stages is an unavoidable part of making games. So yes, sometimes the art is adjusted to work within Live2D's technical constraints, and sometimes we change the technical approach to bring an artistic idea to life.
2.  Everyone on the team has a weekly goal for playing the game, and barring exceptional circumstances, we generally meet it. That includes me, of course. Honestly, my current playtime is nowhere near that of our most dedicated Keepers, but I still play pretty much every week. These days, more of my time goes into watching gameplay, exploring better design and production methods with the team, understanding the community's experience, gathering feedback, and handling long-term planning and team management. There never seems to be enough time. As the game and team settle into a more stable rhythm, I hope to spend more time enjoying the game alongside everyone again, as I did before launch and in the early days.
3. That would involve major spoilers, so I'm afraid I can't answer for now! It mainly depends on our writers' plans for the story, and we also pay attention to the characters everyone wants to see.

这里我想澄清一下：“不取代经典界域”，是希望在发展新玩法的同时，保留经典界域原有的玩法与价值，并不代表我们会持续扩展其角色阵容。

目前，经典界域的唤醒体数量仍然远多于二代界域，奇点·超维甚至才只有阿拉克涅一位。因此，在未来相当长的一段时间内，我们确实没有继续扩展经典界域角色阵容的计划。我理解，对喜欢经典界域的守密人来说，“仍然可用”和“持续有新角色加入”并不是同一件事，这一点需要说清楚。

不过，不再扩展角色阵容，并不意味着放弃原有的配队和玩法。我们仍希望这些选择保持可行，也不希望喜欢经典界域的守密人感觉被落下。因此，我们会阶段性回顾经典界域的唤醒体，对需要帮助的唤醒体做出增强，让他们在新的游戏环境中继续有用武之地。

Let me clarify what we mean by not replacing classic realms: we want to develop new playstyles while preserving the existing gameplay and value of classic realms. That doesn't mean we'll continually expand their character rosters.

Classic realms still have far more Awakeners than second-generation realms. Singularity: Ultra, for example, currently has only Arachne. For that reason, we don't plan to expand the classic realm rosters for quite some time. I understand that, for Keepers who enjoy classic realms, remaining viable and continuing to receive new characters aren't the same thing. It's important to make that distinction clear.

However, not expanding those rosters doesn't mean abandoning their existing teams and playstyles. We want those options to remain viable, and we don't want Keepers who enjoy classic realms to feel left behind. We'll therefore periodically review classic realm Awakeners and buff those who need support, so they can continue to have a meaningful place as the game evolves.
messages.prev:
In a similar vein to Leap and Quasar being depreciated and phased out of Ultra, does that also mean effects like Xu's Resonance have fallen out of unit-design's favor?

If that's the case, I think that would be tragic. Half of today's Q&A is about how randomness needed to be a bigger factor in gameplay, and sequence-dependent effects like Leap/Quasar/Resonance can help pull us towards that direction in a more measured and controlled manner than a behind-the-curtain coinflip like Caraboo's Blessing Prices or RNG Chaos Posses.

We sort of have that sequencing in Arachne Pursuit, Vortice Pursuit, and G.Lotan's Short Blade -> Long Blade, but they aren't as well-integrated and notated/indicated as their predecessors.

I'm not playing a card game for the bot to flip a coin and tell me if I win or lose. I'm playing the card game because I believe in the heart of the cards and the deck that I've curated.

与 Leap 和 Quasar 被贬值并逐步从 Ultra 中淘汰类似，这是否也意味着像 Xu 的共振这样的效果已经不再受到单位设计的青睐？

如果真是这样的话，我想那就是悲剧了。今天的问答有一半是关于随机性如何成为游戏玩法中一个更大的因素，而像 Leap/Quasar/Resonance 这样的依赖于序列的效果可以帮助我们以一种更加谨慎和可控的方式朝着这个方向前进，而不是像 Caraboo 的 Blessing Price 或 RNG Chaos Posses 这样的幕后硬币翻转。

我们在《Arachne Pursuit》、《Vortice Pursuit》和《G.Lotan 的短剑 -> 长剑》中都有这样的排序，但它们不像前辈那样整合和注释/指示。

我们已经几次提高主线奖励、增加养成资源的获取途径，目前暂时没有进一步增加主线奖励的计划。不过，我们理解大家希望减轻养成压力，也希望有更多尝试不同队伍的机会。
对于内容固定的主线关卡，我们担心把奖励与不同队伍反复通关绑定，最终会让尝试阵容变成重复领取奖励的负担，因此暂时不考虑这个方案。未来，我们会积极考虑通过更多玩法和活动，为大家提供奖励！

We've increased main story rewards and expanded access to upgrade materials several times, and we don't currently plan to increase main story rewards further. Still, we understand the desire to ease progression costs and have more opportunities to try different teams.
For fixed main story stages, we're concerned that tying rewards to repeated clears with different teams could turn team experimentation into a repetitive reward grind, so we aren't considering that approach for now. We'll look for opportunities to offer more rewards through future game modes and events!
messages.prev:
I think that merely giving every player 5 Turn-Rewinds a day is either just a stop-gap solution, or is entirely missing the point on what makes the existence of Turn-Rewinds frustrating.

While I imagine the Turn-Rewind was originally thought of as a way to correct a mistake on the player's end on how they decided to go about playing a specific turn, it has now devolved into an RNG-manipulation tool. I remember staying up an entire night farming a 50% and 25% DR proc on Madness W2 in the D-Tide rotation after Caraboo's release without a Turn-Rewind, simply due to how many card and exalt animations I had to go through on each attempt. If you look through D-Tide replays, you can even find people proccing DR at 10% or less, which generally makes a lot of team-comps not a viable strategy for players without a VERY large number of Turn-Rewinds.

If changing how DR works is not an option, which I assume is the case, the only alternative to DR procs available to players seems to be improving the defensive capabilities of their teams. While leveling up defensive characters alleviates the issue, this is often not enough, and a higher Max HP becomes important or, due to how certain characters scale their effects based on Max HP (like GHelot or Myriam), downright necessary.

Currently, Max HP is heavily reliant on a keeper's account level, as Somatic Research relies quite heavily on it. Even though it's technically possible to level up all awakeners on a team in order to raise it, it's very expensive to get all awakeners past level 70. The only way of increasing account level is waiting a very long time, or spending a lot of money on the game. As I think waiting until early 2029 in order to have a Somatic Research high enough to tackle endgame content without relying on random DR as much is bad, I believe removing or severely reducing Somatic Research's scaling with a keeper's account level is best for the game's health.

messages.content:
按目前的方案，归档刻痕计算到第66个钥令，两项研究深度最多各提高99%，而且这个加成对所有界域都有效。未来是否调整上限，目前还没有确定的安排，也许下一个篇章我们会找到更好的解决办法。
你提到用完4次觉醒后，再获得使用携带钥令的机会，也是一个值得考虑的方向。前面我们已经讨论了充能等提供有限掌控感的办法，会结合这些建议继续研究，但目前还不能保证具体方案。谢谢你的建议！

Under the current proposal, Archive Mark counts up to 66 unlocked Posses, granting a maximum increase of 99% to each Research stat. This bonus applies to all realms. We haven't decided whether to adjust the cap in the future; we may find a better solution for the next arc.
Allowing access to your equipped Posse after all four Awakenings have been used is also a direction worth considering. We've discussed ways to provide limited control, including realm charges, and we'll continue exploring these suggestions. We can't promise a specific solution yet. Thank you for the suggestion!

현재 계획에서는 해금한 열쇠(Posse)를 66개까지 계산하며, 두 연구 수치는 각각 최대 99%까지 증가합니다. 이 보너스는 모든 영역에 적용됩니다. 앞으로 상한을 조정할지는 아직 정해지지 않았으며, 다음 장에서는 더 나은 해결책을 찾을 수도 있습니다.
각성을 네 번 모두 사용한 뒤, 장착한 열쇠를 사용할 기회를 주자는 제안도 검토할 만한 방향입니다. 앞서 충전 방식처럼 제한적인 선택권을 제공하는 방법도 이야기했으며, 이런 제안들을 함께 고려해 계속 검토하겠습니다. 다만 아직 구체적인 방안을 약속드릴 수는 없습니다. 의견 감사합니다!

messages.content:
我们会继续设计专属钥令，但会重新寻找角色对钥令依赖程度的平衡点。

“随便选4名角色也能一起战斗”，曾经是我们的理想，游戏初期和相位对弈也更接近这种体验。但随着游戏发展，我们逐渐意识到，让所有数学上的组合都有效，并不现实，也未必能带来健康的策略环境。我们希望维护的是多种有明确思路、能够成立的构筑，而不是让任意组合都表现相同。

我们当然希望有趣的构筑越来越多，但更多自由并不总是意味着更多有意义的选择。前面提过经典深海的例子：静海与怒涛可以自由切换，但在实际环境中，选择往往固定为“平时静海，爆发时怒涛”。看似自由，实际却容易变成固定操作。不过，固定3回合冷却又可能过于僵化，所以我们引入界域充能，尝试在取舍与弹性之间找到更好的平衡。

利莫里亚羁绊则是另一种情况。这些角色原本可以在各自的队伍中发挥作用，但放在一起时，机制未必自然契合。为了让故事中的联系也能在玩法中体现，我们加入了羁绊支持，让一个原本不太适配的组合成为可行选择。角色分开后，仍然有其他可行、甚至更好的搭配。

所以，它看起来像是指定了一套阵容，但我们的目标其实是增加一种组队理由，而不是让这些角色只能一起使用。如果未来再设计类似羁绊，也会基于这样的考虑。

这些取舍有时确实反直觉。我们希望增加的是值得尝试的策略和组合，而不只是表面上的自由度。当然，设计意图不等于实际体验一定达到了目标，大家指出的不适配和受限问题，我们也需要继续认真评估。

messages.content:
We'll continue designing character-specific Posses, but we'll keep looking for a better balance in how much characters depend on them.

Being able to pick any four characters and make a team was once our ideal. The early game and Traphase come closer to that experience. But as the game has developed, we've realized that making every mathematically possible combination viable isn't realistic, nor does it necessarily create a healthy strategic environment. We want to support a variety of coherent, viable builds, rather than make every arbitrary combination perform equally well.

We certainly want more interesting builds, but more freedom doesn't always mean more meaningful choices. Take the classic Aequor example discussed earlier: switching freely between Tranquil Sea and Raging Waves can, in practice, settle into "Tranquil Sea normally, Raging Waves for burst damage." What looks like freedom can become a fixed routine. On the other hand, a strict three-turn cooldown can be too rigid, which is why we're introducing realm charges to seek a better balance between trade-offs and flexibility.
messages.tr:
我们将继续设计特定角色的团队，但我们将继续在角色对它们的依赖程度方面寻求更好的平衡。

能够选择任意四个角色并组成一个团队曾经是我们的理想。早期的游戏和 Traphase 更接近这种体验。但随着游戏的发展，我们意识到让每一个数学上可能的组合都可行是不现实的，也不一定能创造一个健康的战略环境。我们希望支持各种连贯、可行的构建，而不是让每个任意组合都表现得同样好。

我们当然想要更有趣的构建，但更多的自由并不总是意味着更有意义的选择。以前面讨论的经典 Aequor 为例：在平静海和汹涌波涛之间自由切换，实际上可以适应“平静海正常，汹涌波爆发伤害”。看似自由的事情可能会成为固定的惯例。另一方面，严格的三回合冷却时间可能过于严格，这就是为什么我们引入领域费用以寻求权衡和灵活性之间更好的平衡。
