op.content:
Hello everyone, this is Light, producer of Morimens.

Over the past few months, a great many Keepers have told us about places where our systems could use an update. Thank you to everyone who took part in our surveys and left feedback — you've been an enormous help in improving the game! Now, after finally carving out a bit of time from development hell, our team has taken a deep look at the game and drafted an initial direction for future updates.

I'd like to share the issues we've identified and our draft plans with you in the form of a devlog. Since there's a lot to cover, these adjustments will be rolled out across several minor updates within the V2.6 major version. As always, we're looking forward to your feedback in this thread, and we may make any necessary adjustments during implementation.
op.tr:
大家好，我是《Morimens》的制作人Light。

在过去的几个月里，很多 Keepers 告诉我们我们的系统可以在哪些地方使用更新。感谢所有参与我们调查并留下反馈的人 - 你们对改进游戏提供了巨大帮助！现在，在终于从开发地狱中抽出一点时间后，我们的团队深入研究了游戏，并为未来的更新起草了初步方向。

我想以开发日志的形式与您分享我们发现的问题和我们的计划草案。由于需要涵盖的内容很多，这些调整将在 V2.6 主要版本中的几个小更新中推出。一如既往，我们期待您在此线程中提供反馈，并且我们可能会在实施过程中进行任何必要的调整。

messages.content:
## [Operation]
- As Morimens has grown, every Keeper's strategic skill, progress, and character strength can vary wildly. On the very same unforgettable story stage, some players will try everything until their palms sweat, while others can clear it effortlessly on Auto. The more we emphasize freedom in how you progress through the game, the more this disparity stands out, and we've come to feel we can no longer avoid rethinking it.
- At our 2nd anniversary, we tried lowering the difficulty of the main story and ran into pushback from some of our more hardcore players. We completely understand — while lowering the difficulty is friendlier to newer players, it genuinely costs them some of the unique challenge that makes Morimens what it is. Losing that experience to a mismatch in difficulty is a real shame. Now we've finally settled on an approach: instead of us deciding, on everyone's behalf, what the "right" average difficulty should be, we're handing that choice over to you.
- "Hard" will no longer be a separate mode — it becomes a difficulty you can freely choose for each individual combat stage.
- When challenging a stage on "Hard," if you haven't yet cleared that stage on "Normal," the "Normal" difficulty's story content will not be skipped.
- Clearing a stage on "Hard" also counts as clearing the corresponding "Normal" difficulty — you'll simultaneously receive the Evaluation, Stage Achievement, and Hidden Resource rewards for it as well.
messages.tr:
## 【操作】
- 随着莫里门斯的成长，每个守护者的战略技能、进度和角色强度都会有很大差异。在同一个令人难忘的故事舞台上，有的玩家会尝试一切直到手心出汗，而另一些玩家则可以在自动模式下轻松通关。我们越强调游戏进程的自由，这种差异就越突出，我们开始觉得我们无法再避免重新思考它。
- 在我们的两周年纪念日上，我们尝试降低主线故事的难度，但遭到了一些更硬核玩家的反对。我们完全理解——虽然降低难度对新玩家来说更友好，但这确实让他们失去了一些独特的挑战，而正是这些挑战才造就了莫里门斯。由于难度不匹配而失去这种经验真是一种耻辱。现在我们终于确定了一种方法：我们不再代表每个人决定“正确”的平均难度应该是多少，而是将选择权交给您。
- “困难”将不再是一个单独的模式——它变成了你可以为每个单独的战斗阶段自由选择的难度。
- 挑战“困难”关卡时，如果“普通”关卡尚未通关，则不会跳过“普通”难度的故事内容。
- 通关“困难”关卡也算作通关相应的“普通”难度——您将同时获得评估、关卡成就和隐藏资源奖励。

messages.content:
## [Regional D-Effect Zone]
- The Regional D-Effect Zone is one of the most challenging pieces of endgame content. However, more and more Keepers have been breaking past the reward threshold we set back when it launched — even the highest tier of challenge has seen a growing number of single-turn clears. On one hand, that's proof that everyone has genuinely gotten stronger, and we're proud of that. But it also means we need tougher opponents! And, of course, more rewards!
- On the other hand, we don't want the Regional D-Effect Zone's list of difficulty tiers and rewards to keep growing until it becomes impossible to parse and read. So we've decided that compressing the difficulty tiers is the better path forward: we'll keep the original stages and rewards in the first half, and place the new stages and rewards in the second half.
- To help everyone deal with all manner of harsh conditions, we're also lifting the restriction on using Emergency Gnosis inside the Regional D-Effect Zone. With Emergency Gnosis to back you up, you'll be able to take on the toughest conditions more boldly, with much less worry about having to drop down a difficulty and restart.
messages.tr:
## [区域D效应区]
- 区域 D 效应区是残局内容中最具挑战性的部分之一。然而，越来越多的守护者已经突破了我们在推出时设定的奖励门槛——即使是最高级别的挑战，单回合通关的数量也越来越多。一方面，这证明每个人都真正变得更强大，我们为此感到自豪。但这也意味着我们需要更强硬的对手！当然，还有更多奖励！
- 另一方面，我们不希望区域 D 效应区的难度等级和奖励列表继续增长，直到变得无法解析和阅读。所以我们决定压缩难度等级是更好的前进道路：我们将在上半场保留原有的关卡和奖励，并在下半场放置新的关卡和奖励。
- 为了帮助每个人应对各种恶劣的情况，我们还取消了在区域 D 效应区内使用紧急灵知的限制。有了紧急灵知的支持，您将能够更大胆地应对最艰难的条件，而不必担心必须放弃困难并重新开始。

messages.content:
# 前瞻：V2.6.X 玩法与奖励

大家好！我是 Morimens 制作人 Light。

这几个月以来其实有非常多的守密人告诉我们一些系统应该有所更新的地方，感谢参与问卷反馈、留言的每一位守密人，你们为游戏改进带来了很多帮助！现在，我们团队终于在产能地狱中腾出些许时间，深度审视游戏，并初步拟定了未来的更新方向。

现在，我希望用日志的形式来与大家分享一下我们看到的问题和草案。由于这些调整内容很多，他们需要分散在 V2.6 大版本内的多个小版本中实装。 一如既往，我们很期待能够在这个帖子内得到大家的反馈，在实装时我们也可能会做出任何必要的调整。

## 【调查行动】
- Morimens 发展到今天，每位守密人的策略水平、进度、练度可能会非常不同。同一段刻骨铭心的故事关卡，有的人想尽一切办法打的手心冒汗，也有人使用自动就能轻松过关。当我们越是强调游戏进程的自由，这样的问题就会越是显著，到如今我们认为不得不重新思考这个问题。
- 两周年时我们试图下调主线难度，遭到了部分硬核玩家的反对。我们完全理解——下调难度虽然能够对一些新玩家友好，但也确实会让他们失去了一些属于 Morimens 独特的挑战乐趣。因为难度的不匹配，缺少了这部分体验是一件相当可惜的事情。现在，我们终于想清楚，不再完全由我们决定所有守密人适合挑战的平均难度，而是将选择的自主权交给大家。
- 「困难」不再是一种模式，而是每个战斗关卡可以自由选择的一种难度。
- 「困难」难度挑战时，如果尚未通关该关卡的「普通」难度，则「普通」难度的剧情也不会被跳过。
- 「困难」难度通关，也同时视为对应的「普通」难度通关，包括调查评价、关卡成就、隐藏物资的奖励也会同时获得。

## 【融灾禁区】
- 融灾禁区是游戏后期最有挑战的内容之一。然而当年设立的那条挑战奖励线，有越来越多的守密人突破——即便是最高档位的挑战也出现了越来越多的一回合通关记录。一方面，这说明大家切切实实在变强了，我们感到很自豪。但同时，这也意味着我们需要更强的对手！当然还有更多的奖励！
- 另一方面，我们也不希望融灾禁区的难度数量和奖励清单越来越长，变得无法理解和阅读。因此我们认为压缩融灾禁区的难度是更好的选择，将原有的关卡和奖励放在前半段，将新增的关卡和奖励放在后半段。
- 为了帮助大家面对各种严苛环境，我们还将解除在融灾禁区使用「应急灵知体」的限制。在「应急灵知体」的帮助下，你将可以更大胆的挑战那些最为艰难的环境而更少担忧需要降级重开。
### 普通
- 第 1~5 波的推荐等级为 44/48/52/56/60，通关特训值为 50/60/70/80/90。
- 特训值 50~350 解锁的奖励共有：「灵核碎片」×50、「银芯」×1250、「黑色贡物」×7500。
### 困难
- 第 1~5 波的推荐等级为 64/68/72/76/80，通关特训值为 60/70/80/90/100。
- 特训值 360~400 解锁的奖励共有：「精粹灵核碎片」×25、「黑色贡物」×7500、「无形者的礼券」×50、「蔷薇金券」×1500000。
### 噩梦
- 第 1~5 波的推荐等级为 82/84/86/88/90，通关特训值为 70/80/90/100/110。
- 特训值 410~450 解锁的奖励共有：「精粹灵核碎片」×25、「银芯」×1250。
### 癫狂
- 第 1~5 波的推荐等级为 92/94/96/98/100，通关特训值为 80/90/100/110/120。
- 特训值 460~500 解锁的奖励共有：「无形者的请柬」×5。
### 应急灵知体
- 现在当你在融灾禁区时，可使用「应急灵知体」支持你完成挑战！
-  使用「应急灵知体」通关后获得的特训值只能用于领取奖励，不会计入排行榜。

## 【疾驰的欢愉专列】
- 疾驰的欢愉专列是我们地图设计上最接近肉鸽定义的玩法，很多守密人早早就完成了 50 级雅室规格，向我们反馈玩的不够尽兴。现在是时候为这个玩法带来一次扩充！
### 雅室规格
- 最大等级从 50 提高为 100！
- 等级追加后至多能够获取「精粹原初灵核」×1、「银芯」×2500、「蔷薇金券」×3750000。
### 最终阶段
- 仅「癫狂难度」下，完成第三阶段挑战后将额外挑战最终阶段。
- 该阶段仅包含最终首领「塔薇」，击败后可额外获得「贵宾积分」×1500。

## 【禁忌试炼】
- 我们希望禁忌试炼中轮换玩法的赛季任务更有吸引力，也希望提供无法攻略主线时，有更多获取调查徽章的途径。因此为大家追加了一些相关奖励！
- 「幻梦深潜」、「疾驰的欢愉专列」、「相位对弈：预组模式」、「相位对弈：轮选模式」的赛季任务追加奖励：「灵核碎片」×5。
- 「深潜等级」、「雅室规格」、「预组等级」、「轮选等级」每个等级追加「调查徽章」奖励，追加后每个玩法均至多可额外获得：「调查徽章」×25000，总计「调查徽章」×100000。

You can still field 10 teams, but each additional team only gets +5
仍然可以10队伍，不过每个额外队伍只能+5

messages.content: 下一篇就是兑换商店的内容！不过新密契还要等一等！

All strategy, character growth, new tactics, accumulated skill, and new Relics ultimately end up expressed as numbers, unless we add restrictions — but that would make everyone feel weaker, which is clearly not right either. That's why the launch of Astral Reign brought a lot of numerical power increases to offset this. The Japanese version's power inflation has been much gentler; Astral Reign there didn't introduce nearly as many negatives, and enemy HP is far lower than on the Global server. The tradeoff is longer cooldowns on mechanics, and the starting mechanics also feel a bit weaker. That's because we anticipated the consequences for the Global server ahead of time.

We've been doing our best to slow down power inflation through clever strategic differentiation and progressively stricter testing, and we introduced things like Soulforge Aptitude, which gets replaced in each new chapter. But sometimes we still ended up raising the power bar too high due to mistakes, and then had no choice but to go back and buff everything across the board. So, to fix these legacy issues, the pace of power inflation across all of Astral Reign has indeed looked faster than it should have. But overall, we've built up a lot of experience and methods that will help keep things more stable going forward.

所有的策略、养成、新战术、积累的技巧、新造物都会最终以数值的方式呈现，除非我们增加限制条件，这样会让大家感觉到变弱，这显然也是不对的。因此星辰篇推出带来了许多数值提升来抵消这一点。日本版本的数值膨胀就要缓和的多，星辰篇也没有引入太多负面，敌人的生命远低于国际服。作为代价，机制冷却较多、初始机制也感觉弱一些。这是因为提前就考虑到了国际服这边的后果。

我们极力在用巧妙的策略差和逐渐严苛的测试来减缓数值膨胀，并且引入了灵塑适性这样在新篇章会替换的内容。但我们有时候还是因为失误抬高了数值标准，然后不得已回头强化所有内容。所以为了解决历史问题，整个星辰篇的确显得数值膨胀速度较快。但整体上，我们已经积累了很多经验和方法，来让未来趋于稳定。

Fair question, so I'll give you a straight answer.

First, something we got wrong: some of the feedback we did read and discussed internally, but we never came back to tell you what we decided. From where you're standing, that looks exactly like not listening. That one's on us, and it'll change.

Now, what "community first" actually means here. When you tell us where it hurts, you're almost always right, and we take all of it. But the fix is a different story — the same problem usually has more than one possible fix, and we have to think about the long run, so sometimes we'll go a different way than what's being asked for.

messages.content:
That hasn't changed at all. This adjustment isn't about pushing for more spending — it's that Regional D-Extinction Zone difficulty hasn't been adjusted for a long time, and in some versions it even regressed for technical reasons. The gap between players' current power and that difficulty has been growing wider and wider.

We don't want to do what a lot of similar games do — quietly ramp up the numbers while leaving the rewards completely untouched. The 300~350-score reward tier was set two years ago, right when Regional D-Extinction Zone first launched, and the difficulty has barely changed since then. For most Keepers with even a bit of experience, clearing that tier isn't much of a challenge anymore. We think now is a good time to address this. That's also why we're providing Emergency Gnosis Vessels alongside it — to make sure everyone has more room for error.
messages.tr:

我们不想做许多类似游戏所做的事情——悄悄地增加数字，同时完全不影响奖励。 300~350分的奖励等级是在两年前，也就是区域性D-灭绝区刚推出时设定的，此后难度几乎没有变化。对于大多数拥有一点经验的守护者来说，清除该级别不再是一个挑战。我们认为现在是解决这个问题的好时机。这也是我们同时提供紧急灵知容器的原因——以确保每个人都有更多犯错的空间。

messages.content: We're just as frustrated by this as you are. I'd really like to give you that reassurance, but honestly, I can't yet. The only evidence I can point to is what we've already put in past update patch notes — all the bugfixes we've listed. Sometimes a single version update brings well over a hundred bugfixes, which is an improvement in itself, but it also means we're generating bugs faster than that. That's on us, obviously. We're actively looking for ways to fix this — we've brought on some new combat designers — but the overall game logic has gotten so complex, and there was so much rushed, hacky work from back when we didn't have enough manpower, that at this point bugs are hiding in almost every corner. We fight this problem every single day. What makes it worse is that on top of it, we've had version delays. After 2.0 we had to push back releases multiple times. Recently, with a lot of effort, we've cut down on delays, but that's also made the quality issues stand out more. That's the next thing we need to figure out how to solve.
messages.tr: 我们和您一样对此感到沮丧。我真的很想给你这样的保证，但老实说，我还不能。我可以指出的唯一证据是我们已经在过去的更新补丁说明中添加的内容 - 我们列出的所有错误修复。有时，单个版本更新会带来一百多个错误修复，这本身就是一种改进，但这也意味着我们生成错误的速度比这更快。显然，这是我们的责任。我们正在积极寻找解决这个问题的方法——我们聘请了一些新的战斗设计师——但整体游戏逻辑已经变得如此复杂，而且当我们没有足够的人力时，后面有太多仓促、黑客的工作，以至于此时错误几乎隐藏在每个角落。我们每天都在与这个问题作斗争。更糟糕的是，我们还出现了版本延迟。 2.0 之后，我们不得不多次推迟发布。最近，经过大量努力，我们减少了延误，但这也使得质量问题更加突出。这是我们接下来需要弄清楚如何解决的问题。

messages.content:
## Exchange Stores: Rework
As the game has gone on, some Keepers have gradually reached a point where their exchange currencies just aren't that useful anymore. To address this, we've planned new goods for each store and lifted a number of purchase limits. With these changes in place, we hope every Keeper will be able to plan their own progression path and playstyle more freely and more effectively.

### Sediment Exchange

- Added Refined Gnosis Fragment to the stock: Costs Radix Sediment ×500, limited to 10 purchases per month.
- Added Investigation Badge ×100 to the stock: Costs Radix Sediment ×15, no purchase limit.
- Black Offering ×100 and D-Jewel ×100 no longer have purchase limits.
- Special Potion Supply limit raised from 1 per week to 5 per month.
- Emergency Gnosis is no longer bought from the store directly. Instead, when you fail a challenge and are short on Emergency Gnosis, a purchase prompt will appear.

### D-Jewel Exchange
- Dreamspark and Dreamshard: limits raised from 100/25 per week to 500/125 per month.

### Gnosis Fragment
- The Gnosis Fragment in Investigation Exchange, Lightless Exchange, and D-Jewel Exchange has its limit raised from 5 per month to 10 per month.

### Remembrance Quill
- The Remembrance Quill in Sediment Exchange, Investigation Exchange, Lightless Exchange, and D-Jewel Exchange has its limit raised from 10 per week to 100 per month.

messages.content:
### Covenant Bonding
Covenant Bonding offers you a brand-new way to use Covenants: you gain more Mainstat bonuses, but the trade-off is that you lose the flexibility to swap them around. Whether you use it is entirely up to you!

- You can bond a Covenant to an Awakener for free under Awakener Details – Covenant, raising that Covenant's Mainstat by an additional - 50% and upgrading it to Prismatic quality.
- When building a Lineup, if a deployed Awakener has a bonded Covenant, that Awakener's bonded Covenant will be used automatically.
- Bonded Covenants no longer appear under Inventory – Covenant and no longer take up storage space, but you can still Enhance and Transcribe them from the Awakener screen.
- If you later need to remove a bonded Covenant from an Awakener, each piece costs Dissociation Inscription ×10 of the corresponding Covenant. It will lose the Mainstat bonus and revert to Gold quality.
- Dismantling a Covenant no longer grants Remnants directly; it grants Dissociation Inscriptions instead. Dissociation Inscriptions can be converted into Remnants.
- The point of this change is to give you an option that, in the long run, cuts down the complexity of adjusting Lineups and team comps — and to give the Covenants sold across the various stores a chance to matter again, so that earning all these currencies feels more meaningful and more motivating.
messages.tr:
### 契约结合
契约结合为您提供了一种使用契约的全新方式：您获得更多主状态奖励，但代价是您失去了交换它们的灵活性。是否使用它完全取决于您！

- 您可以在觉醒者详细信息 - 契约下免费将契约与觉醒者结合，将该契约的主状态额外提高 - 50% 并将其升级到棱柱品质。
- 组建阵容时，如果部署的觉醒者有绑定契约，则将自动使用该觉醒者的绑定契约。
- 契约契约不再出现在物品栏-契约下，也不再占用存储空间，但您仍然可以从觉醒者屏幕中增强和转录它们。
- 如果您稍后需要从觉醒者身上移除绑定的盟约，则每件都需要花费相应盟约的解离铭文×10。它将失去主状态加成并恢复为黄金品质。
- 拆除盟约不再直接授予遗迹；相反，它会授予解离铭文。解离铭文可以转化为遗迹。
- 这一变化的目的是为你提供一个选择，从长远来看，可以降低调整阵容和团队阵容的复杂性 - 并让在各个商店出售的契约有机会再次发挥作用，这样赚取所有这些货币就会感觉更有意义，更有动力。

messages.content:
## Affinity
Affinity is meant to be a symbol of the bond genuinely formed between an Awakener and their Keeper, but there are currently some immature aspects of its design that cause Affinity to drift away from that original intent in certain edge cases. To fix this, we've reworked the rules for earning Affinity. After the change, Affinity gain during normal play will generally be significantly faster.

Having settled the fairness and effectiveness of earning Affinity, we're also providing a way to keep unlocking higher Affinity level caps, with a meaningful reward at every level — and finally, a card cosmetic style as the exclusive reward for maxing Affinity out. We hope this change gives you more reasons to keep fighting alongside the Awakeners you love.

### Affinity Rule

- The more cards an Awakener plays, and the more Arithmetica and Aliemus they spend, the more Affinity that Awakener earns upon completing an Investigation.
- The more Keyflare the Keeper spends, the more Affinity deployed Awakeners earn upon completing an Investigation. Affinity from the Keeper's Keyflare expenditure is divided evenly among the deployed Awakeners.
- The higher a stage's Rec. Level, the more Affinity earned upon completing the Investigation. When fighting in Manual Battle, Affinity earned is tripled.
- Invite now generates Affinity at 1 point every 5 minutes, up from 1 point every 12 minutes.
- The maximum Affinity that Invite can store offline is changed from a flat 360 points to: past 300 points, the generation rate drops to 1/3, and up to 3,000 points can be stored.
- The rules for earning Affinity in Traphase are unchanged.
messages.tr:
## 亲和力
Affinity 旨在成为觉醒者与其守护者之间真正形成的纽带的象征，但目前其设计中存在一些不成熟的方面，导致 Affinity 在某些边缘情况下偏离了最初的意图。为了解决这个问题，我们重新设计了赚取亲和力的规则。更改后，正常游戏时的亲和力增益通常会明显加快。

在解决了赚取亲和力的公平性和有效性之后，我们还提供了一种不断解锁更高亲和力等级上限的方法，并在每个级别提供有意义的奖励 - 最后，卡牌外观风格作为最大化亲和力的独家奖励。我们希望这一变化能让您有更多理由继续与您喜爱的觉醒者并肩作战。

### 亲和力规则

- 觉醒者打的牌越多，花费的算术和阿利穆斯越多，觉醒者在完成调查后获得的亲和力就越多。
- 守护者花费的 Keyflare 越多，部署 Affinity 的觉醒者在完成调查后获得的收入就越多。守护者钥匙焰支出的亲和力在已部署的觉醒者之间平均分配。
- 阶段的 Rec 越高。等级越高，完成调查后获得的亲和力就越高。在手动战斗中进行战斗时，获得的亲和力会增加三倍。
- 邀请现在每 5 分钟产生 1 点亲和力，高于每 12 分钟 1 点。
- Invite离线存储的最大亲和力从固定的360点更改为：过去300点，生成率下降到1/3，最多可以存储3,000点。
- 在 Traphase 中赚取亲和力的规则保持不变。

messages.content:
# 前瞻：V2.6.X 商店兑换、密契结合与同调率

大家好！

这是此前我给大家介绍过 V2.6.X 前瞻的剩余部分。这些调整总体以新奖励、新选择的方式出现，我们希望在这些内容实装后，能够让游戏的经济系统增强活力。

这当然不是我们的全部工作！我们希望在这些生态系统调整完成后，能够将目光放回一些老旧的战斗组件、命轮或唤醒体进行增强调整。然后全力迎来我们星辰篇的关键版本—— V2.7。

 一如既往，我们很期待能够在这个帖子内得到大家的反馈，在实装时我们也可能会做出任何必要的调整。

## 【兑换商店：重构】
随着游戏的进展，部分守密人逐渐出现了兑换货币不再那么有用的情况。为此我们规划新增了各个商店的商品，并解除了一些购买限制。我们希望在这些变化的支持下，所有守密人应该都可以更自由、更有效的规划自己的成长路线和游玩风格。
### 沉淀兑换
- 新增商品「精粹灵核碎片」：单价「根源沉淀」×500，每月限购 10 次。
- 新增商品「调查徽章」×100：单价为「根源沉淀」×15，不限购。
- 「黑色贡物」×100、「融蚀之珠」×100 不再限购。
- 「特批药剂」由每周限购 1 次上调为每月限购 5 次。
- 「应急灵知体」的购买方式变更为在挑战失败且应急灵知体不足时，弹出购买选项。
### 融珠兑换
- 「群星余梦」、「碎裂余梦」：由每周限购 100/25 次上调为每月限购 500/125 次。
### 灵核碎片
- 调查兑换、无光兑换、融珠兑换中的「灵核碎片」由每月限购 5 次上调为每月限购 10 次。
### 追念羽笔
- 沉淀兑换、调查兑换、无光兑换、融珠兑换中的「追念羽笔」由每周限购 10 次上调为每月限购 100 次。
### 拟态凝晶
- 调查兑换中新增商品「拟态凝晶」：单价「调查徽章」×20，每月限购 150 次。
- 无光兑换中新增商品「拟态凝晶」：单价「黑色贡物」×20，每月限购 150 次。
- 融珠兑换、沉淀兑换中「拟态凝晶」由每周限购 30 次上调为每月限购 150 次。
### 贤石碎屑
- 调查兑换中新增商品「贤石碎屑」：单价「调查徽章」×40，每月限购 120 次。
- 沉淀兑换中新增商品「贤石碎屑」：单价「根源沉淀」×2，每月限购 120 次。
### 金券兑换
- 从每日付费刷新调整为每周刷新或每月刷新，出售内容与数量也对应有所调整。
- 密契「荒原狼」、「有机形态」调整为不限量兑换。
- 各界域绿色、蓝色、紫色升格素材：单价「蔷薇金券」×500/1500/4500，每周限购 100 次。
- 「灵知制剂 Ⅰ」、「灵知制剂 Ⅱ」、「灵知制剂 Ⅲ」：单价「蔷薇金券」×250/1000/5000，每周限购 100 次。
- 原「拟态凝晶」每日兑换升级为「幸运糖果」等 8 种高阶技能素材每月兑换，通关对应主线章节后解锁：单价「蔷薇金券」 ×250000，每月限购 3 次。
- 原「贤石碎屑」每日兑换升级为「贤者之石」每月兑换：单价「蔷薇金券」 ×2500000，每月限购 3 次。

## 【密契结合】
密契结合将为你提供一种全新使用密契的办法，能够获得更多主属性加成，但作为代价会失去更换的灵活性。是否要使用完全由你说了算！

- 可以免费在「唤醒体详情-密契」中为唤醒体结合密契，来使密契主属性额外提升 50%，并升级为棱彩品质。
- 编队时，如果上阵唤醒体有结合密契，将直接采用上阵唤醒体的结合密契。
- 被结合的密契不会出现在「物资-密契」中，也不会占用储存空间，但仍然可以在唤醒体界面继续强化和转录。
- 被结合的密契后若需要从唤醒体身上取下来，每个部件需要消耗被对应密契的「析离铭文」 ×10。会失去主属性加成，品质重新变为金色。
- 密契分解不再直接获得「残本」，而是获得「析离铭文」。「析离铭文」可以置换为「残本」。

这项调整是为了给提供一种长期而言降低编队配队调整复杂度的选择，并有机会重新激活各个商店内兑换密契的作用，让获取各种货币感觉更有意义和动力。

## 【同调率】
同调率理应是作为唤醒体与守密人真实产生的羁绊象征，但目前有一些机制设计不成熟之处，让同调率与这个初衷在某些特殊情况下背离。为了修正这个问题，我们重新调整了同调率的获取规则，调整后获取同调率在正常游玩时的获取速度通常来说会显著更快。

在解决同调率获取的公平性和有效性之后，我们提供了一种继续解锁同调率等级上限的办法，并为每一级带来有意义的奖励，最终我们将一种卡牌外观样式作为同调率满级的专属奖励。我们希望这个调整可以让大家有更多的理由与心仪的唤醒体继续并肩作战。
### 同调率规则
- 唤醒体出牌越多，消耗的算力及狂气越多，该唤醒体在完成调查时获得的「同调率」越多。
- 守密人银钥能量消耗越多，上阵唤醒体在完成调查时获得的「同调率」越多；来自守密人银钥能量消耗的「同调率」将平均分配给上阵唤醒体。
- 关卡的推荐等级越高，完成调查时获得的「同调率」越多。当使用手动战斗时，获得的「同调率」变为 3 倍。
- 「邀请来客」获得「同调率」的速度从每 12 分钟 1 点加速为每 5 分钟 1 点。
- 「邀请来客」离线可存储的「同调率」最大数量从 360 点调整为：超出 300 点后，获得速度变为 1/3，最多可储存 3000 点。
-  相位对弈中获得「同调率」的规则不变。
### 灵肉同调
- 唤醒体同调率等级达到 15/16/17/18/19 级时，可消耗道具「同心之证」×1，将同调率等级上限突破至 16/17/18/19/20 级。
- 同调率提升至 16 至 20 级，每级可获得：「精粹灵核碎片」×5。
- 同调率提升至 20 级时，还将额外获得该唤醒体的专属奖励：「曜闪」×1。「曜闪」是一种可以自由选择开启的卡牌外观收藏。
- 「同心之证」在守密人等级达到 50 之后，可在以下「兑换商店」中获得。
- 「调查兑换」：单价「调查徽章」×50000，每月限购 1 次。
- 「无光兑换」：单价「黑色贡物」×50000，每月限购 1 次。
- 「融珠兑换」：单价「融蚀之珠」×50000，每月限购 1 次。

曜闪是一种卡牌装饰边框，不会影响卡面插画、与可能的战斗特效。
Scintilla is a decorative card border. It does not affect the card's illustration, nor any potential battle visual effects.

posts.title: Preview: Traphase Pausing New Updates, Entering Balance Maintenance Mode
posts.titleTr: 预览：Traphase 暂停新更新，进入平衡维护模式

op.content:
Since its release, Traphase has accompanied all of you through many moments. It has been a great joy to see more and more Keepers playing and enjoying this mode.

However, after careful consideration, we've decided that Traphase will pause new content updates from now on and enter a state of balance maintenance. This wasn't an easy decision, but we believe it's a necessary one.

We deeply understand that the foundation Traphase is built on is "every choice matters." But with each new batch of cards added, the space of tactical combinations grows multiplicatively. The more content there is, the harder it becomes to ensure every choice remains clear and every match remains pure.

So rather than rushing to add more new cards, we'd like to first polish the game's core experience so that every card is worth your investment, and only then resume adding new content to Traphase.

For example, we're planning to add more detailed environment displays for Traphase, showing each card's recent popularity and win rate across different rank tiers, to help everyone better understand Traphase.

If you have any further thoughts on Traphase, feel free to leave a comment and let us know!
op.tr:
自发布以来，Traphase 陪伴大家度过了许多时刻。看到越来越多的守护者玩并享受这种模式，我感到非常高兴。

但经过慎重考虑，我们决定Traphase即日起暂停新内容更新，进入平衡维护状态。这不是一个容易的决定，但我们相信这是一个必要的决定。

我们深刻理解 Traphase 的基础是“每一个选择都很重要”。但随着每一批新卡牌的添加，战术组合的空间都会成倍增长。内容越多，就越难确保每个选择保持清晰、每场比赛保持纯粹。

因此，我们不想急于添加更多新卡牌，而是​​首先打磨游戏的核心体验，让每张卡牌都值得你的投资，然后再继续向 Traphase 添加新内容。

例如，我们计划为Traphase添加更详细的环境展示，展示每张卡牌最近在不同段位的受欢迎程度和胜率，以帮助大家更好地了解Traphase。

如果您对 Traphase 有任何进一步的想法，请随时发表评论并告诉我们！

messages.content:
# 前瞻：相位对弈暂停更新，进入平衡维护状态

相位对弈自发布以来，陪伴大家走过了许多时光，看到越来越多的守密人在游玩这一模式并享受其中，这让我们感到十分高兴。

然而经过慎重考虑，我们决定：相位对弈从现在开始暂停新内容的更新，进入平衡维护状态。做这个决定并不轻松，但我们认为这是必要的。

我们深深明白：相位对弈的立身之本，是"每一个选择都有意义"。但每加入一批新卡，战术组合空间是乘法增长的。内容越多，越难保证每个选择依然清晰、每场对局依然纯粹。

因此比起快速加入更多新卡牌，我们希望在游戏的基础体验打磨的更好、让每一张卡值得你的投入之后，再重新开始为相位对弈加入新内容。

例如说，我们计划会加入相位对弈更详细的环境展示，可以看到每个卡牌近期在不同分段的热度、胜率，来帮助大家更好的理解相位对弈。

如果大家对相位对弈有什么更多想法，欢迎留言告诉我们！
频率不一定会，但是我们确实会放更多精力在这上面。
We're still maintaining it — we're just pausing the pace of adding new content, so we can polish what's already there and make it better.

posts.title: Statement on the PV-Related Feedback
posts.titleTr: 关于光伏相关反馈的声明

op.content:
We've noted and looked into the concerns that have been raised: the opening of a gameplay trailer released in July 2026 for a certain game bears a strong resemblance to our PV "Silver" (released November 2023), both in composition and sound design. We've completed a side-by-side comparison of the visuals and audio, documented and preserved the relevant materials along with both release timelines, and handed the matter over to a professional team to assess how best to proceed. We'll keep you posted as things develop.

As the producer of Morimens, and as someone who's been a devoted fan of that game's original series for years, coming across something like this leaves me with genuinely complicated feelings. What I'm most grateful for is that you all cared enough to speak up: It reminds us just how much responsibility we carry.

As a token of thanks for your support, we'll be releasing a 4K wallpaper of this specific CG from "Silver" for everyone to keep. We'll do everything we can to live up to your expectations and keep pushing forward.

May the Silver Key light our path.
op.tr:
我们注意到并调查了人们提出的担忧：某游戏于 2026 年 7 月发布的游戏预告片的开场与我们的 PV“Silver”（2023 年 11 月发布）在构图和声音设计上都非常相似。我们已经完成了视觉和音频的并排比较，记录并保存了相关材料以及两个发布时间表，并将此事移交给专业团队来评估如何最好地进行。随着事态的发展，我们会及时通知您。

作为《Morimens》的制作人，以及多年来该游戏原作系列的忠实粉丝，遇到这样的事情让我的心情非常复杂。我最感激的是你们都足够关心并敢于发声：这提醒我们肩负着多大的责任。

为了感谢大家的支持，我们将发布《Silver》这张特定CG的4K壁纸供大家保存。我们将尽一切努力不辜负您的期望并继续前进。

愿银钥匙照亮我们的道路。

messages.content:
### 关于PV相关反馈的核验说明

我们注意到并核验了大家反馈的问题：某游戏26年7月发布的实机预告片开头与我们23年11月发布的PV《银芯》在构图与声音设计上存在高度相似。我们已完成画面与音效的比对，相关素材与双方发布时间线已完成存证，并已提交专业团队评估后续处理方式。有进展会同步大家。

作为《忘却前夜》的制作人，也作为该游戏原作系列多年的忠实粉丝，出现这样的雷同属实让我百感交集。最感谢的，是大家对于这件事的在意——这让我们感到肩上责任的沉重。

为了感谢大家的厚爱，我们将特别放出《银芯》中这张CG的4K版壁纸，供大家收藏。我们会全力以赴承载大家的期待，继续努力。

愿银钥指引前路。

### PV 관련 피드백에 대한 확인 안내

안녕하세요, 수호자님.

당사는 여러분께서 2026년 7월에 특정 게임이 공개한 인게임 트레일러 오프닝이 저희 측에서 2023년 11월에 공개한 PV 《은심》의 구성과 사운드 디자인에서 매우 높은 유사성을 보이고 있다고 제기해 주신 문제를 인지하고 확인하였습니다. 당사는 화면과 음향에 대한 비교 분석을 완료하였으며, 관련 소재와 양측의 공개 타임라인에 대한 증거 보존을 마쳤습니다. 또한, 전문가 팀에 향후 처리 방안에 대한 평가를 의뢰를 마친 상태입니다. 진전 사항이 있을 경우 다시 공유해 드리도록 하겠습니다.

《모리멘스》의 프로듀서이자, 해당 게임 원작 시리즈의 오랜 팬으로서 이러한 유사성이 발생한 것에 대해 매우 복잡한 심경입니다. 무엇보다도 여러분께서 이 일에 대해 관심을 가져주신 점에 깊이 감사드리며, 이는 저희가 맡은 책임의 무게를 더욱 절감하게 합니다.

여러분의 소중한 성원에 보답하고자, 《은심》 중 해당 CG의 4K 월페이퍼를 특별히 공개하오니 많은 소장 부탁드립니다. 저희는 여러분의 기대에 부응하기 위해 전력을 다해 계속 노력하겠습니다.

은열쇠가 앞길을 인도하길.
messages.tr:

愿银钥匙指引你的道路。

posts.title: Notice Regarding Music Content Adjustments and Our Sincere Apology
posts.titleTr: 关于音乐内容调整的通知并致以诚挚的歉意

op.content:
Dear Keepers,

During a recent internal review, we identified that a melodic segment featured in Awakener Pontos's soundtracks bears similarity to a pre-existing musical work. Following thorough investigation and internal discussion, we have concluded that this content does not align with the creative standards we uphold at Morimens. Accordingly, we have made the decision to implement immediate adjustments. We would like to extend our sincere apologies for this oversight.

Affected Content

The following soundtracks, which incorporate the melody in question, will be adjusted:

- Psyche Deepdive "Ebwynnos Evermore" Act 1: "Family Secret" (00:00–00:20)
- Psyche Deepdive "Ebwynnos Evermore" Act 4: "When You Were Gone" (00:00–00:20)
- Radio Drama "Addiction" (07:00–07:20)

The relevant in-game content will be updated at the earliest opportunity, and the affected material will be removed from all media platforms as soon as possible. Once adjustments are finalized, the revised versions will be re-released.

Our Commitment

Originality and respect for intellectual property are core principles that B.I.A.V Studio has always upheld, and they form the very foundation upon which Morimens is built. This incident has revealed shortcomings in our creation, review, and publishing processes, and we take full responsibility for them. Moving forward, we are committed to strengthening the rigor of our internal workflows to prevent similar issues from occurring in the future.

As a token of our apology for this oversight, we will be distributing the following to all Keepers shortly:

Luminous Core ×10
Ethereal Core ×10
Pure Core ×10

We are deeply grateful for your continued support, understanding, and trust in Morimens. Your patience as we work to make things right means a great deal to us.

Sincerely,
B.I.A.V Studio
op.tr:
亲爱的守护者，

在最近的一次内部审查中，我们发现 Awakener Pontos 配乐中的旋律片段与预先存在的音乐作品相似。经过彻底的调查和内部讨论，我们得出的结论是，该内容不符合我们在 Morimens 坚持的创意标准。据此，我们决定立即实施调整。我们对这一疏忽表示诚挚的歉意。

受影响的内容

以下包含相关旋律的配乐将进行调整：

- Psyche Deepdive“Ebwynnos Evermore”第一幕：“家庭秘密”（00:00–00:20）
- Psyche Deepdive“Ebwynnos Evermore”第四幕：“当你离开时”（00:00–00:20）
- 广播剧《上瘾》（07:00–07:20）

我们将第一时间更新相关游戏内容，并尽快从所有媒体平台下架受影响的内容。一旦调整完成，修订后的版本将重新发布。

我们的承诺
原创性和尊重知识产权是 B.I.A.V Studio 一贯秉承的核心原则，也是 Morimens 赖以生存的基础。此次事件暴露了我们创作、审核、出版过程中的不足，我们对此承担全部责任。展望未来，我们致力于加强内部工作流程的严谨性，以防止未来发生类似问题。

为了表达我们对这一疏忽的歉意，我们将很快向所有 Keepers 分发以下内容：

发光核心×10
空灵核心×10
纯核×10

我们衷心感谢您对 Morimens 一如既往的支持、理解和信任。在我们努力把事情做好的过程中，您的耐心对我们来说意义重大。

真诚的，
B.I.A.V工作室

# 일부 음악 콘텐츠 조정 및 사과 관련 안내

안녕하세요, 수호자 님.

최근 사내 검토 과정에서, 폰토스의 BGM 중 멜로디 수초 분량 일부가 다른 작품의 음악과 지나치게 유사한 점을 확인하였습니다. 추후 추가 검토 및 논의를 거쳐, 해당 콘텐츠가 저희 <모리멘스>의 창작 기준에 부합하지 않는다고 판단하여 즉시 조정하기로 결정했습니다. 이번 업무상의 허술함에 대해 심심한 사과의 말씀을 드립니다.

이번에 조정되는 콘텐츠는 다음과 같습니다.

[조정되는 콘텐츠]

· 라디오 드라마 「중독」 엔딩 수초

창작의 원칙과 지식재산권 존중을 고수하는 것은 저희 STUDIO B.I.A.V가 항상 고집해 온 창작 원칙이자, <모리멘스>의 존재 근간입니다. 이번 이슈는 저희의 창작, 검토 및 배포 과정에 아직 허술한 점이 있음을 드러냈습니다. 저희는 이에 대한 책임을 엄중히 인식하며, 내부 업무의 엄밀성을 더욱 강화해 이와 같은 문제가 재발하지 않도록 최선을 다하겠습니다.

이번 업무상의 허술함 관련 이슈에 대한 사죄의 뜻으로, 곧 모든 수호자 분들께 「광휘의 은핵」×10, 「공환의 은핵」×10, 「무구의 은핵」×10을 지급해 드리도록 하겠습니다.

감사합니다.

posts.title: Before the Saya no Uta Collaboration Begins
posts.titleTr: 在 Saya no Uta 合作开始之前

op.content:
## 写在《沙耶之歌》联动开始之前

本次联动是我们 B.I.A.V. Studio 与 Nitro+ 共同的一次特别创作。

作为《沙耶之歌》的忠实粉丝和行业后辈，能够有这次合作机会，我们无比荣幸。我们邀请到川村みどり继续饰演沙耶，请到原主题曲歌手いとうかなこ献声日文版主题曲以致敬原作，并邀请 Emi Evans 演绎英文版主题曲，使其与《忘却前夜》的主题相互呼应。我们对待这次合作的每一个细节，与对待《忘却前夜》中自己的角色与故事同等用心。

我们深深明白，《沙耶之歌》的剧情之于许多读者有着难以替代的位置。也正因如此，想先和大家交个底：我们与 Nitro+ 选择将本次联动以突出印象与氛围的方式，在《忘却前夜》所能承载的形态内尽力呈现。希望各位能在那些未被直接讲述的地方，再一次感受到《沙耶之歌》多年来所留下的那份冲击与触动。

This collaboration is a special work co-created by B.I.A.V. Studio and Nitro+.

As devoted fans of Saya no Uta, and as relative newcomers to this industry, we feel truly honored to have been given this opportunity. We invited Midori Kawamura to reprise the role of Saya, and asked Kanako Ito, who performed the original theme song, to lend her voice to the Japanese theme as a tribute to the source work; for the English theme, we invited Emi Evans, so that it resonates with the themes of Morimens. We have given every detail of this collaboration the same care we give to our own characters and stories within Morimens.

We understand deeply that the story of Saya no Uta holds an irreplaceable place for many readers. That is precisely why we want to be upfront with you: together with Nitro+, we have chosen to bring this collaboration to you as an experience centered on impression and atmosphere, doing our utmost within the form that Morimens can carry. We hope that, in the places left untold, you will once again feel the impact and the resonance that Saya no Uta has left behind over all these years.

messages.content:
Thank you for the feedback! I’m sorry to say, though, that this isn’t an adjustment we’re planning to make.

In our design, this system is meant as an optional, extra use for your Pure Cores — somewhere to spend them once you feel you no longer need them elsewhere. Without it, nothing about the existing game content changes at all.

So if these stats don’t feel worth investing in for you right now, that’s a completely fair call to make — it just means your Pure Cores are still doing valuable work for you elsewhere.
messages.tr:
感谢您的反馈！不过，我很遗憾地说，这不是我们计划进行的调整。

在我们的设计中，这个系统是作为你的 Pure Core 的一种可选的额外用途——一旦你觉得你在其他地方不再需要它们，就可以在某个地方使用它们。没有它，现有游戏内容就不会发生任何变化。

因此，如果您现在觉得这些统计数据不值得投资，那么这是一个完全公平的决定 - 这只是意味着您的 Pure Core 仍在其他地方为您做有价值的工作。
messages.prev: 15分鐘

messages.content:
I appreciate the concern, truly. But I’d gently say this: every investment we make is the best arrangement we can manage within our means — so please don’t worry on that front.

Bringing Emi in to sing for Morimens was something we insisted on, and not for the reason you might think. She also performed for our very first ED — so having her sing the English theme, echoing within “May I Call Your Name,” is a deliberately Morimens choice: one that carries our own mark, rather than simply borrowing from the original Saya no Uta.

We’ll be releasing the full English and Japanese versions of the song at the right time — we hope you’ll all enjoy them when they’re here!
messages.tr:
我真的很感谢你们的关心。但我要温和地说：我们所做的每一项投资都是我们力所能及的最好安排——所以请不要担心这方面。

让 Emi 为 Morimens 唱歌是我们坚持的事情，但原因可能不是你想象的那样。她还为我们的第一首 ED 表演过——所以让她唱英文主题，呼应《May I Call Your Name》，是 Morimens 特意做出的选择：带着我们自己的印记，而不是简单地借用原作《Saya no Uta》。

我们将在适当的时候发布这首歌的完整英文和日文版本——我们希望你们都能喜欢它们！

messages.content:
I’d like to take a moment to be straight with everyone about a few things.

On where we stand, and how we spend: money is tight — we’re holding the survival line — but even so, we deliberately put a larger share toward the milestones that matter most, like our 2nd and 2.5 anniversaries. This is consistent with what I promised before: we’re doing our utmost to turn the support you give us into better content. And when a piece of content grows beyond what we can reasonably carry, rather than forcing out something mediocre, we’d sooner delay it — keeping our costs within a given window under control. To put it simply: it’s like wanting something you can’t quite afford yet, so you set a little aside each month until you can make it happen.

On Emi herself: as a partner, I don’t think it’s quite proper for me to publicly weigh in on whether she’s “expensive” or not — out of respect for the people we collaborate with, that’s not an angle I’ll respond from directly. What I will say is that Emi works with plenty of indie games too, not just AAA titles. I also wrote to thank her personally, and she replied with real warmth. If all goes well in the future, I would love for Emi’s voice to become one of the most iconic parts of Morimens.

On how we make these calls: our budget, our production timelines, and the quality we put into each piece of content aren’t a fixed assembly line. So we choose the arrangement that fits best, and adjust our investment elsewhere accordingly. This time, for instance, for a number of reasons, our investment in the story portion was more limited than in other areas. The turnaround on this collaboration was unusually short — and I genuinely hope that, once we’ve built up more production capacity in the future, we’ll be able to prepare everything more fully.
messages.tr:
I’d like to take a moment to be straight with everyone about a few things.

关于我们的立场和支出方式：资金紧张——我们坚守着生存线——但即便如此，我们还是故意将更大的份额投入到最重要的里程碑上，比如我们成立 2 周年和 2.5 周年纪念日。这与我之前的承诺是一致的：我们正在尽最大努力将您给予我们的支持转化为更好的内容。当某项内容的增长超出了我们可以合理承受的范围时，我们宁愿推迟它，而不是强行淘汰一些平庸的内容——将成本控制在给定的范围内。 To put it simply: it’s like wanting something you can’t quite afford yet, so you set a little aside each month until you can make it happen.
关于惠美本人：作为合伙人，我认为我不太合适公开评论她是否“昂贵”——出于对合作者的尊重，这不是我直接回应的角度。我要说的是，Emi 还与许多独立游戏合作，而不仅仅是 AAA 游戏。我还亲自写信感谢她，她的回信非常热情。如果未来一切顺利，我希望 Emi 的声音能够成为 Morimens 最具标志性的部分之一。

关于我们如何做出这些决定：我们的预算、我们的制作时间表以及我们投入到每件内容中的质量都不是固定的装配线。因此，我们选择最适合的安排，并相应地调整我们在其他地方的投资。例如，这一次，由于多种原因，我们对故事部分的投入比其他领域更加有限。这次合作的周转时间异常短暂——我真诚地希望，一旦我们在未来建立了更多的生产能力，我们将能够更充分地准备一切。

messages.content:
① Combined Banner

We did adjust this type of banner back at the 2nd anniversary — but that decision was based on a different read of the situation at the time, and looking back, we now believe that adjustment was insufficient. After careful reconsideration, we’ve come to see that the combined banner carries both its own risks and its own value. If we ran a fully-rotating banner like this at every half-anniversary, our regular rerun banners would stop meaning anything at all. We want everything to have a sensible rhythm and purpose — the same long-term philosophy we hold for our combat design. So this time, we chose not to change the rotating banner.

② Ethereal Cores

When Ethereal Cores were handed out in large amounts as rewards, that was indeed driven by grey-market concerns — but we’d also said before that they might be used within paid rewards. If you do the math, this design actually lets us offer more pulls for the same spend. Yes, those pulls carry a time limit on conversion, but they still genuinely amount to better value — and that’s before accounting for the fact that the Silver Prime itself comes with a real discount built in through how it’s extracted and gifted. So this, too, is part of us keeping our word in response to introducing AA: our aim is to make +12 meaningful, while also easing the paywall pressure of pulling for everyone.
messages.tr:
① 组合横幅

我们确实在两周年之际调整了这种横幅——但这个决定是基于对当时情况的不同解读，现在回想起来，我们认为调整是不够的。经过仔细的重新考虑，我们发现合并后的旗帜既有其自身的风险，也有其自身的价值。如果我们在每个半周年纪念日都运行一个像这样的完全旋转的横幅，那么我们定期重新运行的横幅将不再具有任何意义。我们希望一切都有一个合理的节奏和目的——这与我们对战斗设计所持有的长期理念相同。所以这一次，我们选择不改变旋转横幅。

② 空灵核心
当空灵核心作为奖励大量发放时，这确实是出于对灰色市场的担忧——但我们之前也说过，它们可能会用于付费奖励。如果您计算一下，这种设计实际上可以让我们以相同的支出提供更多的吸引力。是的，这些拉动对转换有时间限制，但它们仍然确实具有更好的价值——而且这是在考虑到 Silver Prime 本身通过其提取和赠送方式带来真正的折扣这一事实之前。因此，这也是我们在引入 AA 时信守诺言的一部分：我们的目标是让 +12 变得有意义，同时减轻每个人的付费压力。

messages.content: That said, I have to be honest that some things have drifted from what we intended. AA, for instance, was meant to play a far more restrained role than it ended up doing. But once that had already happened, we’ve done our best to remedy it and bring the overall picture back within a reasonable range — for example, by raising the magnitude and scope of base enhancements, and by moving some of the overly strong AA effects to shallower positions, or even into the base kit. We aren’t perfect; we make mistakes; we aren’t gods, and we genuinely can’t deliver 100% of everything promised at any given moment — but we will keep moving toward our goals, without pause.
messages.tr: 也就是说，我必须诚实地说，有些事情已经偏离了我们的初衷。例如，AA 的本意是扮演比它最终扮演的角色要克制得多的角色。但一旦出现这种情况，我们就会尽最大努力进行补救，让整体画面回到合理的范围内——例如，通过提高基础增强的幅度和范围，以及将一些过强的 AA 效果移至较浅的位置，甚至移至基础套件中。我们并不完美；我们会犯错误；我们不是神，我们确实无法在任何特定时刻 100% 兑现所承诺的一切 - 但我们将继续朝着我们的目标前进，不会停顿。

messages.content: This was actually touched on above — I may not have explained it clearly enough. In the realm of free rewards, our purpose was to counter the grey market; but within paid packs, the design serves a different goal. We think of Ethereal Cores as a lower-priced version of Luminous Cores, with the trade-off that they’re time-limited. If you want to get more pulls for the same price within a short window, go for the packs tied to Ethereal Cores. If you’d rather stock up for banners further down the line, go for the packs tied to Luminous Cores. So both may appear among our offerings, for you to choose between.
messages.tr: 这个其实上面已经讲到了，可能是我解释得不够清楚。在免费奖励领域，我们的目的是对抗灰色市场；但在付费包中，设计服务于不同的目标。我们认为空灵核心是发光核心的低价版本，但其代价是它们有时间限制。如果您想在短时间内以相同的价格获得更多拉力，请选择与 Ethereal Core 相关的包。如果您想进一步储备横幅，请购买与发光核心相关的包。因此，两者都可能出现在我们的产品中，供您选择。

op.content:
## 前瞻：V2.5.1 胚胎融合变化

我们计划在 V2.5.1带来几项胚胎融合调整，敬请注意：

- 胚胎融合会以数值显示而非百分比，普通血肉界域在胚胎融合达到 100 时生成 1 个「胚胎」到手中。
- 阿格里帕指令卡「不耐的施舍」：胚胎融合翻倍效果现在最多使基础胚胎融合 +100，不受到胚胎融合效果提高加成。
- 泰旖丝超限爆发「永续圣骸的传承」：如果没有「胚胎」时，不再获得「胚胎」，而是胚胎融合+100，不受到胚胎融合效果提高加成。

这些调整不会影响 V2.5.1 更新之前就拥有的实际能力，但是能够为后续游戏内容更新带来更多的设计空间与信息辨识度。

We plan to roll out several Embryo Fusion adjustments in V2.5.1. Please take note:

- Embryo Fusion will be displayed as a numerical value rather than a percentage. In the standard Caro Realm, when Embryo Fusion reaches 100, 1 "Embryo" will be generated to your hand.
- Agrippa's Command Card "Reluctant Alms": The Embryo Fusion doubling effect will now grant at most +100 base Embryo Fusion, and will not benefit from Embryo Fusion effect bonuses.
- Thais's Over-Exaltation "Sacred Relic's Perpetuity": When there is no "Embryo", instead of gaining an "Embryo", you will gain +100 Embryo Fusion, which is not affected by Embryo Fusion effect bonuses.

These adjustments will not affect actual capabilities you already possess prior to the V2.5.1 update, but will provide greater design space and clearer information legibility for subsequent content updates.

posts.title: Preview: V2.5.1 Chaos Awakener Enhancement
posts.titleTr: 预览：V2.5.1 混沌觉醒者增强

op.content:
# 前瞻：V2.5.1  混沌唤醒体强化

按此前与大家沟通的那样，我们将在 V2.5.1 的更新中为大量常驻与忘却篇唤醒体带来正向加强。

本次加强的两个目的：

## 一、让老朋友跟得上新内容的体验。

我们始终希望，不论游戏后续如何变更与发展，所有唤醒体都能在相应篇章中保持合理的出场空间。我们注意到部分常驻唤醒体在后期内容中体感吃力，因此会视情况分别处理：
如果整体需要增强，我们会以基础能力加强为主，让唤醒体在所有内容中都更强。
如果主要是星辰篇表现不佳，我们会通过强化「灵塑适性」来解决，在不影响常规内容平衡的前提下定向改善后期内容的体验。

## 二、缓解 V2.5.0 中部分最终法则过重的问题。
V2.5.0 上线后，我们观察到个别唤醒体的整体强度过度集中于最终法则。对于这些情况，我们会把一部分能力从最终法则下放到唤醒体的基础能力中。需要强调的是，这是"下放"而非"转移"——已经拥有最终法则的守密人，在调整后的总体强度与调整前持平或更强，绝不会因此变弱。 具体到每位唤醒体的换算逻辑，我们会在正文中逐条标明"两者同时存在时总效果不变"。

## 敬请注意
- 由于内容非常多，帖子会按界域划分来发布，请大家自行前往对应的日志进行浏览，并在回复中反馈你的想法。
- 这些改动仍然在内部测试中，我们会根据大家的反馈做进一步优化——但调整方向只会是持平或进一步提升，不会对本次前瞻的整体加强幅度做向下削减。
- 最终上线时具体数值可能与前瞻有细微差异，届时请以更新公告为准。

衷心感谢大家对于忘却前夜的支持和理解。

messages.content:
As previously communicated, V2.5.1 will bring targeted positive enhancements to a broad selection of Standard and Faded Legacy Awakeners.

This round of enhancement has two purposes.

## I. Helping our long-standing Awakeners keep pace with the evolving experience.
We have always hoped that, however Morimens evolves over time, every Awakener can retain a reasonable place on the field within their respective chapters. We have observed that some Standard Awakeners currently feel underpowered in late-game content. We will therefore address these cases on an individual basis:

If overall reinforcement is needed, we will focus on strengthening the Awakener's base kit, making them stronger across all content.
If the issue is specifically underperformance in Astral Reign, we will address it by strengthening "Soulforge Aptitude" — improving the late-game experience in a targeted way without disturbing the balance of regular content.

## II. Easing the over-concentration of power in Absolute Axioms introduced in V2.5.0.
Since V2.5.0 went live, we have observed that a few Awakeners' overall strength has become overly concentrated in their Absolute Axiom. For these cases, we will relocate a portion of that power from the Absolute Axiom down into the Awakener's base kit.

We want to emphasize: this is a "downward transfer," not a "reallocation" — for Keepers who already possess the Absolute Axiom in question, the post-adjustment overall strength will be equal to, or greater than, the pre-adjustment strength, and will never be reduced. The precise conversion logic for each Awakener will be annotated in the main posts with the note "overall effect remains unchanged when both are in effect."
messages.tr:
正如之前所传达的，V2.5.1 将为标准和褪色遗产觉醒者的广泛选择带来有针对性的积极增强。

此轮增强有两个目的。

## I. 帮助我们长期的觉醒者跟上不断变化的体验。
我们一直希望，无论莫里门斯如何随着时间的推移而发展，每个觉醒者都能在各自的战团中保留一个合理的位置。我们观察到，一些标准觉醒者目前在游戏后期内容中感到动力不足。因此，我们将根据具体情况处理这些情况：

如果需要整体强化，我们将重点加强觉醒者的基础套件，使它们在所有内容上都变得更强。
如果问题具体是在《星界王朝》中表现不佳，我们将通过加强“灵魂锻造能力”来解决它——有针对性地改善游戏后期体验，同时不影响常规内容的平衡。

## 二.缓解了 V2.5.0 中引入的 Absolute Axioms 中权力过度集中的问题。
自从V2.5.0上线以来，我们观察到一些觉醒者的整体实力变得过于集中在他们的绝对公理上。对于这些情况，我们会将绝对公理中的一部分力量重新分配到觉醒者的基础套件中。

我们要强调的是：这是“向下转移”，而不是“重新分配”——对于已经拥有绝对公理的Keeper来说，调整后的整体实力将等于或大于调整前的实力，并且永远不会减少。每个觉醒者的精确转换逻辑将在主帖中注明“两者生效时整体效果保持不变”。

- Because there is a great deal of content to cover, the posts will be split by Realm. Please navigate to the corresponding thread for each Realm and share your feedback in the replies.

Thank you sincerely for your continued support and understanding of Morimens.

op.content:
# 【制作人公开信】我们绝不会辜负

## I. An Apology

The V2.5 changes — Ethereal Cores, the weekly mission restructure, the simultaneous rollout of Absolute Axioms — were packed into a single patch without being communicated ahead of time through a proper devlog. The confusion and anxiety this caused was real, and it was our doing.

This was not a small misstep. It was a failure of judgment on my part as producer, and the responsibility sits entirely with me.

## II. What Happened

I’m not writing this to make excuses. I want you to see the full picture of where we are — not to ask for sympathy, but so the decisions of the last few months make sense in context.

### The progress after Anniversary 2 — and what it cost us

A few months ago, coming out of our 2nd Anniversary, we made more real progress than we had at any point before. We’re still a long way from where the bigger games are — but that progress was enough to let us keep going, to keep working toward what we set out to do. As the producer, I felt genuinely grateful.

But the problem with progress is: you have to keep going.

We are sitting on a large pile of overdue work:
    ∙    Hiring more developers
    ∙    2.0 content reserve that is almost depleted
    ∙    3.0 content that needs to start being built well in advance
    ∙    Raising the quality bar for our updates
    ∙    More collaborations
    ∙    Starting to explore advertising and marketing
    ∙    Hiring operations staff
    ∙    Financial planning and long-term strategy
    ∙    Merchandise design, production, and after-sales
    ∙    Onboarding, training, and culture-building as the team grows

All of this costs money and energy — and it already exceeds what we can comfortably carry.

messages.content:
### Two roads

If we don’t address this — or address it too slowly — it won’t be long before content output, update pace, finances, and staffing all start visibly cracking. That’s the classic death spiral: declining quality → longer update cycles → people leaving → worse quality.

The recent conversation about the shift in character gender ratio this year is actually part of the same cycle. It wasn’t a deliberate choice to reduce male characters — we simply didn’t have the production capacity within this version cycle to course-correct in time. Our intent has always been to keep the ratio stable, with modest variation as the story requires. But situations like this are something the team has lived with for a long time, and we’ve come to the same conclusion each time: unless we fix the root cause, this cycle will keep repeating.

If we choose to accelerate the fix, what does it cost in the short term? More energy drained. More development and marketing spend. More financial pressure. The risks aren’t small.

But if we can get through it, Morimens can finally focus on what we actually want to be doing: new stories, new characters, new gameplay, fully original skins — instead of constantly scrambling to figure out monetization.
messages.tr:
### 两条路

如果我们不解决这个问题——或者解决得太慢——用不了多久，内容输出、更新速度、财务和人员配置都会开始出现明显的问题。这是典型的死亡螺旋：质量下降→更新周期更长→人员离开→质量更差。

最近关于今年角色性别比例变化的讨论实际上是同一周期的一部分。减少男性角色并不是刻意的选择——我们只是没有在这个版本周期内及时纠正路线的生产能力。我们的目的始终是保持比例稳定，并根据故事的需要进行适度的变化。但这样的情况是团队长期面临的情况，每次我们都会得出相同的结论：除非我们解决根本原因，否则这个循环将不断重复。

如果我们选择加速修复，短期内的成本是多少？更多的能量被耗尽。更多的开发和营销支出。财务压力更大。风险不小。
但如果我们能渡过难关，莫里门斯最终可以专注于我们真正想做的事情：新故事、新角色、新游戏玩法、完全原创的皮肤——而不是不断地忙于弄清楚货币化。

messages.content:
### Why V2.5 was the moment

Our 2.5 anniversary is approaching. I believed V2.5.0 was the best window to clean up the game’s historical issues, because our plan for the second half of the year is to bring in more players through some marketing efforts. Making these changes after that window could have led to more painful outcomes — possibly even derailing the entire plan for this year.

The intent behind the V2.5 changes was:
    ∙    Absolute Axiom: to give Keepers who invest all the way to +12 on a character they love something meaningful at the end of that investment, rather than it feeling pointless.
    ∙    Ethereal Cores: to safely distribute more pull currency, without the long-term damage caused by gray-market account farming.
    ∙    Seasonal gameplay rotation: to fix the “rewards too low to motivate play” problem that emerged after the V2.4 workload reduction, and to address the structural issue that old modes grow stale while new modes have nowhere to slot in.
messages.tr:
### 为什么选择 V2.5

我们的 2.5 周年纪念日即将到来。我认为V2.5.0是清理游戏历史问题的最佳窗口，因为我们下半年的计划是通过一些营销努力吸引更多玩家。在这个窗口期之后做出这些改变可能会导致更痛苦的结果——甚至可能破坏今年的整个计划。

V2.5 更改背后的意图是：
    ∙ 绝对公理：在投资结束时为他们喜爱的角色一路投资到+12的守护者提供一些有意义的东西，而不是感觉毫无意义。
    ∙ Ethereal Cores：安全地分配更多的拉币，而不会因灰市账户挖矿而造成长期损害。
    ∙ 季节性轮换：解决V2.4工作量减少后出现的“奖励太低，没有动力玩”的问题，解决旧模式陈旧、新模式无处插入的结构性问题。

messages.content:
### But it all happened too fast

For a team of our size, everything happened too fast — especially once we decided to accelerate the fixes all at once. The team’s capacity, and particularly mine as someone wearing many hats, was severely over-extended.

The result was a version that caused a lot of unnecessary, unintended damage to your trust in us. That’s the objective part of why V2.5.0 felt rushed and under-considered — not because anyone on the dev team wanted to upset you. The subjective part, as I said earlier, is that I underestimated how much risk we were taking on. Once we realized what was happening, we pulled back quickly and adjusted the key parts.

Some have read this as us caving under community pressure — as a painful “do we give in or not” decision. It wasn’t. It was a correction of our own misjudgment — a natural course correction once feedback helped us see how far we had drifted from our own principles and goals.
messages.tr:
###但这一切发生得太快了

对于我们这样规模的团队来说，一切都发生得太快了——尤其是当我们决定立即加速修复时。团队的能力，尤其是我身兼多职的能力，严重超支了。

结果是这个版本对您对我们的信任造成了很多不必要的、意外的损害。这就是为什么 V2.5.0 感到仓促和考虑不足的客观原因——并不是因为开发团队中的任何人想让你不高兴。正如我之前所说，主观部分是我低估了我们承担的风险。当我们意识到发生了什么后，我们迅速撤回并调整了关键部分。

有些人将此解读为我们在社区压力下屈服——作为一个痛苦的“我们是否屈服”的决定。事实并非如此。这是对我们自己错误判断的纠正——一旦反馈帮助我们看到我们偏离自己的原则和目标有多远，这是一种自然的路线纠正。

messages.content:
### On the question: “Are the developers just getting greedy?”

On its own, V2.5.0 does look suspicious. I understand why people are asking whether the developers have gotten greedy. I’ll leave that judgment to you — all I can do is give you my side of the facts.

The fact is this: because of the heavy historical investment debt from the early days, the project as a whole is still deeply in the red — a number that, for a small studio, is genuinely frightening. Financially, the reason the game is able to continue is that we’re hovering near break-even, with things slowly trending upward.

That means we, as individuals, don’t really benefit from the game earning more money — at best, we’re still paying down old debt. These monetization structure changes are not about extracting more money from you. They’re about creating a better sense of “what I put in matches what I get back” across different spending and investment profiles, so the game’s monetization health improves naturally — so the play experience gets better, and so we can keep funding future content, which in turn flows back into more and richer game content.

I’m staking my professional future on this, and I make this promise to you seriously: for as long as I am on this team and serving as the producer of this game, this motivation and this goal will not change.

I want to keep developing this work. No matter what voices or criticism come our way, I will keep putting everything I have into it — and there is only one reason for that:

So the story can be told more completely. So that the emotions and themes of this story, in the end, are worthy of what all of you have put into it.
messages.tr:
### 关于问题：“开发商是不是变得贪婪了？”

就其本身而言，V2.5.0 确实看起来很可疑。我理解为什么人们会问开发商是否变得贪婪了。我将把这个判断留给你——我所能做的就是向你提供我这边的事实。

事实是这样的：由于早期历史上沉重的投资债务，整个项目仍然处于严重亏损状态——对于一个小型工作室来说，这个数字确实令人恐惧。从财务上来说，游戏能够继续进行的原因是我们徘徊在收支平衡附近，而且情况正在缓慢上升。

这意味着我们，作为个人，并没有真正从游戏中获益，赚到更多的钱——充其量，我们仍然在偿还旧债。这些货币化结构的变化并不是为了从你身上榨取更多的钱。它们是为了在不同的支出和投资情况下创造一种更好的“我投入的东西与我得到的东西相匹配”的感觉，因此游戏的货币化健康状况自然会改善 - 因此游戏体验会变得更好，因此我们可以继续为未来的内容提供资金，而这些内容又会回流到更多、更丰富的游戏内容中。
我以此赌上自己的职业前途，郑重地向大家做出这样的承诺：只要我还在这个团队，只要我担任这个游戏的制作人，这个动力、这个目标就不会改变。

我想继续发展这项工作。无论有什么样的声音或批评，我都会继续倾尽全力——原因只有一个：

所以这个故事可以讲得更完整。所以这个故事的情感和主题最终对得起你们所有人的投入。

messages.content:
## III. Recent Changes

### The V2.5.0 problems

For Ethereal Cores and weekly rewards, we’ve already made adjustments so that your normal play rhythm is preserved — total rewards are in fact higher than before. If you’re not interested in the new rewards, you can simply ignore them, and nothing changes for you.

As for the Absolute Axioms that are about to go live — some of them did end up stronger than we had originally planned. This is largely a gap between intent and execution, and it’s difficult to change at this point because some of you may have already started investing resources.

What we can commit to as a correction: V2.5.1 and the versions that follow will strengthen the weaker Axioms to bring the overall balance closer to where we want it — closer to the vision that every character has a reasonable chance to see play. We will also continue to make sure the game does not assume Absolute Axiom possession when designing stages. If there are moments where a technical constraint forces a short-term deviation from that principle, we commit to repairing those deviations through subsequent adjustments.
messages.tr:
## 三.最近的变化

### V2.5.0 的问题

对于空灵核心和每周奖励，我们已经进行了调整，以便保留您正常的游戏节奏 - 总奖励实际上比以前更高。如果您对新奖励不感兴趣，您可以简单地忽略它们，对您来说没有任何变化。

至于即将上线的绝对公理——其中一些最终确实比我们最初计划的更强大。这很大程度上是意图和执行之间的差距，此时很难改变，因为你们中的一些人可能已经开始投入资源。

我们可以承诺的修正：V2.5.1 和后续版本将加强较弱的 Axioms，使整体平衡更接近我们想要的地方 - 更接近每个角色都有合理机会看到比赛的愿景。我们还将继续确保游戏在设计阶段时不会假设绝对公理占有。如果某些时候技术限制迫使我们短期偏离该原则，我们承诺通过后续调整来修复这些偏差。

messages.content:
### V2.5.1 preview

We will be strengthening the base kits of many characters so they can better adapt to the new environment. As we’ve said before, Absolute Axiom is not meant to be a baseline assumption for character strength. Strengthening the base kits directly is how we uphold that.

We will also be adding two PC-exclusive paid options. If you’re willing to support us by playing and paying on PC, there are several angles in which that helps the game more directly. The recent dual-platform reward events we’ve been running are, on one hand, to encourage you to try experiencing the game on different platforms — and on the other hand, tied to this reason.

We will also be fully overhauling the bonus rewards that came with the Silver Prime — they will no longer grant Silver, but will grant Silver Prime directly. And for every historical Silver Prime order you have made, we will offer the option to convert the Silver you received into Silver Prime.

The specific list of base kit improvements for V2.5.1, along with the Absolute Axiom adjustment plan, will be communicated through a devlog before they go live. This will also be the first time I’m making good on the “advance communication” commitment I discuss later in this letter — please hold me to it using that devlog as the test.
messages.tr:
### V2.5.1预览

我们将加强许多角色的基础套件，以便他们能够更好地适应新环境。正如我们之前所说，绝对公理并不意味着成为角色强度的基线假设。直接加强基础套件是我们坚持的方式。

我们还将添加两个 PC 独有的付费选项。如果您愿意通过在 PC 上玩游戏和付费来支持我们，可以从多个角度更直接地帮助游戏。我们最近举办的双平台奖励活动，一方面是为了鼓励大家尝试在不同平台上体验游戏，另一方面也是出于这个原因。

我们还将全面修改 Silver Prime 附带的奖金奖励——它们将不再授予 Silver Prime，而是直接授予 Silver Prime。对于您下达的每一个历史 Silver Prime 订单，我们都会提供将您收到的白银转换为 Silver Prime 的选项。
V2.5.1 基础套件改进的具体列表以及 Absolute Axiom 调整计划将在上线前通过开发日志进行传达。这也将是我第一次兑现我在这封信后面讨论的“预先沟通”承诺——请使用该开发日志作为测试来让我坚持下去。

messages.content:
### Further ahead

We plan to continue releasing more varieties of 1-star skins, because we’ve heard the community ask for them — different outfit variants of characters from event scenarios, for example (like summer event alt-looks). However, this has led to two misunderstandings among some players: Is the dev team trying to make profit off these? And does my favorite character only deserve simple 1-star skins like these?

Let me address this directly: profiting from 1-star skins has never been our goal, and it wouldn’t even make sense as a business. We will ensure that these asset-reuse-style skins are always first distributed for free through events. The current event, which grants one through “get any Silver Prime,” is technically a free reward — but it does sit on the edge of that line, and that was a lapse on our part. I promise this will not happen again.

At the same time, these 1-star skins do not represent the full vision we have for the skin system. We are genuinely interested in making more fully original new skins. But as you can see, even sustaining regular version updates is a challenge for us right now — a side project at that scale isn’t something we can responsibly take on yet.

We are planning to redesign God King · Tulu in V2.7, and the voice actor will naturally change as a result. Looking back at 2.0, we had almost nothing to work with, and the current design was finalized in a rush just to stay on schedule. By the standards we hold ourselves to now, that design cannot meet what you — or we — would reasonably expect. I want all Keepers to understand this clearly.

Between V2.7 and V3.0, we will be introducing a short additional series of minor chapters and new characters, to further explore the variety of the story’s world. As a result, V3.0 will likely arrive roughly a year from now.
messages.tr:
### 更进一步

我们计划继续发布更多种类的 1 星皮肤，因为我们听到社区要求它们 - 例如，来自事件场景的角色的不同服装变体（如夏季事件另类外观）。然而，这导致了一些玩家的两个误解：开发团队是否想从中获利？我最喜欢的角色是否只值得拥有像这样简单的一星皮肤？

让我直接说一下：从一星皮肤中获利从来都不是我们的目标，甚至作为一项业务也没有任何意义。我们将确保这些资产复用风格的皮肤始终首先通过活动免费分发。当前的活动通过“获得任何 Silver Prime”来授予玩家，从技术上讲，这是一项免费奖励 - 但它确实位于该线的边缘，这是我们的失误。我保证这种事不会再发生了。
同时，这些一星皮肤并不代表我们对皮肤系统的完整愿景。我们真正有兴趣制作更完全原创的新皮肤。但正如您所看到的，即使维持定期版本更新现在对我们来说也是一个挑战 - 我们还无法负责任地承担如此规模的副项目。

我们计划在V2.7中重新设计神王·图鲁，声优自然也会随之改变。回顾2.0，我们几乎没有什么可做的，目前的设计只是为了按计划匆忙完成。按照我们现在坚持的标准，该设计无法满足您或我们的合理期望。我希望所有的守护者都能清楚地理解这一点。

在 V2.7 和 V3.0 之间，我们将引入一系列简短的小章节和新角色，以进一步探索故事世界的多样性。因此，V3.0 可能会在大约一年后发布。

messages.content:
## IV. A Final Word

If you put the full chain of logic together, I think you’ll see that if our motive were greed, we wouldn’t be making these changes:
    ∙    Pulling a character to max gives no meaningful return → so we made AA.
    ∙    That pushes total pull demand up → so free pull rewards are being increased.
    ∙    Free rewards going up means gray-market account trading becomes a bigger safety and fairness problem → so Ethereal Cores were planned, to replace newly added rewards in the future.
    ∙    Higher free rewards also weaken the incentive to spend → so we’re reworking the Silver Prime bonuses.
    ∙    To let you better support the game without spending more → we’re starting to encourage PC play.

Of course, you’re free to keep your own judgment on this reasoning. I can only put the facts on the table. The rest is for time to settle.

I can promise this: once these two sets of adjustments land, we will not introduce any further content that deeply changes your established habits before 3.0. We’ll be returning our focus to the fundamentals of the game.

And if 3.0 does eventually require system-level changes, we will make sure to communicate with the community thoroughly beforehand.

And if something comparable ever does come up — no matter how busy we are, I will make the time and the energy to communicate it through a devlog in advance. This is no longer optional. It is mandatory. I hope this letter, and the conversation around it, leaves you with a clearer picture of the full plan — so we can avoid further misunderstandings we could have prevented.

The lesson this time is heavy enough. We will be rebalancing “moving quickly” against “moving carefully,” and keeping your understanding and support at the center of that balance.
messages.tr:
## 四.最后一句话

如果你把完整的逻辑链放在一起，我想你会发现，如果我们的动机是贪婪，我们就不会做出这些改变：
    ∙ 将角色拉至最大值不会产生任何有意义的回报 → 所以我们制作了 AA。
    ∙ 这推高了总拉动需求→因此免费拉动奖励正在增加。
    ∙ 免费奖励的增加意味着灰市账户交易成为一个更大的安全和公平问题 → 因此计划使用 Ethereal Cores 来取代未来新增的奖励。
    ∙ 更高的免费奖励也会削弱消费的动力 → 因此我们正在重新设计 Silver Prime 奖励。
    ∙ 为了让您在不花更多钱的情况下更好地支持游戏→我们开始鼓励在电脑上玩游戏。

当然，您可以自由地对此推理保留自己的判断。我只能把事实摆在桌面上。剩下的就等时间去解决吧。

我可以保证：这两组调整一旦落地，我们将不会再推出任何深刻改变你在3.0之前的既定习惯的内容。我们将把注意力重新集中到游戏的基础上。
如果3.0最终确实需要系统级的更改，我们将确保事先与社区进行充分的沟通。

如果确实出现了类似的情况，无论我们有多忙，我都会花时间和精力通过开发日志提前进行沟通。这不再是可选的。这是强制性的。我希望这封信以及围绕它的对话能让您对整个计划有更清晰的了解，这样我们就可以避免本可以避免的进一步误解。

这次的教训够惨重的。我们将重新平衡“快速行动”和“谨慎行动”，并将您的理解和支持置于这种平衡的中心。

messages.content:
### This game is not really ours. It’s yours.

Thank you to every Keeper still speaking up in the community — whether you’ve been critical, constructive, or supportive. This game has made it this far because of you. You are the ones who saved Morimens.

We will not fail you.

We will not forget.
messages.tr:
### 这个游戏并不是我们真正的游戏。这是你的。

感谢每一位仍在社区中发声的 Keeper，无论您是批评性的、建设性的还是支持性的。因为有你们，这个游戏才走到这一步。你们是拯救莫里门斯的人。

我们不会让您失望。

我们不会忘记。

messages.content:
## 一、致歉

V2.5 的这一连串改动——空幻之芯、每周任务重构、最终法则一次性铺开——塞在同一个补丁里、又缺乏通过开发日志提前沟通，给大家带来了困惑和焦虑。

这不是一次小失误。是我作为制作人的判断失误，责任全面在我。

## 二、发生了什么

我不想辩解——但我想让你们理解我们的处境。这不是为了”博取同情”——只是让大家看到事情的完整图景。

### 2 周年的进步 —— 和它的代价

几个月前，经过 2 周年庆，我们确实取得了前所未有的进步。虽然和其他热门游戏相比还距离很远——但这份成绩已经足够支撑我们继续往前走、完成我们的愿景。作为制作人——我已经感到无比满足。

但问题是——要继续往前走。

我们面临一大堆需要处理的”债务工作”：
    ∙    开发人员招聘
    ∙    2.0 的储备即将耗尽
    ∙    3.0 的内容需要提前建设储备
    ∙    提升更新质量
    ∙    更多的联动合作
    ∙    在广告营销上寻找机会
    ∙    运营人员招聘
    ∙    财务和长期目标的规划
    ∙    周边设计、制作跟进、售后
    ∙    团队扩张后的教学与文化磨合
    ∙    重申战斗玩法设计的哲学
这些——全都需要费用和精力，已经严重超出了我们当前能够负担的程度。

### 两条路的选择

如果我们不解决或慢慢解决——那不用多久，后续内容、更新、财务、人员都会出现明显断档——陷入”产能品质下降 → 更新周期拉长 → 人员流失”的恶性循环。

前阵子关于”第三年性别比例变化”的话题——其实也是这个循环的一部分影响。这并不是我们主动想要减少男性比例——而是在当前版本周期内、我们的制作资源只能支撑这样，来不及作出修正调整。整体上我们希望比例稳定的基础上随故事需要略微波动。但像这种情况，是过去团队里一直发生的事情——我们意识到：如果不去解决根源问题，这个恶性循环永远走不出来。

如果我们选择加速修复——会遭遇什么？短期内：更多的精力消耗、更多的开发和市场费用、更大的财务压力。风险和挑战都不小。

但如果能解决——忘却前夜在未来就可以专注于”新内容的更新”，做我们最想做的事情：新故事、新角色、新玩法、完全原创的新皮肤——而不是被迫在商业变现上不断想办法。

### V2.5 为什么是这个时机

2.5 周年即将到来。我认为 V2.5.0 是解决游戏内历史问题的最佳时机——因为我们计划在下半年通过一些推广方式来吸引更多玩家加入。如果到那时才改——可能会带来更痛苦的后果、甚至让今年整个计划失败。

V2.5 的几个改动背后的初衷是：
    ∙    最终法则：给愿意把喜欢的角色投资到 +12 的守密人一份奖励，而不是觉得毫无用处
    ∙    空幻之芯：通过更安全的方式为大家带来更多抽卡资源，而不必担心灰色产业带来的长期影响
    ∙    玩法赛季轮换：修复 V2.4 减负带来的”部分玩法奖励过低而游玩动力不足”问题，以及”老玩法总会疲劳而难以加入新玩法”的结构问题

### 但这一切发生得太快了

对于我们人数本来就少的团队——一切发生得太快了。尤其是在我们选择”加速解决所有问题”的情况下——团队的精力、特别是身兼多职的我——出现了严重的精力不足。

于是这次版本带来了很多不必要、非本意、但严重损耗大家信任的后果。这是 V2.5.0 种种仓促和考虑不周的客观部分原因——而非开发人员们故意想让大家不开心。主观原因如前所述——是我低估了这样做的风险。意识到这些问题之后——我们撤回方案得很快，对关键处作出调整。

有人说这是我们迫于”要不要向社区妥协”的压力作出的痛苦决定。实际上这单纯是我们考虑不周的问题——因此在大家给出反馈、我们发现与原则和目标的偏离之后——自然而然进行快速纠错。

### 关于”开发者是否变得贪婪”

V2.5.0 单独看上去的确非常可疑——开发者是不是变得贪婪了？这个我交给大家去判断——我只能力所能及地提供我这边的信息：

事实是——由于早期巨大的历史投入债务，我们至今在项目总体上仍然严重亏损——这对一个小团队来说是个可怕的数字。这个作品在财务上目前仍然能继续，是因为我们只是处于盈亏平衡附近，整体在逐渐上升。

因此，我们开发者个人很难从游戏收入提高中得到回报，顶多只是继续偿还债务。这些商业化结构改动——不是为了逼迫大家付更多的钱——而是使不同付费程度、不同投资选择的守密人都有更匹配的回报感——从而自然而然改善游戏的货币化表现——让游玩体验更好，也能更好地支持游戏未来内容的开发——最后这些资源反哺到更丰富的游戏内容里。

我赌上职业生涯未来的一切，向大家郑重承诺：只要我还在这个团队、担任这个游戏的制作人——这个动机和目标就绝对不会变。

我想要继续发展这个作品——不管面对怎样的声音和批评——都选择继续投入我最大程度的一切——有且只有一个原因：

让这个故事更完整地讲下去，让这个故事的情感和主题——最终对得起大家的投入与期待。

## 三、近期的改动

### V2.5.0 的问题

对于空幻之芯和周常奖励——我们已经做出了调整来保持大家过往的游玩习惯——总奖励比以往还要更好。如果对新的奖励不感兴趣也可以选择忽略——不会有任何东西发生变化。

而对于目前即将实装的最终法则——部分强度的确超出了我们原本的规划。这个更多是执行层面的预期偏差——现在很难改变——因为可能已经有人开始使用资源投入了。

我们能做出的修补承诺是：会在 V2.5.1 及后续的版本对许多角色过弱的最终法则作出强化调整——使得整体更平衡——更符合”所有角色都有合理机会上场”的愿景。也仍然确保游戏不会假设大家拥有最终法则来进行关卡设计。就算有些时候因为一些不可逆的技术原因短暂偏离了目标——我们也一定会通过后续调整修复这些问题。

### V2.5.1 的改动预告

我们会在这个版本增强许多角色的基础能力——使他们能够更好地适应新环境。正如我们之前所说——最终法则不会作为角色基础强度的假设前提。对角色基础能力进行补强——就是这个目的。

我们还会增加两个 PC 专有的付费选项。如果你愿意支持我们、在 PC 游玩和付费——几乎总是能够在多个角度对游戏有着更积极的帮助。我们最近推出的双平台相关奖励活动——一方面是鼓励大家尝试用不同的平台享受游戏——另一方面则是这个原因。

我们也会彻底升级原先的提取原液附赠奖励——使它们不再赠送银芯，而是变为赠送源液！并且对于所有历史发生过的提取源液订单——我们都会提供将银芯兑换为源液的机会。

V2.5.1 关于角色基础技能的具体增强名单、以及最终法则的调整方案——我会在实装前通过开发日志与大家详细沟通。这也是我在这封信后半部分提到的”提前沟通”承诺的第一次兑现——请各位守密人用这次开发日志来检验我是否真的说到做到。

### 更遥远的未来

我们未来还会持续推出各种各样的一星皮肤——是因为我们留意到了社区相关的声音——大家希望收集这些各种各样差异的版本（例如夏日活动剧情中不同的换装版本立绘）。然而——这导致部分玩家产生了两个误会：开发团队是否想通过这些东西来获得利润？我喜欢的角色就只能够提供这样简易的一星皮肤吗？

请容我说明：通过一星盈利从来不是我们的目的，这也极不符合实际。我们会保证这些资产复用型的皮肤——首先都会通过活动免费推出。这次的新活动以”提取任意源液赠送”的形式存在——虽然为赠送——但确实踩上了这一边界——这是我们的不慎——我向大家保证未来这样的事情不会发生。
同时——这些一星皮肤也不代表我们对整个皮肤系统应有的期待——我们也非常感兴趣——想要为大家带来更多真正全新制作的皮肤。但如各位所见——目前稳定的版本更新对我们都有挑战——这样的支线任务短时间内还不是成熟的时机。

我们计划 V2.7 神王·图鲁会重新设计——声优自然也会因此发生改变。回顾 2.0 当时——我们几乎什么都没有——为了赶上规划节奏——匆忙定稿了当时的设计。以现在的标准审视——这将难以满足大家和我们自己的期待。请各位守密人充分了解这一点。

在 V2.7 与 V3.0 之前——我们将会引入一个额外的系列小型篇章和新角色——来继续探索故事舞台的多样性。因此 V3.0 可能会在一年后左右的时间才能到来。

## 四、写在最后

如果把所有的逻辑链路整合来看——应该会发现如果我们的动机是贪婪，那我们就不会做这些调整：
    ∙    抽卡抽到满没有得到合理回报 → 所以做最终法则
    ∙    需求的抽卡数会变大 → 所以免费的奖励会提高
    ∙    免费的奖励提高 → 灰色账号交易会有更大的账号安全性和公平性问题 → 因此计划用空幻之芯来取代游戏未来进一步增加的新奖励
    ∙    免费奖励提高 → 付费会更没有动力 → 所以重做提取源液的奖励
    ∙    为了让大家在付费不变的情况下也能够更好地支持游戏 → 所以我们开始转变策略 → 鼓励大家在 PC 上进行游戏

当然——对于这个逻辑，你仍然可以保留自己的判断。我只能把事实摆在这里，剩下的交给时间。

我可以向大家保证——这两个部分的调整完成后——在 3.0 之前游戏不会再有任何可能深刻影响大家习惯变更的内容。我们将重新专注于游戏的基础更新。

如果 3.0 确实需要对系统进行调整，我们也会提前与社区进行充分沟通。

如果未来还有——无论有多忙，我都会腾出时间和精力——提前通过开发日志与大家沟通。这不再是个可选项——而是必选项。希望这次说明和沟通——更能够让大家完整地了解我们整个规划——避免任何进一步不必要的误解。

这次的教训已经足够沉重——我们会重新平衡”快速”与”稳妥”的推进节奏——始终将大家的理解和支持放在第一位。

### 这个游戏实际上不是我们的，而是你们的。

谢谢每一位还在社区里发声的守密人——不管是批评的、建议的、还是支持的——这款游戏能走到今天——是因为你们。是你们拯救了忘却前夜。

我们绝不会辜负。

我们绝不会忘记。

@everyone

Update: I want to share where we’ve landed on Absolute Axiom and the cases where the design went too far — Doresain being the clearest example. The combat design team and I have just reached an alignment on our approach.

In order for Absolute Axiom to serve its intended purpose — without trapping us in an unnecessary balance spiral — V2.5.1 will move a portion of the overpowered Axiom abilities into the character’s base kit at E0.

Using Doresain as the example: 50% of his damage overflow effect will become part of his base kit.

This change will not alter the final effect of any Axiom already committed to, but it may affect how you plan your Axiom investments going forward. Doresain is likely not the only case — we’ll keep reviewing others.

新进展：关于最终法则与例如杜勒赛因这样设计过头的案例，我们的处理方针刚刚与战斗设计师达成了一致。

为了让最终法则服务原本的预期，不至于在平衡时陷入无序膨胀，我们会在V2.5.1 将一部份过于强大的最终法则部份能力转变为0启时的基础能力。

以杜勒赛因为例，其伤害溢出效果将会有 50% 成为基础能力。

这项改动不会影响任何目前承诺的最终法则最终效果，但可能会影响大家对于最终法则的投资规划。杜勒赛因也可能不是唯一的例子，我们会继续观察。

messages.content:
To clarify on one point: Ethereal Cores do serve a different role when they’re inside paid bundles.
What they make possible is offering more pulls per bundle at the same price point — which is especially suited to small, high-value bundles. With Luminous Cores (permanent currency), that kind of pricing is much harder to sustain.
This still fits into the broader framework we’ve been working toward: letting players across different spending levels end up with more pulls, within a financially healthy structure.
messages.tr:
澄清一点：当 Ethereal Core 位于付费捆绑包中时，它们确实扮演着不同的角色。
他们所做的是在相同的价格点上为每个捆绑包提供更多的拉力——这特别适合小型、高价值的捆绑包。对于夜光核心（永久货币）来说，这种定价更难以维持。
这仍然符合我们一直致力于的更广泛的框架：让不同支出水平的参与者在财务健康的结构内最终获得更多的吸引力。

I’m sorry for the misunderstanding. Let me clarify what the commitment actually meant:

We don’t port existing character adjustments from JP directly into Global — that would change content players already have, which is a line we hold.

However, for new designs on both sides, the two versions do look at each other’s experience. For new Realm designs, we are drawing on similar thinking to what JP has explored — including some of their cooldown-based mechanics — because we’ve found those approaches can release more interesting combinations in a controlled way.

But our version’s execution is more aggressive — in numbers and mechanics — to make sure the step-up from classic Realms is meaningful enough.

messages.content:
Even though this is usually considered self-evident in other games, I still want to do my best to be transparent and walk you through our thinking.

Over the long term, yes, the numbers do trend upward, and this has been happening continuously. There are a lot of factors at play. For example, in certain versions or phases, HP was substantially lowered due to an unintended technical error, which meant we later had to gradually dial it back up.That re-adjustment happened to fall right before GMurphy’s release, which was awkward timing. The other factor is maintaining challenge: as players gradually strengthen their teams and their combat strategies keep evolving, enemies become relatively weaker in comparison. Of course, we’d want players’ overall power to grow faster than enemies’. Once it reaches a certain threshold, we consider introducing a new difficulty tier or compressing existing difficulties and raising their rewards, which has happened a few times. The original highest score used to be 350.

I can’t promise that numerical inflation won’t happen. But we try to slow it down through differentiated specialties and mechanics, aiming to bring freshness and fun rather than just pure stat increases, and we’ll always maintain older characters so they can reasonably keep up with the evolving environment.
messages.tr:
尽管这在其他游戏中通常被认为是不言而喻的，但我仍然想尽力保持透明并引导您了解我们的想法。

从长远来看，是的，数字确实呈上升趋势，而且这种情况一直在持续发生。有很多因素在起作用。例如，在某些版本或阶段，HP由于意外的技术错误而大幅降低，这意味着我们后来不得不逐步将其调高。而这次重新调整恰好在GMMurphy发布之前进行，这是一个尴尬的时机。另一个因素是保持挑战：随着玩家逐渐增强自己的队伍，战斗策略不断演变，敌人会变得相对较弱。当然，我们希望玩家的整体实力增长得比敌人快。一旦达到一定的阈值，我们就会考虑引入新的难度等级，或者压缩现有的难度并提高奖励，这种情况已经发生过几次了。原来的最高分是350分。
我不能保证数字膨胀不会发生。但我们试图通过差异化的专业和机制来放慢速度，旨在带来新鲜感和乐趣，而不仅仅是纯粹的统计数据增加，并且我们将始终保留较老的角色，以便他们能够合理地跟上不断变化的环境。

messages.content:
We loved those year-one event mechanics too, and the workload on them came close to main-story territory. A lot of the event mechanics and combat back then, I was building myself. But I’ve had to shift that energy toward marketing, PR, communication, rebuilding the team through hiring, and management. Starting this year, I’ve been getting more involved in character design again, especially with Vortice and Arachne most recently, where I’ve been deeply hands-on, working alongside the combat designers to reclaim the kind of fun the game used to have.

Our investment in combat this past year hasn’t been enough. We tried to free up what budget we could to support story and art, which meant cutting in other places. Once updates get back into a healthy, stable rhythm, gameplay design will gradually catch up too.

去年我们在战斗方面的投入还不够。我们试图腾出尽可能多的预算来支持故事和艺术，这意味着要削减其他地方。一旦更新恢复到健康、稳定的节奏，游戏玩法设计也会逐渐跟上。

posts.title: 致歉：V2.5.0 「空幻之芯」奖励调整和未来计划 Apology: V2.5.0 Ethereal Core Reward Adjustments and Future Plans

op.content:
「空幻之芯」是 V2.5.0 中引入的全新奖励道具，它预期在整个 V2.5.X 中能够作为「流明之芯」使用，而在 V2.5.X 结束后则会转化为「无垢之芯」。

这个设计的主要考量是，防止一些灰色工作室利用我们游戏内的奖励进行长期积累，最终滋生不安全、不合法的账号交易行为，这会影响大家的账号安全和公平性，也不利于游戏的长期发展。次要考量是，我们也希望提高游戏内的奖励进一步缓解正常游玩的守密人抽取负担，通过「空幻之芯」这样我们就可以在游戏中为大家带来更多奖励。这两个考量都比较敏感，所以请原谅我最初没有明说这一点。

然而，这项调整确实存在问题，改变原有的奖励结构会误伤了部分守密人正常的游玩习惯，迫使大家可自由支配的资源变少。昨天各个社区在我进行解释作用后也依然产生了许多担忧和讨论，大家的声音，我们都切实的听到了。我作为制作人，对于这项调整未能充分与大家沟通、设计也存在不成熟、影响大家体验的地方深感自责，在此向大家真诚的致歉。

经过仔细研究和讨论，我们决定修正这个错误，会立即对「空幻之芯」的当前奖励设计做出调整：

- 「空幻之芯」只可能用于今后游戏内新增加的奖励、新的购买内容、或特殊玩法活动等纪念场合大量发放等特殊场合。
- 目前游戏内的奖励、版本预览图中原有的常规活动奖励的「空幻之芯」都将变回「流明之芯」，以确保大家在游戏常规活动原有应得的奖励不会有任何自由度的损失。

非常感谢大家提出了具体反馈、建议、做了详细分析——在你们的反馈帮助我们下定决心推动了这次调整。希望大家能够继续多多支持脑缸组与《忘却前夜》！我们将继续保持聆听！

messages.content:
The Ethereal Core is a new reward item introduced in V2.5.0. It was designed to function as a Luminous Core throughout the entire V2.5.X cycle, and then convert into a Pure Core after V2.5.X ends.

The primary reason behind this design was to prevent grey-market studios from exploiting in-game rewards through long-term accumulation, which would ultimately foster unsafe and illegitimate account trading — something that threatens everyone's account security and fairness, and is harmful to the game's long-term health. The secondary reason was that we also wanted to increase in-game rewards to further ease the pull burden for Keepers during normal gameplay — and Ethereal Cores would have allowed us to introduce more rewards into the game. Both of these considerations are sensitive in nature, so please forgive me for not stating them upfront initially.

However, this adjustment was genuinely flawed. Changing the existing reward structure ended up hurting some Keepers' normal play habits, forcing a reduction in freely disposable resources. Even after my explanations across various communities yesterday, many concerns and discussions continued — and we heard every one of them. As the producer, I feel deep personal responsibility for failing to communicate this change adequately and for the immaturity in its design that negatively affected everyone's experience. I sincerely apologize.

messages.content:

- Ethereal Cores will only be used for newly added rewards, new purchasable content, or special occasions such as commemorative events and special gameplay activities where they may be distributed in large quantities.
- All Ethereal Cores in existing in-game rewards and in the regular event rewards shown in the version preview will be reverted back to Luminous Cores, ensuring that Keepers will not lose any freedom over the rewards they were originally entitled to from regular events.
